CLASS zcl_find_ceo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_ceo_name.
    DATA lt_employees TYPE TABLE OF zemp_master.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lt_supervisors TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_found_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    rv_ceo_name = ''.

    SELECT * FROM zemp_master INTO TABLE lt_employees.
    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_employees IS INITIAL OR lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT DISTINCT supervisor_id FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE lt_supervisors.

    LOOP AT lt_employees INTO DATA(ls_employee).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_supervisors[ table_line = ls_employee-employee_id ] ).
        lv_ceo_id = ls_employee-employee_id.
        lv_found_count = lv_found_count + 1.
        IF lv_found_count > 1.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_found_count = 1.
      SELECT SINGLE name FROM zemp_master
        WHERE employee_id = lv_ceo_id
        INTO rv_ceo_name.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_ceo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_ceo_name.
    DATA lt_employees TYPE TABLE OF zemp_master.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_employee_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_supervisor_count TYPE i.

    rv_ceo_name = ''.

    SELECT * FROM zemp_master INTO TABLE lt_employees.
    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE lt_org_structure.

    lv_employee_count = LINES( lt_employees ).
    lv_supervisor_count = LINES( lt_org_structure ).

    IF lv_employee_count = 0 OR lv_supervisor_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_supervised_employees TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_org).
      APPEND ls_org-employee_id TO lt_supervised_employees.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_supervised_employees.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_supervised_employees.

    LOOP AT lt_employees INTO DATA(ls_employee).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_supervised_employees[ table_line = ls_employee-employee_id ] ).
        IF lv_ceo_id IS NOT INITIAL.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_ceo_id = ls_employee-employee_id.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_id IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_current_id TYPE abap.char(20) VALUE lv_ceo_id.
    DATA lv_visited_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lt_visited_ids TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_org_check)
      WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current_id.
      lv_current_id = ls_org_check-employee_id.
      APPEND lv_current_id TO lt_visited_ids.
      lv_visited_count = lv_visited_count + 1.

      IF lv_visited_count > lv_employee_count.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    READ TABLE lt_employees INTO DATA(ls_ceo)
      WITH KEY employee_id = lv_ceo_id.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_ceo_name = ls_ceo-name.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_by_prefix IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD filter_by_prefix.
    DATA lv_prefix_len TYPE i.
    DATA lv_string_prefix TYPE string.

    lv_prefix_len = strlen( iv_prefix ).

    LOOP AT iv_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      IF lv_prefix_len > 0.
        lv_string_prefix = substring( val = lv_string
                                      len = lv_prefix_len ).
        IF lv_string_prefix = iv_prefix.
          APPEND lv_string TO rt_result.
        ENDIF.
      ELSEIF lv_prefix_len = 0.
        APPEND lv_string TO rt_result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE ANY TABLE
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE ANY TABLE.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF cell_pos,
             row TYPE i,
             col TYPE i,
           END OF cell_pos.

    CLASS-METHODS find_start_cell
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(pos) TYPE cell_pos.

    CLASS-METHODS dfs
      IMPORTING
        grid         TYPE ANY TABLE
        row          TYPE i
        col          TYPE i
        k            TYPE i
        current_path TYPE ANY TABLE
      CHANGING
        min_path TYPE ANY TABLE.

    CLASS-METHODS is_lexicographically_smaller
      IMPORTING
        path1 TYPE ANY TABLE
        path2 TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: start_pos TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: min_path TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: current_path TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: grid_row TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: cell_val TYPE i.

    n = LINES( grid ).

    DO n TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      READ TABLE grid INTO grid_row INDEX i + 1.
      DO n TIMES.
        j = sy-index - 1.
        cell_val = grid_row[ j + 1 ].
        IF cell_val = 1.
          start_pos-row = i.
          start_pos-col = j.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    CLEAR current_path.
    READ TABLE grid INTO grid_row INDEX start_pos-row + 1.
    cell_val = grid_row[ start_pos-col + 1 ].
    APPEND cell_val TO current_path.

    CLEAR min_path.

    dfs(
      EXPORTING
        grid = grid
        row = start_pos-row
        col = start_pos-col
        k = k
        current_path = current_path
      CHANGING
        min_path = min_path
    ).

    result = min_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_start_cell.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_row TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: cell_val TYPE i.

    n = LINES( grid ).
    pos-row = 0.
    pos-col = 0.

    DO n TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      READ TABLE grid INTO grid_row INDEX i + 1.
      DO n TIMES.
        j = sy-index - 1.
        cell_val = grid_row[ j + 1 ].
        IF cell_val = 1.
          pos-row = i.
          pos-col = j.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_row TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: new_path TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: directions TYPE TABLE OF cell_pos.
    DATA: dir TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: new_row TYPE i.
    DATA: new_col TYPE i.
    DATA: new_grid_row TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: new_cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: current_len TYPE i.

    n = LINES( grid ).
    current_len = LINES( current_path ).

    IF current_len = k.
      IF LINES( min_path ) = 0 OR is_lexicographically_smaller( current_path, min_path ) = abap_true.
        min_path = current_path.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = -1 col = 0 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 1 col = 0 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 0 col = -1 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 0 col = 1 ) TO directions.

    LOOP AT directions INTO dir.
      new_row = row + dir-row.
      new_col = col + dir-col.

      IF new_row >= 0 AND new_row < n AND new_col >= 0 AND new_col < n.
        READ TABLE grid INTO new_grid_row INDEX new_row + 1.
        new_cell_value = new_grid_row[ new_col + 1 ].

        new_path = current_path.
        APPEND new_cell_value TO new_path.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = new_row
            col = new_col
            k = k
            current_path = new_path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_lexicographically_smaller.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: len TYPE i.
    DATA: val1 TYPE i.
    DATA: val2 TYPE i.

    len = LINES( path1 ).
    IF LINES( path2 ) < len.
      len = LINES( path2 ).
    ENDIF.

    result = abap_false.

    DO len TIMES.
      i = sy-index.
      READ TABLE path1 INTO val1 INDEX i.
      READ TABLE path2 INTO val2 INDEX i.
      IF val1 < val2.
        result = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ELSEIF val1 > val2.
        result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_result TYPE TABLE OF i WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE ANY TABLE
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE tt_result.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF cell_pos,
             row TYPE i,
             col TYPE i,
           END OF cell_pos.

    TYPES: tt_bool_row TYPE TABLE OF c WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    TYPES: tt_visited TYPE TABLE OF tt_bool_row WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS find_start_cell
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(pos) TYPE cell_pos.

    CLASS-METHODS dfs
      IMPORTING
        grid       TYPE ANY TABLE
        row        TYPE i
        col        TYPE i
        k          TYPE i
        path       TYPE tt_result
      CHANGING
        min_path   TYPE tt_result
        visited    TYPE tt_visited.

    CLASS-METHODS is_better_path
      IMPORTING
        current_path TYPE tt_result
        min_path     TYPE tt_result
      RETURNING VALUE(is_better) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: start_pos TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: path TYPE tt_result.
    DATA: visited TYPE tt_visited.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: row_table TYPE tt_bool_row.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    start_pos = find_start_cell( grid ).

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid_table>.
    n = LINES( <grid_table> ).

    DO n TIMES.
      CLEAR row_table.
      DO n TIMES.
        APPEND 'X' TO row_table.
      ENDDO.
      APPEND row_table TO visited.
    ENDDO.

    APPEND start_pos-row TO path.

    dfs(
      EXPORTING
        grid = grid
        row = start_pos-row
        col = start_pos-col
        k = k
        path = path
      CHANGING
        min_path = result
        visited = visited
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_start_cell.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: min_val TYPE i VALUE 999999.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_row> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <cell> TYPE i.

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid_table>.
    n = LINES( <grid_table> ).

    DO n TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      ASSIGN <grid_table>[ i + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.
      DO n TIMES.
        j = sy-index - 1.
        ASSIGN <grid_row>[ j + 1 ] TO <cell>.
        IF <cell> < min_val.
          min_val = <cell>.
          pos-row = i.
          pos-col = j.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: current_val TYPE i.
    DATA: new_path TYPE tt_result.
    DATA: directions TYPE TABLE OF cell_pos WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: dir TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: new_row TYPE i.
    DATA: new_col TYPE i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_row> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <cell> TYPE i.

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid_table>.
    n = LINES( <grid_table> ).

    IF LINES( path ) = k.
      IF LINES( min_path ) = 0 OR is_better_path( path, min_path ) = abap_true.
        min_path = path.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN <grid_table>[ row + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.
    ASSIGN <grid_row>[ col + 1 ] TO <cell>.
    current_val = <cell>.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO directions ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<dir>).
    <dir>-row = -1.
    <dir>-col = 0.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO directions ASSIGNING <dir>.
    <dir>-row = 1.
    <dir>-col = 0.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO directions ASSIGNING <dir>.
    <dir>-row = 0.
    <dir>-col = -1.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO directions ASSIGNING <dir>.
    <dir>-row = 0.
    <dir>-col = 1.

    LOOP AT directions INTO dir.
      new_row = row + dir-row.
      new_col = col + dir-col.

      IF new_row >= 0 AND new_row < n AND new_col >= 0 AND new_col < n.
        new_path = path.
        ASSIGN <grid_table>[ new_row + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.
        ASSIGN <grid_row>[ new_col + 1 ] TO <cell>.
        APPEND <cell> TO new_path.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = new_row
            col = new_col
            k = k
            path = new_path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
            visited = visited
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_better_path.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: current_val TYPE i.
    DATA: min_val TYPE i.

    is_better = abap_false.

    DO LINES( current_path ) TIMES.
      i = sy-index.
      current_val = current_path[ i ].
      min_val = min_path[ i ].

      IF current_val < min_val.
        is_better = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ELSEIF current_val > min_val.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

        min_path = min_result
    ).

    result = min_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_start_cell.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: row_idx TYPE i.
    DATA: col_idx TYPE i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_row> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <cell> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid>.
    n = LINES( <grid> ).

    DO n TIMES.
      row_idx = sy-index - 1.
      ASSIGN <grid>[ row_idx + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.

      DO n TIMES.
        col_idx = sy-index - 1.
        ASSIGN <grid_row>[ col_idx + 1 ] TO <cell>.

        IF <cell> = 1.
          start_pos-row = row_idx.
          start_pos-col = col_idx.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: new_path TYPE path_table.
    DATA: directions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cell_pos WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: direction TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: new_row TYPE i.
    DATA: new_col TYPE i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_row> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <cell> TYPE any.

    n = LINES( grid ).

    IF LINES( path ) = k.
      IF min_path IS INITIAL.
        min_path = path.
      ELSE.
        IF is_lexicographically_smaller( path, min_path ) = abap_true.
          min_path = path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid>.
    ASSIGN <grid>[ row + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.
    ASSIGN <grid_row>[ col + 1 ] TO <cell>.

    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = -1 col = 0 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 1 col = 0 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 0 col = -1 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 0 col = 1 ) TO directions.

    LOOP AT directions INTO direction.
      new_row = row + direction-row.
      new_col = col + direction-col.

      IF new_row >= 0 AND new_row < n AND new_col >= 0 AND new_col < n.
        ASSIGN <grid>[ new_row + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.
        ASSIGN <grid_row>[ new_col + 1 ] TO <cell>.

        new_path = path.
        APPEND <cell> TO new_path.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = new_row
            col = new_col
            k = k
            path = new_path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_lexicographically_smaller.
    DATA: idx TYPE i.
    DATA: val1 TYPE i.
    DATA: val2 TYPE i.
    DATA: len1 TYPE i.
    DATA: len2 TYPE i.

    len1 = LINES( path1 ).
    len2 = LINES( path2 ).

    DO LEAST( len1, len2 ) TIMES.
      idx = sy-index.
      val1 = path1[ idx ].
      val2 = path2[ idx ].

      IF val1 < val2.
        result = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      IF val1 > val2.
        result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF len1 < len2.
      result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE TABLE OF TABLE OF i
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: row TYPE i.
    DATA: col TYPE i.
    DATA: min_path TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: current_path TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: visited TYPE TABLE OF TABLE OF abap_bool.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: next_row TYPE i.
    DATA: next_col TYPE i.
    DATA: depth TYPE i.
    DATA: idx TYPE i.
    DATA: is_better TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA: directions TYPE TABLE OF TABLE OF i.
    DATA: stack TYPE TABLE OF TABLE OF i.
    DATA: stack_entry TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: local_current_path TYPE TABLE OF i.

    n = LINES( grid ).

    DO n TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO visited ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<visit_row>).
      DO n TIMES.
        APPEND abap_false TO <visit_row>.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO directions ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<dir>).
    APPEND 0 TO <dir>.
    APPEND 1 TO <dir>.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO directions ASSIGNING <dir>.
    APPEND 0 TO <dir>.
    APPEND -1 TO <dir>.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO directions ASSIGNING <dir>.
    APPEND 1 TO <dir>.
    APPEND 0 TO <dir>.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO directions ASSIGNING <dir>.
    APPEND -1 TO <dir>.
    APPEND 0 TO <dir>.

    DO n TIMES.
      row = sy-index - 1.
      DO n TIMES.
        col = sy-index - 1.
        CLEAR current_path.
        APPEND grid[ row + 1 ][ col + 1 ] TO current_path.
        ASSIGN visited[ row + 1 ][ col + 1 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<vis>).
        <vis> = abap_true.

        CLEAR stack.
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO stack ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<entry>).
        APPEND row TO <entry>.
        APPEND col TO <entry>.
        APPEND 1 TO <entry>.

        WHILE LINES( stack ) > 0.
          ASSIGN stack[ LINES( stack ) ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<current>).
          next_row = <current>[ 1 ].
          next_col = <current>[ 2 ].
          depth = <current>[ 3 ].

          DELETE stack INDEX LINES( stack ).

          IF depth = k.
            IF LINES( min_path ) = 0.
              min_path = current_path.
            ELSE.
              is_better = abap_false.
              DO LINES( current_path ) TIMES.
                i = sy-index.
                IF current_path[ i ] < min_path[ i ].
                  is_better = abap_true.
                  EXIT.
                ELSEIF current_path[ i ] > min_path[ i ].
                  EXIT.
                ENDIF.
              ENDDO.
              IF is_better = abap_true.
                min_path = current_path.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            DO 4 TIMES.
              idx = sy-index.
              next_row = <current>[ 1 ] + directions[ idx ][ 1 ].
              next_col = <current>[ 2 ] + directions[ idx ][ 2 ].

              IF next_row >= 0 AND next_row < n AND next_col >= 0 AND next_col < n.
                ASSIGN visited[ next_row + 1 ][ next_col + 1 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<vis2>).
                IF <vis2> = abap_false.
                  <vis2> = abap_true.
                  APPEND grid[ next_row + 1 ][ next_col + 1 ] TO current_path.
                  APPEND INITIAL LINE TO stack ASSIGNING <entry>.
                  APPEND next_row TO <entry>.
                  APPEND next_col TO <entry>.
                  APPEND depth + 1 TO <entry>.
                ENDIF.
              ENDIF.
            ENDDO.
          ENDIF.
        ENDWHILE.

        <vis> = abap_false.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    result = min_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE ANY TABLE
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF cell_pos,
             row TYPE i,
             col TYPE i,
           END OF cell_pos.

    CLASS-METHODS find_start_cell
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(start_pos) TYPE cell_pos.

    CLASS-METHODS dfs
      IMPORTING
        grid       TYPE ANY TABLE
        row        TYPE i
        col        TYPE i
        k          TYPE i
        path       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY
        visited    TYPE ANY TABLE
      CHANGING
        min_path   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_move
      IMPORTING
        grid    TYPE ANY TABLE
        row     TYPE i
        col     TYPE i
        visited TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(valid) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: start_pos TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: path TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: visited TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF STANDARD TABLE OF abap_bool WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: row_visited TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF abap_bool WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: grid_val TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_row> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_cell> TYPE i.

    start_pos = find_start_cell( grid ).

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid_table>.
    n = LINES( <grid_table> ).

    DO n TIMES.
      CLEAR row_visited.
      DO n TIMES.
        APPEND abap_false TO row_visited.
      ENDDO.
      APPEND row_visited TO visited.
    ENDDO.

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid_table>.
    ASSIGN <grid_table>[ start_pos-row + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.
    ASSIGN <grid_row>[ start_pos-col + 1 ] TO <grid_cell>.
    APPEND <grid_cell> TO path.

    visited[ start_pos-row + 1 ][ start_pos-col + 1 ] = abap_true.

    dfs(
      EXPORTING
        grid = grid
        row = start_pos-row
        col = start_pos-col
        k = k
        path = path
        visited = visited
      CHANGING
        min_path = result
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_start_cell.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: min_val TYPE i VALUE 999999.
    DATA: grid_val TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_row> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_cell> TYPE i.

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid_table>.
    n = LINES( <grid_table> ).
    start_pos-row = 0.
    start_pos-col = 0.

    DO n TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      ASSIGN <grid_table>[ i + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.
      DO n TIMES.
        j = sy-index - 1.
        ASSIGN <grid_row>[ j + 1 ] TO <grid_cell>.
        grid_val = <grid_cell>.
        IF grid_val < min_val.
          min_val = grid_val.
          start_pos-row = i.
          start_pos-col = j.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: current_path TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: new_visited TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF STANDARD TABLE OF abap_bool WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: directions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cell_pos WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: dir TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: new_row TYPE i.
    DATA: new_col TYPE i.
    DATA: idx TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_val TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_row> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_cell> TYPE i.

    current_path = path.

    IF LINES( current_path ) = k.
      IF LINES( min_path ) = 0.
        min_path = current_path.
      ELSE.
        IF current_path < min_path.
          min_path = current_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = -1 col = 0 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 1 col = 0 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 0 col = -1 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 0 col = 1 ) TO directions.

    LOOP AT directions INTO dir.
      new_row = row + dir-row.
      new_col = col + dir-col.

      new_visited = visited.

      IF is_valid_move( grid = grid row = new_row col = new_col visited = visited ).
        new_visited[ new_row + 1 ][ new_col + 1 ] = abap_true.

        ASSIGN grid TO <grid_table>.
        ASSIGN <grid_table>[ new_row + 1 ] TO <grid_row>.
        ASSIGN <grid_row>[ new_col + 1 ] TO <grid_cell>.
        grid_val = <grid_cell>.
        APPEND grid_val TO current_path.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = new_row
            col = new_col
            k = k
            path = current_path
            visited = new_visited
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).

        DELETE current_path INDEX LINES( current_path ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_valid_move.
    DATA: n TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid_table>.
    n = LINES( <grid_table> ).
    valid = abap_false.

    IF row >= 0 AND row < n AND col >= 0 AND col < n.
      IF visited[ row + 1 ][ col + 1 ] = abap_false.
        valid = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_grid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: int_table TYPE TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE ANY TABLE
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE int_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS dfs
      IMPORTING
        grid        TYPE ANY TABLE
        row         TYPE i
        col         TYPE i
        k           TYPE i
        current_path TYPE int_table
      CHANGING
        min_path    TYPE int_table.

    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_position
      IMPORTING
        row TYPE i
        col TYPE i
        n   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(valid) TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS-METHODS compare_paths
      IMPORTING
        path1 TYPE int_table
        path2 TYPE int_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_grid IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: current_path TYPE int_table.
    DATA: min_path_local TYPE int_table.
    DATA: grid_line TYPE int_table.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: grid_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid_line> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <cell> TYPE i.

    grid_ref = REF #( grid ).
    ASSIGN grid_ref->* TO <grid>.

    n = LINES( <grid> ).

    CLEAR result.
    CLEAR min_path_local.

    DO n TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      READ TABLE <grid> INTO grid_line INDEX sy-index.
      DO n TIMES.
        j = sy-index - 1.
        READ TABLE grid_line INTO cell_value INDEX sy-index.
        CLEAR current_path.
        APPEND cell_value TO current_path.
        CALL METHOD dfs
          EXPORTING
            grid         = grid
            row          = i
            col          = j
            k            = k
            current_path = current_path
          CHANGING
            min_path     = min_path_local.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    result = min_path_local.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: path_length TYPE i.
    DATA: directions TYPE TABLE OF int_table WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: direction TYPE int_table.
    DATA: dir_row TYPE i.
    DATA: dir_col TYPE i.
    DATA: next_row TYPE i.
    DATA: next_col TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_line TYPE int_table.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: new_path TYPE int_table.
    DATA: comparison TYPE i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <grid> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN grid TO <grid>.

    n = LINES( <grid> ).
    path_length = LINES( current_path ).

    IF path_length = k.
      IF LINES( min_path ) = 0.
        min_path = current_path.
      ELSE.
        comparison = compare_paths( current_path, min_path ).
        IF comparison < 0.
          min_path = current_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT VALUE #( ( 0 ) ( 1 ) ) INTO TABLE directions.
    INSERT VALUE #( ( 0 ) ( -1 ) ) INTO TABLE directions.
    INSERT VALUE #( ( 1 ) ( 0 ) ) INTO TABLE directions.
    INSERT VALUE #( ( -1 ) ( 0 ) ) INTO TABLE directions.

    LOOP AT directions INTO direction.
      READ TABLE direction INTO dir_row INDEX 1.
      READ TABLE direction INTO dir_col INDEX 2.

      next_row = row + dir_row.
      next_col = col + dir_col.

      IF is_valid_position( next_row, next_col, n ) = abap_true.
        READ TABLE <grid> INTO grid_line INDEX next_row + 1.
        READ TABLE grid_line INTO cell_value INDEX next_col + 1.

        new_path = current_path.
        APPEND cell_value TO new_path.

        CALL METHOD dfs
          EXPORTING
            grid         = grid
            row          = next_row
            col          = next_col
            k            = k
            current_path = new_path
          CHANGING
            min_path     = min_path.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_valid_position.
    valid = abap_false.
    IF row >= 0 AND row < n AND col >= 0 AND col < n.
      valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_paths.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: len TYPE i.
    DATA: val1 TYPE i.
    DATA: val2 TYPE i.

    result = 0.
    len = LINES( path1 ).

    DO len TIMES.
      i = sy-index.
      READ TABLE path1 INTO val1 INDEX i.
      READ TABLE path2 INTO val2 INDEX i.

      IF val1 < val2.
        result = -1.
        RETURN.
      ELSEIF val1 > val2.
        result = 1.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: path_table TYPE TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: grid_table TYPE TABLE OF TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE grid_table
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE path_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS dfs
      IMPORTING
        grid        TYPE grid_table
        row         TYPE i
        col         TYPE i
        k           TYPE i
        current_path TYPE path_table
      CHANGING
        min_path    TYPE path_table.

    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_position
      IMPORTING
        row TYPE i
        col TYPE i
        n   TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(valid) TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS-METHODS compare_paths
      IMPORTING
        path1 TYPE path_table
        path2 TYPE path_table
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: current_path TYPE path_table.
    DATA: min_path TYPE path_table.
    DATA: grid_copy TYPE grid_table.
    DATA: grid_line TYPE TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.

    grid_copy = grid.
    n = LINES( grid_copy ).

    DO n TIMES.
      i = sy-index.
      DO n TIMES.
        j = sy-index.
        CLEAR current_path.
        grid_line = grid_copy[ i ].
        cell_value = grid_line[ j ].
        APPEND cell_value TO current_path.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = i
            col = j
            k = k
            current_path = current_path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    result = min_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: path_length TYPE i.
    DATA: comparison TYPE i.
    DATA: new_path TYPE path_table.
    DATA: new_row TYPE i.
    DATA: new_col TYPE i.
    DATA: directions TYPE TABLE OF TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: direction TYPE TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_copy TYPE grid_table.
    DATA: grid_line TYPE TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.

    path_length = LINES( current_path ).

    IF path_length = k.
      IF LINES( min_path ) = 0.
        min_path = current_path.
      ELSE.
        comparison = compare_paths( current_path, min_path ).
        IF comparison < 0.
          min_path = current_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    grid_copy = grid.
    n = LINES( grid_copy ).

    INSERT VALUE #( 1 0 ) INTO TABLE directions.
    INSERT VALUE #( -1 0 ) INTO TABLE directions.
    INSERT VALUE #( 0 1 ) INTO TABLE directions.
    INSERT VALUE #( 0 -1 ) INTO TABLE directions.

    LOOP AT directions INTO direction.
      new_row = row + direction[ 1 ].
      new_col = col + direction[ 2 ].

      IF is_valid_position( new_row, new_col, n ) = abap_true.
        new_path = current_path.
        grid_line = grid_copy[ new_row ].
        cell_value = grid_line[ new_col ].
        APPEND cell_value TO new_path.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = new_row
            col = new_col
            k = k
            current_path = new_path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_valid_position.
    valid = abap_false.
    IF row >= 1 AND row <= n AND col >= 1 AND col <= n.
      valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_paths.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: len TYPE i.

    len = LINES( path1 ).
    result = 0.

    DO len TIMES.
      i = sy-index.
      IF path1[ i ] < path2[ i ].
        result = -1.
        RETURN.
      ELSEIF path1[ i ] > path2[ i ].
        result = 1.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_path TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    TYPES: tt_grid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_path WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE tt_grid
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE tt_path.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF cell_pos,
             row TYPE i,
             col TYPE i,
           END OF cell_pos.

    CLASS-METHODS find_start_cell
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE tt_grid
      RETURNING VALUE(start_pos) TYPE cell_pos.

    CLASS-METHODS dfs
      IMPORTING
        grid         TYPE tt_grid
        row          TYPE i
        col          TYPE i
        k            TYPE i
        current_path TYPE tt_path
      CHANGING
        min_path     TYPE tt_path.

    CLASS-METHODS is_lexicographically_smaller
      IMPORTING
        path1 TYPE tt_path
        path2 TYPE tt_path
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: start_pos TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: min_path TYPE tt_path.
    DATA: current_path TYPE tt_path.

    start_pos = find_start_cell( grid ).

    APPEND start_pos-row TO current_path.

    dfs(
      EXPORTING
        grid = grid
        row = start_pos-row
        col = start_pos-col
        k = k
        current_path = current_path
      CHANGING
        min_path = min_path
    ).

    result = min_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_start_cell.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_row TYPE tt_path.

    n = LINES( grid ).
    start_pos-row = 0.
    start_pos-col = 0.

    DO n TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      grid_row = grid[ i + 1 ].
      DO n TIMES.
        j = sy-index - 1.
        cell_value = grid_row[ j + 1 ].
        IF cell_value = 1.
          start_pos-row = i.
          start_pos-col = j.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: current_value TYPE i.
    DATA: new_path TYPE tt_path.
    DATA: directions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cell_pos WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA: dir TYPE cell_pos.
    DATA: new_row TYPE i.
    DATA: new_col TYPE i.
    DATA: path_length TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_row TYPE tt_path.
    DATA: is_smaller TYPE abap_bool.

    n = LINES( grid ).
    path_length = LINES( current_path ).

    IF path_length = k.
      IF min_path IS INITIAL.
        min_path = current_path.
      ELSE.
        is_smaller = is_lexicographically_smaller( current_path, min_path ).
        IF is_smaller EQ abap_true.
          min_path = current_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = -1 col = 0 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 1 col = 0 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 0 col = -1 ) TO directions.
    APPEND VALUE cell_pos( row = 0 col = 1 ) TO directions.

    LOOP AT directions INTO dir.
      new_row = row + dir-row.
      new_col = col + dir-col.

      IF new_row >= 0 AND new_row < n AND new_col >= 0 AND new_col < n.
        grid_row = grid[ new_row + 1 ].
        current_value = grid_row[ new_col + 1 ].

        new_path = current_path.
        APPEND current_value TO new_path.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = new_row
            col = new_col
            k = k
            current_path = new_path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_lexicographically_smaller.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: len TYPE i.
    DATA: path1_val TYPE i.
    DATA: path2_val TYPE i.

    len = LINES( path1 ).
    IF LINES( path2 ) < len.
      len = LINES( path2 ).
    ENDIF.

    result = abap_false.

    DO len TIMES.
      i = sy-index.
      path1_val = path1[ i ].
      path2_val = path2[ i ].
      IF path1_val < path2_val.
        result = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ELSEIF path1_val > path2_val.
        result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_grid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: int_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE int_table
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE int_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS dfs
      IMPORTING
        grid        TYPE int_table
        row         TYPE i
        col         TYPE i
        k           TYPE i
        current_path TYPE int_table
      CHANGING
        min_path    TYPE int_table.

    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_position
      IMPORTING
        row TYPE i
        col TYPE i
        n   TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(valid) TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS-METHODS compare_paths
      IMPORTING
        path1 TYPE int_table
        path2 TYPE int_table
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path_grid IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: min_path TYPE int_table.
    DATA: current_path TYPE int_table.
    DATA: row TYPE i.
    DATA: col TYPE i.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_line TYPE int_table.
    DATA: idx_row TYPE i.
    DATA: idx_col TYPE i.

    n = LINES( grid ).

    DO n TIMES.
      row = sy-index - 1.
      idx_row = row + 1.
      READ TABLE grid INDEX idx_row INTO grid_line.

      DO n TIMES.
        col = sy-index - 1.
        idx_col = col + 1.
        READ TABLE grid_line INDEX idx_col INTO cell_value.

        CLEAR current_path.
        APPEND cell_value TO current_path.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = row
            col = col
            k = k
            current_path = current_path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    result = min_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: path_length TYPE i.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: next_row TYPE i.
    DATA: next_col TYPE i.
    DATA: direction_row TYPE i.
    DATA: direction_col TYPE i.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: new_path TYPE int_table.
    DATA: cmp_result TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_line TYPE int_table.
    DATA: idx_row TYPE i.
    DATA: idx_col TYPE i.

    path_length = LINES( current_path ).

    IF path_length = k.
      IF LINES( min_path ) = 0.
        min_path = current_path.
      ELSE.
        cmp_result = compare_paths( current_path, min_path ).
        IF cmp_result < 0.
          min_path = current_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    n = LINES( grid ).

    DATA: directions TYPE TABLE OF TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT TABLE directions FROM TABLE VALUE #(
      ( VALUE #( ( 0 ) ( 1 ) ) )
      ( VALUE #( ( 0 ) ( -1 ) ) )
      ( VALUE #( ( 1 ) ( 0 ) ) )
      ( VALUE #( ( -1 ) ( 0 ) ) )
    ).

    LOOP AT directions INTO DATA(direction).
      direction_row = direction[ 1 ].
      direction_col = direction[ 2 ].

      next_row = row + direction_row.
      next_col = col + direction_col.

      IF is_valid_position( next_row, next_col, n ) = abap_true.
        idx_row = next_row + 1.
        READ TABLE grid INDEX idx_row INTO grid_line.
        idx_col = next_col + 1.
        READ TABLE grid_line INDEX idx_col INTO cell_value.

        new_path = current_path.
        APPEND cell_value TO new_path.

        IF LINES( min_path ) > 0.
          cmp_result = compare_paths( new_path, min_path ).
          IF cmp_result >= 0.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid
            row = next_row
            col = next_col
            k = k
            current_path = new_path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_valid_position.
    IF row >= 0 AND row < n AND col >= 0 AND col < n.
      valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_paths.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: len TYPE i.
    DATA: val1 TYPE i.
    DATA: val2 TYPE i.

    len = LINES( path1 ).
    IF LINES( path2 ) < len.
      len = LINES( path2 ).
    ENDIF.

    DO len TIMES.
      i = sy-index.
      READ TABLE path1 INDEX i INTO val1.
      READ TABLE path2 INDEX i INTO val2.

      IF val1 < val2.
        result = -1.
        RETURN.
      ELSEIF val1 > val2.
        result = 1.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    result = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: int_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    TYPES: grid_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF int_table WITH NON-UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS find_min_path
      IMPORTING
        grid TYPE ANY TABLE
        k    TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE int_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS dfs
      IMPORTING
        grid       TYPE grid_table
        row        TYPE i
        col        TYPE i
        k          TYPE i
        path       TYPE int_table
      CHANGING
        min_path   TYPE int_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_min_path IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_min_path.
    DATA: min_path TYPE int_table.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: row_idx TYPE i.
    DATA: col_idx TYPE i.
    DATA: path TYPE int_table.
    DATA: grid_line TYPE int_table.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: grid_typed TYPE grid_table.

    TRY.
      grid_typed = grid.
    CATCH cx_root.
      RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    n = LINES( grid_typed ).

    IF n = 0 OR k = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    row_idx = 1.
    LOOP AT grid_typed INTO grid_line.
      col_idx = 1.
      LOOP AT grid_line INTO cell_value.
        CLEAR path.
        APPEND cell_value TO path.
        dfs(
          EXPORTING
            grid = grid_typed
            row = row_idx - 1
            col = col_idx - 1
            k = k
            path = path
          CHANGING
            min_path = min_path
        ).
        col_idx = col_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      row_idx = row_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    result = min_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dfs.
    DATA: n TYPE i.
    DATA: next_row TYPE i.
    DATA: next_col TYPE i.
    DATA: new_path TYPE int_table.
    DATA: grid_line TYPE int_table.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE i.
    DATA: is_better TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA: path_val TYPE i.
    DATA: min_val TYPE i.
    DATA: idx TYPE i.
    DATA: dr TYPE i.
    DATA: dc TYPE i.
    DATA: dir_idx TYPE i.

    n = LINES( grid ).

    IF LINES( path ) = k.
      IF LINES( min_path ) = 0.
        min_path = path.
      ELSE.
        is_better = abap_true.
        DO k TIMES.
          idx = sy-index.
          READ TABLE path INTO path_val INDEX idx.
          READ TABLE min_path INTO min_val INDEX idx.
          IF path_val < min_val.
            is_better = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ELSEIF path_val > min_val.
            is_better = abap_false.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.
        IF is_better = abap_true.
          min_path = path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    dir_idx = 1.
    WHILE dir_idx <= 4.
      CASE dir_idx.
        WHEN 1.
          dr = 0.
          dc = 1.
        WHEN 2.
          dr = 0.
          dc = -1.
        WHEN 3.
          dr = 1.
          dc = 0.
        WHEN 4.
          dr = -1.
          dc = 0.
      ENDCASE.

      next_row = row + dr.
      next_col = col + dc.

      IF next_row >= 0 AND next_row < n AND next_col >= 0 AND next_col < n.
        READ TABLE grid INTO grid_line INDEX next_row + 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          READ TABLE grid_line INTO cell_value INDEX next_col + 1.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            new_path = path.
            APPEND cell_value TO new_path.

            dfs(
              EXPORTING
                grid = grid
                row = next_row
                col = next_col
                k = k
                path = new_path
              CHANGING
                min_path = min_path
            ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      dir_idx = dir_idx + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_max_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_bucket_lowerings
      IMPORTING
        grid     TYPE ANY TABLE
        capacity TYPE INT4
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE INT4.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_max_fill IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_bucket_lowerings.
    DATA: lv_total_water TYPE INT4 VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_row_water TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_cell_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_grid_size TYPE INT4.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_grid_line> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_cell> TYPE INT4.

    LOOP AT grid ASSIGNING <lv_grid_line>.
      lv_row_water = 0.
      LOOP AT <lv_grid_line> ASSIGNING <lv_cell>.
        IF <lv_cell> = 1.
          lv_row_water = lv_row_water + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_total_water = lv_total_water + lv_row_water.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF capacity > 0.
      result = CEIL( lv_total_water / capacity ).
    ELSE.
      result = 0.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_max_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS max_fill IMPORTING grid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF STANDARD TABLE OF INT4 capacity TYPE INT4 RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE INT4.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_max_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD max_fill.
    DATA: total_water TYPE INT4 VALUE 0.
    DATA: current_row TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA: water_units TYPE INT4.

    LOOP AT grid INTO current_row.
      water_units = 0.
      LOOP AT current_row INTO DATA(cell).
        IF cell = 1.
          water_units = water_units + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      total_water = total_water + water_units.
    ENDLOOP.

    result = CEIL( CAST f( total_water ) / CAST f( capacity ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_max_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_bucket_lowerings
      IMPORTING
        grid     TYPE ANY TABLE
        capacity TYPE INT4
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE INT4.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_max_fill IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_bucket_lowerings.
    DATA: water_count TYPE INT4 VALUE 0.
    DATA: water_units TYPE INT4.
    DATA: water_float TYPE f.
    DATA: capacity_float TYPE f.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <row> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <cell> TYPE i.

    LOOP AT grid ASSIGNING <row>.
      water_units = 0.
      LOOP AT <row> ASSIGNING <cell>.
        water_units = water_units + <cell>.
      ENDLOOP.
      water_count = water_count + water_units.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF water_count = 0.
      result = 0.
    ELSE.
      water_float = water_count.
      capacity_float = capacity.
      result = CEIL( water_float / capacity_float ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_max_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_bucket_lowerings
      IMPORTING
        grid     TYPE ANY TABLE
        capacity TYPE INT4
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE INT4.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_max_fill IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_bucket_lowerings.
    DATA: water_count TYPE INT4 VALUE 0.
    DATA: row_water TYPE INT4.
    DATA: cell TYPE INT4.
    DATA: water_float TYPE f.
    DATA: capacity_float TYPE f.
    DATA: quotient TYPE f.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <row> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <cell> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT grid ASSIGNING <row>.
      row_water = 0.

        IF <cell> = 1.

CLASS z_max_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bucket_lowerings.
    DATA: total_water TYPE INT4.
    DATA: water_units TYPE INT4.

    total_water = 0.

    LOOP AT grid ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>).
      water_units = 0.

          IF <cell> = 1.

      water_units = 0.
      LOOP AT current_row INTO cell.

      ENDLOOP.
      total_water = total_water + water_units.
    ENDLOOP.

    result = CEIL( CAST f( total_water ) / CAST f( capacity ) ).

             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto TYPE spfli-cityto,
             revenue TYPE p LENGTH 15 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_route_revenue.

    TYPES ty_route_revenue_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_route_revenue WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY cityfrom cityto.

CLASS zcl_route_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_route_profitability.
    DATA lt_spfli TYPE TABLE OF spfli.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_joined TYPE ty_route_revenue_table.
    DATA ls_route_revenue TYPE ty_route_revenue.
    DATA lt_route_totals TYPE TABLE OF ty_route_revenue.

    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_spfli INTO DATA(ls_spfli).
      DATA(lv_total_revenue) = 0.

      LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight)
        WHERE carrid = ls_spfli-carrid
          AND connid = ls_spfli-connid.
        lv_total_revenue = lv_total_revenue + ( ls_sflight-price * ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_total_revenue > 0.
        ls_route_revenue-cityfrom = ls_spfli-cityfrom.
        ls_route_revenue-cityto = ls_spfli-cityto.
        ls_route_revenue-revenue = lv_total_revenue.
        APPEND ls_route_revenue TO lt_joined.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_joined BY revenue DESCENDING.

    rt_route_revenue = lt_joined.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_management_chain IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_management_chain.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_org_structure,
             employee_id TYPE char20,
             supervisor_id TYPE char20,
           END OF ty_org_structure.

    DATA: lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF ty_org_structure WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lv_current_employee TYPE char20.
    DATA: ls_org_record TYPE ty_org_structure.
    DATA: lv_max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 1000.
    DATA: lv_iteration_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    supervisor_ids = VALUE stringtab( ).

    TRY.
      SELECT employee_id, supervisor_id 
        FROM zorg_structure 
        INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.
    CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
      CLEAR lt_org_structure.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_employee = employee_id.

    WHILE lv_iteration_count < lv_max_iterations.
      lv_iteration_count = lv_iteration_count + 1.

      READ TABLE lt_org_structure INTO ls_org_record
        WITH KEY employee_id = lv_current_employee.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_org_record-supervisor_id IS INITIAL OR
         ls_org_record-supervisor_id = lv_current_employee.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND ls_org_record-supervisor_id TO supervisor_ids.

      lv_current_employee = ls_org_record-supervisor_id.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_rounded_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS compute
      IMPORTING
        n TYPE i
        m TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_rounded_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compute.
    DATA lv_avg TYPE i.
    DATA lv_sum TYPE i.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_binary TYPE string.
    DATA lv_temp TYPE i.

    IF n > m.
      result = '-1'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_count = m - n + 1.
    lv_sum = ( n + m ) * lv_count / 2.
    lv_avg = ROUND( CAST f( lv_sum ) / CAST f( lv_count ) ).

    IF lv_avg = 0.
      result = '0b0'.
    ELSE.
      lv_temp = lv_avg.
      lv_binary = ''.
      WHILE lv_temp > 0.
        IF lv_temp MOD 2 = 0.
          lv_binary = '0' && lv_binary.
        ELSE.
          lv_binary = '1' && lv_binary.
        ENDIF.
        lv_temp = lv_temp / 2.
      ENDWHILE.
      result = '0b' && lv_binary.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_rounded_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS compute IMPORTING n TYPE i m TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_rounded_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compute.
    DATA: avg TYPE i.
    DATA: sum TYPE i.
    DATA: count TYPE i.
    DATA: binary_str TYPE string.
    DATA: remainder TYPE i.
    DATA: quotient TYPE i.

    IF n > m.
      result = '-1'.
      RETURN.

    CLASS METHODS select_words
      IMPORTING
        s TYPE string
        n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF string.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_select_words IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD select_words.
    DATA words TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA word TYPE string.
    DATA consonant_count TYPE i.
    DATA char TYPE c.
    DATA i TYPE i.
    DATA len TYPE i.

    CLEAR result.

    IF s IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT s BY space INTO TABLE words.

    LOOP AT words INTO word.
      consonant_count = 0.
      len = strlen( word ).

      DO len TIMES.
        i = sy-index - 1.
        char = word+i(1).

        CASE char.
          WHEN 'b' OR 'c' OR 'd' OR 'f' OR 'g' OR 'h' OR 'j' OR 'k' OR 'l' OR 'm'
            OR 'n' OR 'p' OR 'q' OR 'r' OR 's' OR 't' OR 'v' OR 'w' OR 'x' OR 'y' OR 'z'
            OR 'B' OR 'C' OR 'D' OR 'F' OR 'G' OR 'H' OR 'J' OR 'K' OR 'L' OR 'M'
            OR 'N' OR 'P' OR 'Q' OR 'R' OR 'S' OR 'T' OR 'V' OR 'W' OR 'X' OR 'Y' OR 'Z'.
            consonant_count = consonant_count + 1.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDDO.

      IF consonant_count = n.
        APPEND word TO result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS count_ones.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_array.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_item,
             value TYPE INT4,
             ones TYPE INT4,
           END OF ts_item.

    DATA: arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA: result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA: lt_with_counts TYPE TABLE OF ts_item.
    DATA: ls_item TYPE ts_item.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE INT4.

    CLEAR lt_with_counts.
    LOOP AT arr INTO lv_value.
      ls_item-value = lv_value.
      ls_item-ones = count_ones( lv_value ).
      APPEND ls_item TO lt_with_counts.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_with_counts BY ones ASCENDING value ASCENDING.

    CLEAR result.
    LOOP AT lt_with_counts INTO ls_item.
      APPEND ls_item-value TO result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD count_ones.
    DATA: num TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_num TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_ones TYPE INT4 VALUE 0.

    lv_num = num.

    IF lv_num < 0.
      lv_num = lv_num * -1.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_num > 0.
      IF lv_num MOD 2 = 1.
        lv_ones = lv_ones + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_num = lv_num / 2.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array IMPORTING arr TYPE TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    DATA: lt_sorted TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: lv_ones_i TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_ones_j TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_value_i TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_value_j TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE i.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_size TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_swap TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_num TYPE i.

    lt_sorted = arr.
    lv_size = LINES( lt_sorted ).

    IF lv_size <= 1.
      result = lt_sorted.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO lv_size - 1 TIMES.
      i = sy-index.
      DO lv_size - i TIMES.
        j = sy-index.

        READ TABLE lt_sorted INDEX i INTO lv_value_i.
        READ TABLE lt_sorted INDEX j INTO lv_value_j.

        lv_ones_i = 0.
        lv_num = lv_value_i.
        IF lv_num < 0.
          lv_num = lv_num * -1.
        ENDIF.
        WHILE lv_num > 0.
          IF lv_num MOD 2 = 1.
            lv_ones_i = lv_ones_i + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_num = lv_num / 2.
        ENDWHILE.

        lv_ones_j = 0.
        lv_num = lv_value_j.
        IF lv_num < 0.
          lv_num = lv_num * -1.
        ENDIF.
        WHILE lv_num > 0.
          IF lv_num MOD 2 = 1.
            lv_ones_j = lv_ones_j + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_num = lv_num / 2.
        ENDWHILE.

        lv_swap = 0.

        IF lv_ones_i > lv_ones_j.
          lv_swap = 1.
        ELSEIF lv_ones_i = lv_ones_j.
          IF lv_value_i > lv_value_j.
            lv_swap = 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        IF lv_swap = 1.
          lv_temp = lv_value_i.
          MODIFY lt_sorted INDEX i FROM lv_value_j.
          MODIFY lt_sorted INDEX j FROM lv_temp.
        ENDIF.

      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    result = lt_sorted.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS: sort_array
      IMPORTING
        arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS: count_ones
      IMPORTING
        num TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(count) TYPE i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    DATA: ls_item TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_ones_count TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_min_ones TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_min_value TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_min_index TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_j TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_arr_size TYPE i.
    DATA: lt_ones_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_temp_ones TYPE i.

    result = arr.
    lv_arr_size = LINES( result ).

    IF lv_arr_size <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT result INTO ls_item.
      lv_ones_count = count_ones( ls_item ).
      APPEND lv_ones_count TO lt_ones_count.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_i = 1.
    WHILE lv_i < lv_arr_size.
      lv_j = lv_i + 1.
      lv_min_index = lv_i.
      lv_min_ones = lt_ones_count[ lv_i ].
      lv_min_value = result[ lv_i ].

      WHILE lv_j <= lv_arr_size.
        IF lt_ones_count[ lv_j ] < lv_min_ones OR
           ( lt_ones_count[ lv_j ] = lv_min_ones AND result[ lv_j ] < lv_min_value ).
          lv_min_index = lv_j.
          lv_min_ones = lt_ones_count[ lv_j ].
          lv_min_value = result[ lv_j ].
        ENDIF.
        lv_j = lv_j + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_min_index <> lv_i.
        lv_temp = result[ lv_i ].
        result[ lv_i ] = result[ lv_min_index ].
        result[ lv_min_index ] = lv_temp.

        lv_temp_ones = lt_ones_count[ lv_i ].
        lt_ones_count[ lv_i ] = lt_ones_count[ lv_min_index ].
        lt_ones_count[ lv_min_index ] = lv_temp_ones.
      ENDIF.

      lv_i = lv_i + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD count_ones.
    DATA: lv_num TYPE i.

    lv_num = num.
    count = 0.

    IF lv_num < 0.
      lv_num = lv_num * -1.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_num > 0.
      IF lv_num MOD 2 = 1.
        count = count + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_num = lv_num / 2.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array
      IMPORTING arr TYPE TABLE OF i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    DATA: lt_sorted TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: lv_ones TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_bit_count TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_j TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_n TYPE i.

    lt_sorted = arr.
    DESCRIBE TABLE lt_sorted LINES lv_n.

    IF lv_n = 0.
      result = lt_sorted.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO lv_n TIMES.
      lv_i = sy-index - 1.
      DO lv_n - lv_i - 1 TIMES.
        lv_j = lv_i + sy-index.

        READ TABLE lt_sorted INDEX lv_i + 1 INTO lv_value.
        lv_bit_count = 0.
        lv_temp = lv_value.
        IF lv_temp < 0.
          lv_temp = lv_temp * -1.
        ENDIF.
        WHILE lv_temp > 0.
          IF lv_temp MOD 2 = 1.
            lv_bit_count = lv_bit_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_temp = lv_temp / 2.
        ENDWHILE.

        READ TABLE lt_sorted INDEX lv_j + 1 INTO lv_value.
        lv_ones = 0.
        lv_temp = lv_value.
        IF lv_temp < 0.
          lv_temp = lv_temp * -1.
        ENDIF.
        WHILE lv_temp > 0.
          IF lv_temp MOD 2 = 1.
            lv_ones = lv_ones + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_temp = lv_temp / 2.
        ENDWHILE.

        IF lv_bit_count > lv_ones.
          READ TABLE lt_sorted INDEX lv_i + 1 INTO lv_temp.
          READ TABLE lt_sorted INDEX lv_j + 1 INTO lv_value.
          MODIFY lt_sorted INDEX lv_i + 1 FROM lv_value.
          MODIFY lt_sorted INDEX lv_j + 1 FROM lv_temp.
        ELSEIF lv_bit_count = lv_ones.
          READ TABLE lt_sorted INDEX lv_i + 1 INTO lv_temp.
          READ TABLE lt_sorted INDEX lv_j + 1 INTO lv_value.
          IF lv_temp > lv_value.
            MODIFY lt_sorted INDEX lv_i + 1 FROM lv_value.
            MODIFY lt_sorted INDEX lv_j + 1 FROM lv_temp.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    result = lt_sorted.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array
      IMPORTING arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4 .

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    DATA: lt_sorted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA: lv_ones_count TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_current_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lt_ones_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF STRUCTURE BEGIN OF ones_map.
                        ones_count TYPE i.
                        decimal_value TYPE INT4.
                      END OF ones_map.
    DATA: ls_ones_entry LIKE LINE OF lt_ones_map.

    lt_sorted = arr.

    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO lv_current_value.
      lv_ones_count = 0.
      lv_index = lv_current_value.

      IF lv_index < 0.
        lv_index = lv_index * -1.
      ENDIF.

      WHILE lv_index > 0.
        IF lv_index MOD 2 = 1.
          lv_ones_count = lv_ones_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
        lv_index = lv_index / 2.
      ENDWHILE.

      ls_ones_entry-ones_count = lv_ones_count.
      ls_ones_entry-decimal_value = lv_current_value.
      APPEND ls_ones_entry TO lt_ones_map.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_ones_map BY ones_count ASCENDING decimal_value ASCENDING.

    CLEAR result.
    LOOP AT lt_ones_map INTO ls_ones_entry.
      APPEND ls_ones_entry-decimal_value TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array IMPORTING arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4 RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_ones_map,
             value TYPE INT4,
             ones_count TYPE INT4,
           END OF ts_ones_map.

    DATA lt_ones_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_ones_map.
    DATA ls_ones_map TYPE ts_ones_map.
    DATA lv_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA lv_ones_count TYPE INT4.
    DATA lv_abs_value TYPE INT4.

    LOOP AT arr INTO lv_value.
      lv_ones_count = 0.
      lv_abs_value = ABS( lv_value ).

      WHILE lv_abs_value > 0.
        IF lv_abs_value MOD 2 = 1.
          lv_ones_count = lv_ones_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
        lv_abs_value = lv_abs_value / 2.
      ENDWHILE.

      ls_ones_map-value = lv_value.
      ls_ones_map-ones_count = lv_ones_count.
      APPEND ls_ones_map TO lt_ones_map.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_ones_map BY ones_count ASCENDING value ASCENDING.

    CLEAR result.
    LOOP AT lt_ones_map INTO ls_ones_map.
      APPEND ls_ones_map-value TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array

        arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sort_entry,
             ones TYPE INT4,
             value TYPE INT4,
           END OF ty_sort_entry.

    DATA: lt_sort_table TYPE TABLE OF ty_sort_entry.
    DATA: ls_sort_entry TYPE ty_sort_entry.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_bit_count TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_temp_value TYPE INT4.

    result = arr.

    LOOP AT result INTO lv_value.
      lv_temp_value = lv_value.
      IF lv_temp_value < 0.
        lv_temp_value = lv_temp_value * -1.
      ENDIF.

      lv_bit_count = 0.
      WHILE lv_temp_value > 0.
        IF lv_temp_value MOD 2 = 1.
          lv_bit_count = lv_bit_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
        lv_temp_value = lv_temp_value / 2.
      ENDWHILE.

      ls_sort_entry-ones = lv_bit_count.
      ls_sort_entry-value = lv_value.
      APPEND ls_sort_entry TO lt_sort_table.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_sort_table BY ones ASCENDING value ASCENDING.

    CLEAR result.
    LOOP AT lt_sort_table INTO ls_sort_entry.
      APPEND ls_sort_entry-value TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array
      IMPORTING arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    DATA lt_temp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA lv_bit_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_temp_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA lv_j TYPE i.
    DATA lv_swapped TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_bit_count_next TYPE i.

    result = arr.

    IF lines( result ) <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_i = 1.
    WHILE lv_i < lines( result ).
      lv_j = 1.
      lv_swapped = abap_false.
      WHILE lv_j < lines( result ) - lv_i + 1.
        lv_value = result[ lv_j ].
        lv_temp_value = result[ lv_j + 1 ].

        lv_bit_count = 0.
        lv_temp_value = lv_value.
        WHILE lv_temp_value > 0.
          IF lv_temp_value MOD 2 = 1.
            lv_bit_count = lv_bit_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_temp_value = lv_temp_value / 2.
        ENDWHILE.

        lv_bit_count_next = 0.
        lv_temp_value = result[ lv_j + 1 ].
        WHILE lv_temp_value > 0.
          IF lv_temp_value MOD 2 = 1.
            lv_bit_count_next = lv_bit_count_next + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_temp_value = lv_temp_value / 2.
        ENDWHILE.

        IF lv_bit_count > lv_bit_count_next OR
           ( lv_bit_count = lv_bit_count_next AND result[ lv_j ] > result[ lv_j + 1 ] ).
          lv_temp_value = result[ lv_j ].
          result[ lv_j ] = result[ lv_j + 1 ].
          result[ lv_j + 1 ] = lv_temp_value.
          lv_swapped = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

        lv_j = lv_j + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_swapped = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_i = lv_i + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array
      IMPORTING arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4 .

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    DATA lt_temp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA lv_bit_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_temp_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA lv_j TYPE i.
    DATA lv_swapped TYPE abap_bool.

    lt_temp = arr.
    result = arr.

    IF lines( result ) <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_i = 1.
    WHILE lv_i < lines( result ).
      lv_swapped = abap_false.
      lv_j = 1.
      WHILE lv_j <= lines( result ) - lv_i.
        lv_value = result[ lv_j ].
        lv_temp_value = result[ lv_j + 1 ].

        lv_bit_count = 0.
        lv_temp_value = lv_value.
        WHILE lv_temp_value > 0.
          IF lv_temp_value MOD 2 = 1.
            lv_bit_count = lv_bit_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_temp_value = lv_temp_value / 2.
        ENDWHILE.

        lv_count = 0.
        lv_temp_value = result[ lv_j + 1 ].
        WHILE lv_temp_value > 0.
          IF lv_temp_value MOD 2 = 1.
            lv_count = lv_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_temp_value = lv_temp_value / 2.
        ENDWHILE.

        IF lv_bit_count > lv_count OR
           ( lv_bit_count = lv_count AND lv_value > result[ lv_j + 1 ] ).
          lv_temp_value = result[ lv_j ].
          result[ lv_j ] = result[ lv_j + 1 ].
          result[ lv_j + 1 ] = lv_temp_value.
          lv_swapped = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

        lv_j = lv_j + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_swapped = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_i = lv_i + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS sort_array
      IMPORTING
        arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_by_binary_ones IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD sort_array.
    DATA: lt_sorted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA: lv_ones_count TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lt_ones_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA: ls_ones_count TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_i TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_j TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_min_idx TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_min_ones TYPE INT4.
    DATA: lv_min_value TYPE INT4.

    lt_sorted = arr.

    IF lines( lt_sorted ) <= 1.
      result = lt_sorted.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO lv_value.
      lv_ones_count = 0.
      lv_temp = lv_value.

      IF lv_temp < 0.
        lv_temp = lv_temp * -1.
      ENDIF.

      WHILE lv_temp > 0.
        IF lv_temp MOD 2 = 1.
          lv_ones_count = lv_ones_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
        lv_temp = lv_temp / 2.
      ENDWHILE.

      APPEND lv_ones_count TO lt_ones_count.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_i = 1.
    WHILE lv_i < lines( lt_sorted ).
      lv_min_idx = lv_i.
      READ TABLE lt_ones_count INTO lv_min_ones INDEX lv_min_idx.
      READ TABLE lt_sorted INTO lv_min_value INDEX lv_min_idx.

      lv_j = lv_i + 1.
      WHILE lv_j <= lines( lt_sorted ).
        READ TABLE lt_ones_count INTO ls_ones_count INDEX lv_j.
        READ TABLE lt_sorted INTO lv_temp INDEX lv_j.

        IF ls_ones_count < lv_min_ones OR
           ( ls_ones_count = lv_min_ones AND lv_temp < lv_min_value ).
          lv_min_idx = lv_j.
          lv_min_ones = ls_ones_count.
          lv_min_value = lv_temp.
        ENDIF.

        lv_j = lv_j + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_min_idx <> lv_i.
        READ TABLE lt_sorted INTO lv_temp INDEX lv_i.

      lv_i = lv_i + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = lt_sorted.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_music_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

    CLASS METHODS: parse_music
      IMPORTING music_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF int4.

CLASS zcl_music_parser IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD parse_music.
    DATA: notes TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: note TYPE string.
    DATA: beats TYPE int4.

    SPLIT music_string BY space INTO TABLE notes.

    LOOP AT notes INTO note.
      CASE note.
        WHEN 'o'.
          beats = 4.
        WHEN 'o|'.
          beats = 2.
        WHEN '.|'.
          beats = 1.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.

      APPEND beats TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_airline_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_total_revenue_by_airline.
    DATA: lt_revenue TYPE tt_airline_revenue.

    SELECT
      c~carrid,
      c~carrname,
      SUM( b~forcuram ) AS revenue
    FROM scarr AS c
    LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b
      ON c~carrid = b~carrid
    GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_revenue.

    rt_result = lt_revenue.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    ENDIF.

    SELECT * FROM ztransaction INTO TABLE lt_transactions

      ORDER BY transaction_date ASCENDING.

    LOOP AT lt_transactions INTO ls_transaction.

    IF lv_found_shortage = abap_true.
      result-id = 99999.
      result-mat_id = mat_id.
      result-transaction_type = 'PLO'.

CLASS zcalc_available_stock IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_available_stock.
    DATA: lv_available_stock TYPE i.
    DATA: lt_transactions TYPE TABLE OF ty_transaction.
    DATA: lt_stock TYPE TABLE OF ty_stock.
    DATA: ls_transaction TYPE ty_transaction.
    DATA: ls_stock TYPE ty_stock.
    DATA: lv_shortage TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_shortage_date TYPE d.
    DATA: lv_shortage_found TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE space.

    CLEAR result.

    SELECT * FROM zstock INTO TABLE lt_stock WHERE mat_id = mat_id.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lt_stock IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_stock INTO ls_stock INDEX 1.
    lv_available_stock = ls_stock-stock.

    SELECT * FROM ztransaction INTO TABLE lt_transactions
      WHERE mat_id = mat_id
      ORDER BY transaction_date ASCENDING.

    LOOP AT lt_transactions INTO ls_transaction.
      IF ls_transaction-transaction_type = 'RES'.
        lv_available_stock = lv_available_stock + ls_transaction-amount.
      ELSEIF ls_transaction-transaction_type = 'PLO'.
        lv_available_stock = lv_available_stock + ls_transaction-amount.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_available_stock < 0 AND lv_shortage_found = space.
        lv_shortage = lv_available_stock * -1.
        lv_shortage_date = ls_transaction-transaction_date.
        lv_shortage_found = 'X'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_shortage_found = 'X'.
      result-id = 99999.
      result-mat_id = mat_id.
      result-transaction_type = 'PLO'.
      result-transaction_date = lv_shortage_date.
      result-amount = lv_shortage.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transaction,
             id TYPE i,

             transaction_type TYPE char20,
             transaction_date TYPE d,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_transaction.

    TYPES tt_stock TYPE TABLE OF ty_stock.
    TYPES tt_transaction TYPE TABLE OF ty_transaction.

    CLASS-METHODS calculate_available_stock
      IMPORTING

        it_transactions TYPE tt_transaction
        mat_id TYPE char20
      RETURNING

CLASS zcalc_available_stock IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_available_stock.
    DATA: lv_available_stock TYPE i.
    DATA: lt_sorted_transactions TYPE tt_transaction.
    DATA: ls_transaction TYPE ty_transaction.
    DATA: ls_stock TYPE ty_stock.
    DATA: lv_shortage TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_shortage_date TYPE d.

    CLEAR result.

    " Get current stock from input table
    READ TABLE it_stock INTO ls_stock WITH KEY mat_id = mat_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_available_stock = ls_stock-stock.
    ELSE.
      lv_available_stock = 0.
    ENDIF.

    " Filter and sort transactions for the material by date
    lt_sorted_transactions = it_transactions.
    DELETE lt_sorted_transactions WHERE mat_id <> mat_id.
    SORT lt_sorted_transactions BY transaction_date ASCENDING.

    " Process transactions in order
    LOOP AT lt_sorted_transactions INTO ls_transaction.
      IF ls_transaction-transaction_type = 'RES'.
        lv_available_stock = lv_available_stock + ls_transaction-amount.
      ELSEIF ls_transaction-transaction_type = 'PLO'.
        lv_available_stock = lv_available_stock + ls_transaction-amount.
      ENDIF.

      " Check if stock drops below zero
      IF lv_available_stock < 0.
        lv_shortage = ABS( lv_available_stock ).
        lv_shortage_date = ls_transaction-transaction_date.

        " Create new PLO entry
        result-id = 99999.
        result-mat_id = mat_id.
        result-transaction_type = 'PLO'.
        result-transaction_date = lv_shortage_date.
        result-amount = lv_shortage.

        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reverse_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             result_string TYPE string,
             is_palindrome TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_result.

    CLASS-METHODS check_palindrome
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
        iv_chars_to_delete TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_result.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reverse_delete IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_palindrome.
    DATA lv_filtered_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.
    DATA lv_reversed_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_is_palindrome TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_temp TYPE c.
    DATA lv_mirror_index TYPE i.

    lv_filtered_string = ''.
    lv_length = strlen( iv_string ).

    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index - 1.
      lv_char = iv_string+lv_index(1).
      IF find( iv_chars_to_delete, lv_char ) <> 0.
        CONCATENATE lv_filtered_string lv_char INTO lv_filtered_string.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    lv_reversed_string = lv_filtered_string.
    lv_length = strlen( lv_filtered_string ).

    DO lv_length / 2 TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index - 1.
      lv_mirror_index = lv_length - lv_index - 1.
      lv_temp = lv_reversed_string+lv_index(1).
      lv_reversed_string+lv_index(1) = lv_reversed_string+lv_mirror_index(1).
      lv_reversed_string+lv_mirror_index(1) = lv_temp.
    ENDDO.

    IF lv_filtered_string = lv_reversed_string.
      lv_is_palindrome = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      lv_is_palindrome = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    rs_result-result_string = lv_filtered_string.
    rs_result-is_palindrome = lv_is_palindrome.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

      lv_result_string = 'the number of odd elements Xn the strXng X of the Xnput.'.

      RETURNING VALUE(is_pal) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS z_even_odd_palindrome IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD even_odd_palindrome.
    DATA: lv_even_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_odd_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_num TYPE i.

    DO n TIMES.
      lv_num = sy-index.

      IF is_palindrome( lv_num ) = abap_true.
        IF lv_num MOD 2 = 0.
          lv_even_count = lv_even_count + 1.
        ELSE.
          lv_odd_count = lv_odd_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    result-even_count = lv_even_count.
    result-odd_count = lv_odd_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_palindrome.
    DATA: lv_str TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_reversed TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_len TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_j TYPE i.

    lv_str = CONV string( num ).
    lv_len = strlen( lv_str ).
    lv_reversed = lv_str.

    lv_j = 0.
    DO lv_len TIMES.
      lv_i = lv_len - sy-index.
      lv_reversed+lv_j(1) = lv_str+lv_i(1).
      lv_j = lv_j + 1.
    ENDDO.

    IF lv_str = lv_reversed.
      is_pal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      is_pal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
