CLASS zcalc_delivery_date IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_delivery_date.
    DATA lv_current_date TYPE date.
    DATA lv_lead_time TYPE i.
    DATA lv_working_days_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lt_holidays TYPE TABLE OF zholiday.
    DATA lv_is_holiday TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA ls_holiday TYPE zholiday.
    DATA lv_weekday TYPE i.

    lv_current_date = order_date.

    SELECT SINGLE lead_time_days
      FROM zmaterial
      WHERE mat_id = @mat_id
      INTO @lv_lead_time.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_lead_time = 0.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_lead_time = 0.
      delivery_date = lv_current_date.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT *
      FROM zholiday
      INTO TABLE @lt_holidays.

    WHILE lv_working_days_count < lv_lead_time.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.

      lv_weekday = ( cl_abap_tstmp=>string_to_tstmp(
        EXPORTING
          string = lv_current_date
      ) MOD 7 ) + 1.

      IF lv_weekday >= 2 AND lv_weekday <= 6.
        lv_is_holiday = abap_false.
        LOOP AT lt_holidays INTO ls_holiday.
          IF ls_holiday-holiday_date = lv_current_date.
            lv_is_holiday = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_is_holiday = abap_false.
          lv_working_days_count = lv_working_days_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    delivery_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcalc_delivery_date IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_delivery_date.
    DATA lv_current_date TYPE d.
    DATA lv_working_days_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_lead_time_days TYPE i.
    DATA lt_holidays TYPE TABLE OF zholiday.
    DATA lv_holiday_found TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA ls_holiday TYPE zholiday.
    DATA lt_materials TYPE TABLE OF zmaterial.
    DATA ls_material TYPE zmaterial.
    DATA lv_day_of_week TYPE i.

    lv_current_date = cl_abap_datfm=>conv_string_to_date( order_date ).

    SELECT * FROM zmaterial INTO TABLE lt_materials.

    LOOP AT lt_materials INTO ls_material.
      IF ls_material-mat_id = mat_id.
        lv_lead_time_days = ls_material-lead_time_days.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    SELECT * FROM zholiday INTO TABLE lt_holidays.

    IF lv_lead_time_days = 0.
      delivery_date = lv_current_date.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_working_days_count < lv_lead_time_days.
      lv_current_date = cl_abap_datfm=>add_days_to_date(
        iv_date = lv_current_date
        iv_days = 1 ).

      lv_day_of_week = cl_abap_datfm=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).

      IF lv_day_of_week >= 1 AND lv_day_of_week <= 5.
        lv_holiday_found = abap_false.
        LOOP AT lt_holidays INTO ls_holiday.
          IF ls_holiday-holiday_date = lv_current_date.
            lv_holiday_found = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_holiday_found = abap_false.
          lv_working_days_count = lv_working_days_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    delivery_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

      current_date = current_date + 1.

      day_index = ( current_date - DATE '1900-01-01' ) MOD 7.

      IF day_index <> 5 AND day_index <> 6.

        LOOP AT holidays INTO DATA(holiday).
          IF holiday-holiday_date = current_date.
            is_holiday = abap_true.

        ENDLOOP.

        IF is_holiday = abap_false.
          working_days_count = working_days_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    delivery_date = current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

    ENDIF.

    IF lv_lead_time = 0.
      delivery_date = lv_current_date.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT * FROM zholiday INTO TABLE lv_holidays.

    WHILE lv_days_counted < lv_lead_time.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.

      lv_weekday = cl_abap_tstmp=>string_to_tstmp_utc( CONV string( lv_current_date ) ).
      lv_weekday = ( lv_weekday + 3 ) MOD 7.

      IF lv_weekday < 5.
        lv_is_holiday = abap_false.
        LOOP AT lv_holidays INTO ls_holiday.
          IF ls_holiday-holiday_date = lv_current_date.
            lv_is_holiday = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_is_holiday = abap_false.
          lv_days_counted = lv_days_counted + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    delivery_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcalc_delivery_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS calculate_delivery_date
      IMPORTING
        order_date TYPE string
        mat_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(delivery_date) TYPE date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcalc_delivery_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_delivery_date.
    DATA lv_start_date TYPE date.
    DATA lv_current_date TYPE date.
    DATA lv_lead_time TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_working_days_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_day_of_week TYPE i.
    DATA lt_materials TYPE TABLE OF zmaterial.
    DATA lt_holidays TYPE TABLE OF zholiday.
    DATA ls_material TYPE zmaterial.
    DATA ls_holiday TYPE zholiday.
    DATA lv_holiday_found TYPE abap_bool.

    lv_start_date = order_date.

    SELECT * FROM zmaterial INTO TABLE lt_materials WHERE mat_id = mat_id.
    IF lt_materials IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_materials INTO ls_material INDEX 1.
      lv_lead_time = ls_material-lead_time_days.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT * FROM zholiday INTO TABLE lt_holidays.

    lv_current_date = lv_start_date.
    lv_working_days_count = 0.

    WHILE lv_working_days_count < lv_lead_time.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.

      lv_day_of_week = cl_abap_tstmp=>string_to_tstmp( |{ lv_current_date }000000| )-daynumber.

      IF lv_day_of_week >= 2 AND lv_day_of_week <= 6.
        lv_holiday_found = abap_false.
        LOOP AT lt_holidays INTO ls_holiday.
          IF ls_holiday-holiday_date = lv_current_date.
            lv_holiday_found = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_holiday_found = abap_false.
          lv_working_days_count = lv_working_days_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    delivery_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_path_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS calculate_critical_path
      IMPORTING
        it_steps       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_dependencies TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_duration) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_step_info,
             step_id   TYPE string,
             duration  TYPE i,
             max_path  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_step_info.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_step,
             step_id     TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
             duration    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_step.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dependency,
             from_step TYPE string,
             to_step   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dependency.

    TYPES: tt_predecessors TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES: tt_memo TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_step_info WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY step_id.

    CLASS-METHODS get_predecessors
      IMPORTING
        it_dependencies TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_step_id      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_predecessors) TYPE tt_predecessors.

    CLASS-METHODS calculate_max_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_step_id      TYPE string
        it_steps        TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_dependencies TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_memo         TYPE tt_memo
      CHANGING
        ct_memo         TYPE tt_memo
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_path) TYPE i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_path_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_critical_path.
    DATA: lt_memo TYPE tt_memo.
    DATA: lv_max_duration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_current_max TYPE i.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE ty_step.
    DATA: lt_steps_typed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_step.

    IF it_steps IS INITIAL.
      rv_duration = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_steps_typed = it_steps.

    LOOP AT lt_steps_typed INTO ls_step.
      lv_current_max = calculate_max_path(
        iv_step_id = ls_step-step_id
        it_steps = it_steps
        it_dependencies = it_dependencies
        it_memo = lt_memo
        ct_memo = lt_memo
      ).
      IF lv_current_max > lv_max_duration.
        lv_max_duration = lv_current_max.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_duration = lv_max_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_predecessors.
    DATA: ls_dep TYPE ty_dependency.
    DATA: lt_deps_typed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dependency.

    lt_deps_typed = it_dependencies.

    LOOP AT lt_deps_typed INTO ls_dep
      WHERE to_step = iv_step_id.
      APPEND ls_dep-from_step TO rt_predecessors.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_max_path.
    DATA: ls_memo_entry TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lt_predecessors TYPE tt_predecessors.
    DATA: lv_pred_max_path TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_current_duration TYPE i.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE ty_step.
    DATA: lt_steps_typed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_step.

    READ TABLE ct_memo INTO ls_memo_entry
      WITH KEY step_id = iv_step_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_max_path = ls_memo_entry-max_path.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_steps_typed = it_steps.

    READ TABLE lt_steps_typed INTO ls_step
      WITH KEY step_id = iv_step_id.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_max_path = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_predecessors = get_predecessors(
      it_dependencies = it_dependencies
      iv_step_id = iv_step_id
    ).

    IF lt_predecessors IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_path = ls_step-duration.
    ELSE.
      lv_current_duration = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_predecessors INTO DATA(lv_pred_step_id).
        lv_pred_max_path = calculate_max_path(
          iv_step_id = lv_pred_step_id
          it_steps = it_steps
          it_dependencies = it_dependencies
          it_memo = ct_memo
          ct_memo = ct_memo
        ).
        IF lv_pred_max_path > lv_current_duration.
          lv_current_duration = lv_pred_max_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      rv_max_path = lv_current_duration + ls_step-duration.
    ENDIF.

    ls_memo_entry-step_id = iv_step_id.
    ls_memo_entry-max_path = rv_max_path.
    APPEND ls_memo_entry TO ct_memo.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_path_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_critical_path.
    DATA: lt_memo TYPE ty_memo_table.
    DATA: lv_max_duration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE ty_step.

    IF it_steps IS INITIAL.
      rv_duration = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_steps INTO ls_step.
      DATA(lv_path) = calculate_max_path(
        iv_step_id = ls_step-step_id
        it_steps = it_steps
        it_dependencies = it_dependencies
        it_memo = lt_memo
      ).
      CHANGE lt_memo.
      IF lv_path > lv_max_duration.
        lv_max_duration = lv_path.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_duration = lv_max_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_max_path.
    DATA: ls_memo TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lt_predecessors TYPE ty_step_id_table.
    DATA: lv_pred_max_path TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_current_duration TYPE i.

    READ TABLE ct_memo INTO ls_memo
      WITH KEY step_id = iv_step_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_max_path = ls_memo-max_path.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_duration = get_step_duration(
      it_steps = it_steps
      iv_step_id = iv_step_id
    ).

    IF lv_current_duration = 0.
      rv_max_path = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_predecessors = get_predecessors(
      it_dependencies = it_dependencies
      iv_step_id = iv_step_id
    ).

    IF lt_predecessors IS INITIAL.
      ls_memo-step_id = iv_step_id.
      ls_memo-duration = lv_current_duration.
      ls_memo-max_path = lv_current_duration.
      INSERT ls_memo INTO TABLE ct_memo.
      rv_max_path = lv_current_duration.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_predecessors INTO DATA(lv_pred_id).
      DATA(lv_pred_path) = calculate_max_path(
        iv_step_id = lv_pred_id
        it_steps = it_steps
        it_dependencies = it_dependencies
        it_memo = ct_memo
      ).
      CHANGE ct_memo.
      IF lv_pred_path > lv_pred_max_path.
        lv_pred_max_path = lv_pred_path.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    ls_memo-step_id = iv_step_id.
    ls_memo-duration = lv_current_duration.
    ls_memo-max_path = lv_current_duration + lv_pred_max_path.
    INSERT ls_memo INTO TABLE ct_memo.

    rv_max_path = ls_memo-max_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_predecessors.
    DATA: ls_dependency TYPE ty_dependency.

    LOOP AT it_dependencies INTO ls_dependency.
      IF ls_dependency-to_step = iv_step_id.
        INSERT ls_dependency-from_step INTO TABLE rt_predecessors.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_step_duration.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE ty_step.

    LOOP AT it_steps INTO ls_step.
      IF ls_step-step_id = iv_step_id.
        rv_duration = ls_step-duration.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_duration = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_critical_path_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_critical_path.
    rv_duration = calculate_longest_path(
      it_steps = it_steps
      it_dependencies = it_dependencies
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_longest_path.
    DATA: lt_step_info TYPE TABLE OF ty_step_info.
    DATA: ls_step_info TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lt_processed TYPE TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lv_step_id TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_max_duration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lt_predecessors TYPE TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lv_pred_max TYPE i.
    DATA: ls_pred_step TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lv_all_processed TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA: lv_max_iterations TYPE i.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE any.
    DATA: ls_dep TYPE any.

    lv_max_iterations = lines( it_steps ) + 1.

    LOOP AT it_steps INTO ls_step.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STEP_ID' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_step_id>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DURATION' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_duration>).
      IF <lv_step_id> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_duration> IS ASSIGNED.
        ls_step_info-step_id = <lv_step_id>.
        ls_step_info-duration = <lv_duration>.
        ls_step_info-max_path = <lv_duration>.
        INSERT ls_step_info INTO TABLE lt_step_info.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DO lv_max_iterations TIMES.
      lv_all_processed = abap_true.

      LOOP AT lt_step_info INTO ls_step_info.
        IF line_exists( lt_processed[ table_line = ls_step_info-step_id ] ).
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.

        lt_predecessors = get_predecessors(
          iv_step_id = ls_step_info-step_id
          it_dependencies = it_dependencies
        ).

        IF lines( lt_predecessors ) = 0.
          INSERT ls_step_info-step_id INTO TABLE lt_processed.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.

        lv_pred_max = 0.
        lv_all_processed = abap_false.

        LOOP AT lt_predecessors INTO lv_step_id.
          READ TABLE lt_step_info INTO ls_pred_step
            WITH KEY step_id = lv_step_id.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            IF ls_pred_step-max_path > lv_pred_max.
              lv_pred_max = ls_pred_step-max_path.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_pred_max > 0.
          ls_step_info-max_path = lv_pred_max + ls_step_info-duration.
          MODIFY lt_step_info FROM ls_step_info.
          INSERT ls_step_info-step_id INTO TABLE lt_processed.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_all_processed = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    LOOP AT lt_step_info INTO ls_step_info.
      IF ls_step_info-max_path > lv_max_duration.
        lv_max_duration = ls_step_info-max_path.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_max_duration = lv_max_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_predecessors.
    DATA: ls_dep TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_dependencies INTO ls_dep.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TO_STEP' OF STRUCTURE ls_dep TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_to_step>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FROM_STEP' OF STRUCTURE ls_dep TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_from_step>).
      IF <lv_to_step> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_from_step> IS ASSIGNED.
        IF <lv_to_step> = iv_step_id.
          INSERT <lv_from_step> INTO TABLE rt_predecessors.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_path_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_critical_path.
    DATA: lt_step_info TYPE TABLE OF ty_step_info.
    DATA: ls_step_info TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lv_max_duration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE ty_step.
    DATA: ls_dep TYPE ty_dependency.

    IF it_steps IS INITIAL.
      rv_duration = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_steps INTO ls_step.
      ls_step_info-step_id = ls_step-step_id.
      ls_step_info-duration = ls_step-duration.
      ls_step_info-max_path = 0.
      INSERT ls_step_info INTO TABLE lt_step_info.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT it_steps INTO ls_step.
      calculate_max_path(
        EXPORTING
          iv_step_id = ls_step-step_id
          it_steps = it_steps
          it_dependencies = it_dependencies
        CHANGING
          ct_step_info = lt_step_info
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_step_info INTO ls_step_info.
      IF ls_step_info-max_path > lv_max_duration.
        lv_max_duration = ls_step_info-max_path.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_duration = lv_max_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_predecessors.
    DATA: ls_dep TYPE ty_dependency.

    LOOP AT it_dependencies INTO ls_dep.
      IF ls_dep-to_step = iv_step_id.
        INSERT ls_dep-from_step INTO TABLE rt_predecessors.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_max_path.
    DATA: lt_predecessors TYPE ty_predecessors.
    DATA: lv_max_pred_path TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE ty_step.
    DATA: ls_info TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lv_pred_id TYPE ty_step_id.
    DATA: ls_pred_info TYPE ty_step_info.

    READ TABLE ct_step_info INTO ls_info WITH KEY step_id = iv_step_id.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_info-max_path > 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_predecessors = get_predecessors(
      it_dependencies = it_dependencies
      iv_step_id = iv_step_id
    ).

    IF lt_predecessors IS INITIAL.
      READ TABLE it_steps INTO ls_step WITH KEY step_id = iv_step_id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_info-max_path = ls_step-duration.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      LOOP AT lt_predecessors INTO lv_pred_id.
        calculate_max_path(
          EXPORTING
            iv_step_id = lv_pred_id
            it_steps = it_steps
            it_dependencies = it_dependencies
          CHANGING
            ct_step_info = ct_step_info
        ).

        READ TABLE ct_step_info INTO ls_pred_info WITH KEY step_id = lv_pred_id.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_pred_info-max_path > lv_max_pred_path.
          lv_max_pred_path = ls_pred_info-max_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      READ TABLE it_steps INTO ls_step WITH KEY step_id = iv_step_id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_info-max_path = lv_max_pred_path + ls_step-duration.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY TABLE ct_step_info FROM ls_info.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_critical_path_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_critical_path.
    DATA: lt_memo TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_step_info WITH UNIQUE KEY step_id.
    DATA: lv_max_duration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: ls_step_info TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lt_deps TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dependency.

    IF it_steps IS INITIAL.
      rv_duration = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_steps INTO DATA(ls_step).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STEP_ID' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_step_id>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DURATION' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_duration>).

      IF <lv_step_id> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_duration> IS ASSIGNED.
        ls_step_info-step_id = <lv_step_id>.
        ls_step_info-duration = <lv_duration>.
        ls_step_info-max_path = -1.
        INSERT ls_step_info INTO TABLE lt_memo.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT it_dependencies INTO DATA(ls_dep).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FROM_STEP' OF STRUCTURE ls_dep TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_from>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TO_STEP' OF STRUCTURE ls_dep TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_to>).

      IF <lv_from> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_to> IS ASSIGNED.
        DATA(ls_dep_rec) = VALUE ty_dependency( from_step = <lv_from> to_step = <lv_to> ).
        APPEND ls_dep_rec TO lt_deps.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT it_steps INTO ls_step.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STEP_ID' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO <lv_step_id>.

      IF <lv_step_id> IS ASSIGNED.
        DATA(lv_path) = calculate_longest_path(
          iv_step_id = <lv_step_id>
          it_steps = it_steps
          it_dependencies = lt_deps
          ct_memo = lt_memo ).

        IF lv_path > lv_max_duration.
          lv_max_duration = lv_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_duration = lv_max_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_predecessors.
    LOOP AT it_dependencies INTO DATA(ls_dep)
      WHERE to_step = iv_step_id.
      APPEND ls_dep-from_step TO rt_predecessors.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_longest_path.
    DATA: ls_memo TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lv_max_pred_path TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_current_duration TYPE i.

    READ TABLE ct_memo INTO ls_memo
      WITH TABLE KEY step_id = iv_step_id.

    IF ls_memo-max_path >= 0.
      rv_path = ls_memo-max_path.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_steps INTO DATA(ls_step).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STEP_ID' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_step_id>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DURATION' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_duration>).

      IF <lv_step_id> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_step_id> = iv_step_id.
        IF <lv_duration> IS ASSIGNED.
          lv_current_duration = <lv_duration>.
        ENDIF.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_current_duration = 0.
      rv_path = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_predecessors) = get_predecessors(
      it_dependencies = it_dependencies
      iv_step_id = iv_step_id ).

    IF lt_predecessors IS INITIAL.
      ls_memo-max_path = lv_current_duration.
    ELSE.
      LOOP AT lt_predecessors INTO DATA(lv_pred_step).
        DATA(lv_pred_path) = calculate_longest_path(
          iv_step_id = lv_pred_step
          it_steps = it_steps
          it_dependencies = it_dependencies
          ct_memo = ct_memo ).

        IF lv_pred_path > lv_max_pred_path.
          lv_max_pred_path = lv_pred_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      ls_memo-max_path = lv_current_duration + lv_max_pred_path.
    ENDIF.

    ls_memo-step_id = iv_step_id.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_memo FROM ls_memo.

    rv_path = ls_memo-max_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_critical_path.
    DATA: lt_memo TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_step_info WITH UNIQUE KEY step_id.
    DATA: lv_max_duration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: ls_step_info TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lv_step_id TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_duration TYPE i.
    DATA: lr_table TYPE REF TO data.

    IF it_steps IS INITIAL.
      rv_duration = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA lr_table LIKE it_steps.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lt_steps>).
    <lt_steps> = it_steps.

    LOOP AT <lt_steps> INTO ls_step.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STEP_ID' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_step_id>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DURATION' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_duration>).

      IF <lv_step_id> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_duration> IS ASSIGNED.
        lv_step_id = <lv_step_id>.
        lv_duration = <lv_duration>.

        ls_step_info-step_id = lv_step_id.
        ls_step_info-duration = lv_duration.
        ls_step_info-max_path = 0.
        INSERT ls_step_info INTO TABLE lt_memo.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT <lt_steps> INTO ls_step.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STEP_ID' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO <lv_step_id>.

      IF <lv_step_id> IS ASSIGNED.
        lv_step_id = <lv_step_id>.

        DATA(lv_path_length) = calculate_longest_path(
          iv_step_id = lv_step_id
          it_steps = it_steps
          it_dependencies = it_dependencies
          CHANGING ct_memo = lt_memo ).

        IF lv_path_length > lv_max_duration.
          lv_max_duration = lv_path_length.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_duration = lv_max_duration.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_longest_path.
    DATA: ls_memo TYPE ty_step_info.
    DATA: lt_predecessors TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    DATA: lv_max_pred_path TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: ls_step TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lv_step_id TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_duration TYPE i.
    DATA: lr_table TYPE REF TO data.

    READ TABLE ct_memo INTO ls_memo WITH TABLE KEY step_id = iv_step_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_memo-max_path > 0.
      RETURN ls_memo-max_path.
    ENDIF.

    lt_predecessors = get_predecessors(
      it_dependencies = it_dependencies
      iv_step_id = iv_step_id ).

    IF lt_predecessors IS INITIAL.
      CREATE DATA lr_table LIKE it_steps.
      ASSIGN lr_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lt_steps>).
      <lt_steps> = it_steps.

      LOOP AT <lt_steps> INTO ls_step.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STEP_ID' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_step_id>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DURATION' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_duration>).

        IF <lv_step_id> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_duration> IS ASSIGNED.
          lv_step_id = <lv_step_id>.
          lv_duration = <lv_duration>.

          IF lv_step_id = iv_step_id.
            ls_memo-max_path = lv_duration.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      LOOP AT lt_predecessors INTO DATA(lv_pred_step_id).
        DATA(lv_pred_path) = calculate_longest_path(
          iv_step_id = lv_pred_step_id
          it_steps = it_steps
          it_dependencies = it_dependencies
          CHANGING ct_memo = ct_memo ).

        IF lv_pred_path > lv_max_pred_path.
          lv_max_pred_path = lv_pred_path.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      CREATE DATA lr_table LIKE it_steps.
      ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_steps>.
      <lt_steps> = it_steps.

      LOOP AT <lt_steps> INTO ls_step.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STEP_ID' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO <lv_step_id>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DURATION' OF STRUCTURE ls_step TO <lv_duration>.

        IF <lv_step_id> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_duration> IS ASSIGNED.
          lv_step_id = <lv_step_id>.
          lv_duration = <lv_duration>.

          IF lv_step_id = iv_step_id.
            ls_memo-max_path = lv_max_pred_path + lv_duration.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    UPDATE TABLE ct_memo FROM ls_memo.

    RETURN ls_memo-max_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_predecessors.
    DATA: lt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    DATA: ls_dep TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lv_from_step TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_to_step TYPE string.
    DATA: lr_table TYPE REF TO data.

    CREATE DATA lr_table LIKE it_dependencies.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lt_deps>).
    <lt_deps> = it_dependencies.

    LOOP AT <lt_deps> INTO ls_dep.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FROM_STEP' OF STRUCTURE ls_dep TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_from_step>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TO_STEP' OF STRUCTURE ls_dep TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_to_step>).

      IF <lv_from_step> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_to_step> IS ASSIGNED.
        lv_from_step = <lv_from_step>.
        lv_to_step = <lv_to_step>.

        IF lv_to_step = iv_step_id.
          APPEND lv_from_step TO lt_result.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_predecessors = lt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_palindrome_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS make_palindrome
      IMPORTING iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_palindrome_helper IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD make_palindrome.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_suffix TYPE string.
    DATA lv_prefix TYPE string.
    DATA lv_prefix_reverse TYPE string.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c.
    DATA lv_pos TYPE i.
    DATA lv_is_palindrome TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_suffix_length TYPE i.

    rv_result = iv_string.
    lv_length = strlen( iv_string ).

    IF lv_length = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_index = lv_length.

    WHILE lv_index > 0.
      lv_suffix = substring( iv_string, off = lv_length - lv_index ).
      lv_suffix_length = strlen( lv_suffix ).

      lv_is_palindrome = abap_true.
      lv_pos = 0.
      WHILE lv_pos < lv_suffix_length / 2.
        IF lv_suffix+lv_pos(1) <> lv_suffix+(lv_suffix_length - lv_pos - 1)(1).
          lv_is_palindrome = abap_false.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        lv_pos = lv_pos + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_is_palindrome = abap_true.
        lv_prefix = substring( iv_string, len = lv_length - lv_index ).
        lv_prefix_reverse = ''.

        lv_pos = strlen( lv_prefix ) - 1.
        WHILE lv_pos >= 0.
          lv_char = lv_prefix+lv_pos(1).
          CONCATENATE lv_prefix_reverse lv_char INTO lv_prefix_reverse.
          lv_pos = lv_pos - 1.
        ENDWHILE.

        CONCATENATE iv_string lv_prefix_reverse INTO rv_result.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_index = lv_index - 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    DATA lv_factorial TYPE i.
    DATA lv_j TYPE i.
    DATA lv_special_result TYPE i.

    lv_special_result = 1.

    lv_i = iv_n.
    WHILE lv_i >= 1.
      lv_factorial = 1.
      lv_j = lv_i.
      WHILE lv_j >= 1.

        input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_histogram.
    DATA: letters TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: letter_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH KEY table_line.
    DATA: max_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: current_letter TYPE string.
    DATA: current_count TYPE i.
    DATA: split_str TYPE string.
    DATA: max_letters TYPE TABLE OF string WITH KEY table_line.
    DATA: output_line TYPE string.

    CLEAR result.

    IF input IS INITIAL OR input = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT input BY space INTO TABLE letters.

    CLEAR letter_counts.
    LOOP AT letters INTO current_letter.
      IF current_letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        READ TABLE letter_counts WITH KEY table_line = current_letter TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          INSERT current_letter INTO TABLE letter_counts.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR max_count.
    CLEAR max_letters.

    LOOP AT letter_counts INTO current_letter.
      CLEAR current_count.
      LOOP AT letters INTO split_str.
        IF split_str = current_letter.
          ADD 1 TO current_count.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF current_count > max_count.
        CLEAR max_letters.
        max_count = current_count.
        INSERT current_letter INTO TABLE max_letters.
      ELSEIF current_count = max_count.
        INSERT current_letter INTO TABLE max_letters.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT max_letters INTO current_letter.
      CONCATENATE current_letter ':' max_count INTO output_line.
      INSERT output_line INTO TABLE result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_histogram DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS get_histogram IMPORTING input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_histogram.
    DATA: letters TYPE TABLE OF string,
          letter TYPE string,
          max_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          current_count TYPE i,
          entry TYPE string,
          output TYPE string,
          first_entry TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

    result = ''.

    IF input IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT input BY space INTO TABLE letters.

    LOOP AT letters INTO letter.
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        current_count = 0.
        LOOP AT letters INTO entry.
          IF entry = letter.
            current_count = current_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        IF current_count > max_count.
          max_count = current_count.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT letters INTO letter.
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        current_count = 0.
        LOOP AT letters INTO entry.
          IF entry = letter.
            current_count = current_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        IF current_count = max_count.
          IF first_entry = abap_false.
            output = output && ', '.
          ENDIF.
          output = output && letter && ': ' && current_count.
          first_entry = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    result = output.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD histogram.
    DATA: letters TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: letter TYPE string.
    DATA: letter_list TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: count_values TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: max_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: current_count TYPE i.
    DATA: idx TYPE sy-tabix.
    DATA: i TYPE i.

    result = VALUE #( ).

    IF input_string IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT input_string BY space INTO TABLE letters.

    LOOP AT letters INTO letter.
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        READ TABLE letter_list TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY table_line = letter.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          APPEND letter TO letter_list.
          APPEND 1 TO count_values.
          IF 1 > max_count.
            max_count = 1.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          idx = sy-tabix.
          current_count = count_values[ idx ].
          current_count = current_count + 1.
          count_values[ idx ] = current_count.
          IF current_count > max_count.
            max_count = current_count.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF max_count > 0.
      LOOP AT letter_list INTO letter.
        i = sy-tabix.
        current_count = count_values[ i ].
        IF current_count = max_count.
          APPEND letter TO result.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_histogram.
    DATA: letters TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: max_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: current_count TYPE i.
    DATA: letter TYPE string.
    DATA: output_line TYPE string.
    DATA: unique_letters TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    DATA: found TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA: count_str TYPE string.

    CLEAR result.

    IF test IS INITIAL OR test = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT test BY ' ' INTO TABLE letters.

    LOOP AT letters INTO letter.
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        current_count = 0.
        LOOP AT letters INTO DATA(l).
          IF l = letter.
            current_count = current_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        found = abap_false.
        LOOP AT unique_letters INTO DATA(ul).
          IF ul = letter.
            found = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF found = abap_false.
          INSERT letter INTO unique_letters.
        ENDIF.

        IF current_count > max_count.
          max_count = current_count.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT unique_letters INTO letter.
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        current_count = 0.
        LOOP AT letters INTO DATA(l2).
          IF l2 = letter.
            current_count = current_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF current_count = max_count.
          count_str = current_count.
          output_line = letter && ':' && count_str.
          INSERT output_line INTO result.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_histogram.
    DATA: split_result TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: letter TYPE string.
    DATA: temp_letter TYPE string.
    DATA: temp_count TYPE i.
    DATA: current_count TYPE i.
    DATA: max_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: output_line TYPE string.
    DATA: letter_count_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    DATA: max_letters TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA: output_str TYPE string.
    DATA: found TYPE abap_bool.

    CLEAR result.

    IF test IS INITIAL OR test = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT test BY space INTO TABLE split_result.

    CLEAR letter_count_map.
    LOOP AT split_result INTO letter.
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        CLEAR found.
        LOOP AT letter_count_map INTO output_line.
          IF output_line CS letter && '|'.
            found = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF found = abap_false.
          current_count = 0.
          LOOP AT split_result INTO temp_letter.
            IF temp_letter = letter.
              current_count = current_count + 1.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          output_str = letter && '|' && current_count.
          APPEND output_str TO letter_count_map.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR max_count.
    LOOP AT letter_count_map INTO output_line.
      SPLIT output_line BY '|' INTO temp_letter temp_count.
      IF temp_count > max_count.
        max_count = temp_count.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR max_letters.
    LOOP AT letter_count_map INTO output_line.
      SPLIT output_line BY '|' INTO temp_letter temp_count.
      IF temp_count = max_count.
        INSERT temp_letter INTO TABLE max_letters.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR result.
    LOOP AT max_letters INTO letter.
      LOOP AT letter_count_map INTO output_line.
        SPLIT output_line BY '|' INTO temp_letter temp_count.
        IF temp_letter = letter AND temp_count = max_count.
          output_str = letter && ':' && max_count.
          APPEND output_str TO result.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

      IMPORTING test TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string .

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_histogram .
    DATA: split_result TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: line TYPE string.
    DATA: letter_count_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    DATA: key_value TYPE string.
    DATA: key TYPE string.
    DATA: value TYPE string.
    DATA: value_int TYPE i.
    DATA: idx TYPE i.
    DATA: max_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: output_line TYPE string.
    DATA: found TYPE abap_bool.

    CLEAR result.

    IF test IS INITIAL OR test = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT test BY space INTO TABLE split_result.

    CLEAR letter_count_map.

    LOOP AT split_result INTO line.
      IF line IS NOT INITIAL.
        found = abap_false.
        LOOP AT letter_count_map INTO key_value.
          idx = sy-tabix.
          SPLIT key_value BY ':' INTO key value.
          IF key = line.
            value_int = value.
            value_int = value_int + 1.
            CONCATENATE line ':' value_int INTO key_value.
            MODIFY letter_count_map FROM key_value INDEX idx.
            found = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF found = abap_false.
          CONCATENATE line ':1' INTO key_value.
          APPEND key_value TO letter_count_map.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    max_count = 0.
    LOOP AT letter_count_map INTO key_value.
      SPLIT key_value BY ':' INTO key value.
      value_int = value.
      IF value_int > max_count.
        max_count = value_int.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR result.
    LOOP AT letter_count_map INTO key_value.
      SPLIT key_value BY ':' INTO key value.
      value_int = value.
      IF value_int = max_count.
        CONCATENATE key '=' value INTO output_line.
        APPEND output_line TO result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD .
ENDCLASS .

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_histogram.
    DATA: letters TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: letter_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH KEY table_line.
    DATA: max_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: current_letter TYPE string.
    DATA: current_count TYPE i.
    DATA: letter_count_str TYPE string.
    DATA: parts TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: part TYPE string.
    DATA: count_str TYPE string.
    DATA: output_line TYPE string.

    CLEAR result.

    IF input IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT input BY space INTO TABLE letters.
    DELETE letters WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.

    IF letters IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SORT letters.

    CLEAR current_letter.
    CLEAR current_count.

    LOOP AT letters INTO part.
      IF current_letter IS INITIAL.
        current_letter = part.
        current_count = 1.
      ELSEIF part = current_letter.
        current_count = current_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        IF current_count > max_count.
          max_count = current_count.
          CLEAR letter_counts.
          letter_count_str = current_letter && '=' && current_count.
          APPEND letter_count_str TO letter_counts.
        ELSEIF current_count = max_count.
          letter_count_str = current_letter && '=' && current_count.
          APPEND letter_count_str TO letter_counts.
        ENDIF.
        current_letter = part.
        current_count = 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF current_letter IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF current_count > max_count.
        max_count = current_count.
        CLEAR letter_counts.
        letter_count_str = current_letter && '=' && current_count.
        APPEND letter_count_str TO letter_counts.
      ELSEIF current_count = max_count.
        letter_count_str = current_letter && '=' && current_count.
        APPEND letter_count_str TO letter_counts.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT letter_counts INTO letter_count_str.
      SPLIT letter_count_str BY '=' INTO TABLE parts.
      READ TABLE parts INDEX 1 INTO current_letter.
      READ TABLE parts INDEX 2 INTO count_str.
      output_line = current_letter && ':' && count_str.
      APPEND output_line TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD get_histogram.

    IF input IS INITIAL.

    ENDIF.

    SPLIT input BY space INTO TABLE letters.

    LOOP AT letters INTO letter.
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        current_count = 0.
        LOOP AT letters INTO entry.

            current_count = current_count + 1.

          found = abap_false.

              found = abap_true.
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          IF found = abap_false.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS histogram IMPORTING input_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE string.

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD histogram.
    DATA: letters TYPE TABLE OF string,
          letter TYPE string,
          max_count TYPE i VALUE 0,
          current_count TYPE i,
          letter_key TYPE string,
          index TYPE i,
          found TYPE abap_bool,
          count_values TYPE TABLE OF i,
          count_keys TYPE TABLE OF string,
          output_str TYPE string.

    CLEAR result.

    IF input_string IS INITIAL.
      result = '{}'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT input_string BY space INTO TABLE letters.

    LOOP AT letters INTO letter.
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL.
        found = abap_false.
        LOOP AT count_keys INTO letter_key.
          IF letter_key = letter.
            found = abap_true.
            READ TABLE count_values INDEX sy-tabix INTO current_count.
            current_count = current_count + 1.
            MODIFY count_values INDEX sy-tabix FROM current_count.
            IF current_count > max_count.
              max_count = current_count.
            ENDIF.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        IF found = abap_false.
          APPEND letter TO count_keys.
          APPEND 1 TO count_values.
          IF 1 > max_count.
            max_count = 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    output_str = '{'.
    LOOP AT count_keys INTO letter_key.
      index = sy-tabix.
      READ TABLE count_values INDEX index INTO current_count.
      IF current_count = max_count.
        IF output_str <> '{'.
          CONCATENATE output_str ',' INTO output_str.
        ENDIF.
        CONCATENATE output_str '"' letter_key '":' current_count INTO output_str.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    CONCATENATE output_str '}' INTO output_str.

    result = output_str.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_histogram IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_histogram .
    DATA letters TYPE TABLE OF string .
    DATA letter TYPE string .
    DATA temp_letter TYPE string .
    DATA max_count TYPE i VALUE 0 .
    DATA current_count TYPE i .
    DATA processed TYPE TABLE OF string .
    DATA is_processed TYPE abap_bool .

    CLEAR result .

    IF input IS INITIAL .
      RETURN .
    ENDIF .

    SPLIT input AT space INTO TABLE letters .

    LOOP AT letters INTO letter .
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL .
        current_count = 0 .
        LOOP AT letters INTO temp_letter .
          IF temp_letter = letter .
            current_count = current_count + 1 .
          ENDIF .
        ENDLOOP .
        IF current_count > max_count .
          max_count = current_count .
        ENDIF .
      ENDIF .
    ENDLOOP .

    LOOP AT letters INTO letter .
      IF letter IS NOT INITIAL .
        is_processed = abap_false .
        LOOP AT processed INTO temp_letter .
          IF temp_letter = letter .
            is_processed = abap_true .
            EXIT .
          ENDIF .
        ENDLOOP .

        IF is_processed = abap_false .
          current_count = 0 .
          LOOP AT letters INTO temp_letter .
            IF temp_letter = letter .
              current_count = current_count + 1 .
            ENDIF .
          ENDLOOP .
          IF current_count = max_count .
            APPEND letter TO result .
          ENDIF .
          APPEND letter TO processed .
        ENDIF .
      ENDIF .
    ENDLOOP .

  ENDMETHOD .
ENDCLASS .

CLASS z_by_length IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD convert_array.
    DATA: filtered_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF n,
          sorted_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF n,
          digit_name TYPE string,
          digit_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string,
          idx TYPE n,
          arr_size TYPE n,
          num TYPE n,
          digit TYPE n.

    " Initialize digit name mapping
    digit_map = VALUE #(
      ( 'One' )
      ( 'Two' )
      ( 'Three' )
      ( 'Four' )
      ( 'Five' )
      ( 'Six' )
      ( 'Seven' )
      ( 'Eight' )
      ( 'Nine' )
    ).

    " Filter array to keep only integers between 1 and 9
    LOOP AT arr INTO num.
      IF num >= 1 AND num <= 9.
        APPEND num TO filtered_arr.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sort the filtered array
    sorted_arr = filtered_arr.
    SORT sorted_arr.

    " Reverse the sorted array and convert to names
    arr_size = LINES( sorted_arr ).
    LOOP FROM arr_size DOWN TO 1 INTO idx.
      READ TABLE sorted_arr INTO digit INDEX idx.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        READ TABLE digit_map INTO digit_name INDEX digit.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND digit_name TO result.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_by_length IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD convert_to_words.
    DATA: filtered_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF NUMC,
          sorted_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF NUMC,
          digit_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF STRING,
          digit_name TYPE STRING,
          num TYPE NUMC,
          idx TYPE NUMC,
          temp_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF NUMC.

    " Initialize digit map
    INSERT "One" INTO TABLE digit_map.
    INSERT "Two" INTO TABLE digit_map.
    INSERT "Three" INTO TABLE digit_map.
    INSERT "Four" INTO TABLE digit_map.
    INSERT "Five" INTO TABLE digit_map.
    INSERT "Six" INTO TABLE digit_map.
    INSERT "Seven" INTO TABLE digit_map.
    INSERT "Eight" INTO TABLE digit_map.
    INSERT "Nine" INTO TABLE digit_map.

    " Filter array - keep only integers between 1 and 9 inclusive
    LOOP AT arr INTO num.
      IF num >= 1 AND num <= 9.
        INSERT num INTO TABLE filtered_arr.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sort the filtered array
    sorted_arr = filtered_arr.
    SORT sorted_arr.

    " Reverse the sorted array
    temp_arr = sorted_arr.
    CLEAR sorted_arr.

    LOOP AT temp_arr INTO num.
      INSERT num INTO sorted_arr INDEX 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Convert each digit to its word representation
    LOOP AT sorted_arr INTO num.
      digit_name = digit_map[ num ].
      INSERT digit_name INTO TABLE result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS is_valid_hierarchy RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_all_employees TYPE SORTED TABLE OF abap.char(20) WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA lt_managers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF abap.char(20) WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA lt_visited TYPE SORTED TABLE OF abap.char(20) WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA lt_stack TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_current TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA ls_entry TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA ls_map TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_manager_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_employee_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_has_manager TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lt_manager_map TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      INSERT ls_entry-employee_id INTO TABLE lt_all_employees.
      INSERT ls_entry-supervisor_id INTO TABLE lt_managers.

      LOOP AT lt_manager_map INTO ls_map WHERE employee_id = ls_entry-employee_id.
        RETURN.
      ENDLOOP.

      INSERT VALUE #( employee_id = ls_entry-employee_id supervisor_id = ls_entry-supervisor_id ) INTO TABLE lt_manager_map.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_managers INTO lv_manager_id.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = lv_manager_id ] ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO lv_employee_id.
      lv_has_manager = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry WHERE employee_id = lv_employee_id.
        lv_has_manager = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_has_manager = abap_false.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_employee_id.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT lv_ceo_id INTO TABLE lt_stack.
    INSERT lv_ceo_id INTO TABLE lt_visited.

    lv_index = 1.
    WHILE lv_index <= lines( lt_stack ).
      lv_current = lt_stack[ lv_index ].
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX lv_index.
      lv_index = 1.

      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
        IF NOT line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = ls_entry-employee_id ] ).
          INSERT ls_entry-employee_id INTO TABLE lt_visited.
          INSERT ls_entry-employee_id INTO TABLE lt_stack.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lines( lt_visited ) <> lines( lt_all_employees ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_valid = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS is_valid_hierarchy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_all_employees TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_connected_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_current_emp TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_steps TYPE i.
    DATA lv_max_steps TYPE i.
    DATA lt_employees_with_manager TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA ls_entry TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_emp TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA ls_manager TYPE zorg_structure.

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = ls_entry-employee_id ] ).
        APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = ls_entry-supervisor_id ] ).
        APPEND ls_entry-supervisor_id TO lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_employees_with_manager.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO lv_emp.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_employees_with_manager[ table_line = lv_emp ] ).
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_emp.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_max_steps = lines( lt_all_employees ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO lv_current_emp.
      CLEAR lt_visited.
      lv_steps = 0.
      lv_has_cycle = abap_false.

      WHILE lv_current_emp IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_steps < lv_max_steps.
        IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_current_emp ] ).
          lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        APPEND lv_current_emp TO lt_visited.

        READ TABLE lt_org_structure INTO ls_manager
          WITH KEY employee_id = lv_current_emp.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_current_emp = ls_manager-supervisor_id.
        ELSE.
          lv_current_emp = ''.
        ENDIF.

        lv_steps = lv_steps + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_current_emp <> lv_ceo_id AND lv_current_emp <> ''.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_current_emp = lv_ceo_id OR lv_current_emp = ''.
        lv_connected_count = lv_connected_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_connected_count = lines( lt_all_employees ).
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS is_valid_hierarchy RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_connected_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_all_ids TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_all_ids.
      APPEND ls_entry-supervisor_id TO lt_all_ids.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_all_ids.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_all_ids.

    DATA lt_has_manager TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_has_manager.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_has_manager.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_has_manager.

    LOOP AT lt_all_ids INTO DATA(lv_id).
      READ TABLE lt_has_manager WITH KEY table_line = lv_id TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc NE 0.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_id.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count NE 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_manager_count TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    lt_manager_count = lt_org_structure.
    SORT lt_manager_count BY employee_id.

    DATA lv_prev_employee TYPE abap.char(20) VALUE ''.
    DATA lv_manager_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    LOOP AT lt_manager_count INTO ls_entry.
      IF ls_entry-employee_id NE lv_prev_employee.
        IF lv_manager_count > 1.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_prev_employee = ls_entry-employee_id.
        lv_manager_count = 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_manager_count = lv_manager_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_manager_count > 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_rec_stack TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_stack TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).

    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lt_stack.
    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lt_visited.

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_current) = lt_stack[ lines( lt_stack ) ].
      DELETE lt_stack INDEX lines( lt_stack ).

      APPEND lv_current TO lt_rec_stack.

      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry WHERE employee_id = lv_current.
        DATA(lv_manager) = ls_entry-supervisor_id.

        READ TABLE lt_rec_stack WITH KEY table_line = lv_manager TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        READ TABLE lt_visited WITH KEY table_line = lv_manager TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc NE 0.
          APPEND lv_manager TO lt_visited.
          APPEND lv_manager TO lt_stack.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      DELETE lt_rec_stack WHERE table_line = lv_current.
    ENDWHILE.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    DATA lt_queue TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lt_queue.
    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lt_visited.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_current = lt_queue[ 1 ].
      DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.

      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
        READ TABLE lt_visited WITH KEY table_line = ls_entry-employee_id TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc NE 0.
          APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_visited.
          APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_queue.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_connected_count = lines( lt_visited ).

    IF lv_connected_count NE lines( lt_all_ids ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_valid = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_visited_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_total_employees TYPE i.
    DATA lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_all_employees TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_managers TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_employee_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_supervisor_id TYPE abap.char(20).

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      lv_employee_id = ls_entry-employee_id.
      lv_supervisor_id = ls_entry-supervisor_id.

      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = lv_employee_id ] ).
        APPEND lv_employee_id TO lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.

      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = lv_supervisor_id ] ).
        APPEND lv_supervisor_id TO lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.

      IF NOT line_exists( lt_managers[ table_line = lv_supervisor_id ] ).
        APPEND lv_supervisor_id TO lt_managers.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO lv_employee_id.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_org_structure[ employee_id = lv_employee_id ] ).
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_employee_id.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      DATA lv_current_id TYPE abap.char(20) VALUE ls_entry-employee_id.
      DATA lv_next_id TYPE abap.char(20).
      CLEAR lt_visited.

      WHILE lv_current_id IS NOT INITIAL.
        IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_current_id ] ).
          lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        APPEND lv_current_id TO lt_visited.

        READ TABLE lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_manager_entry)
          WITH KEY employee_id = lv_current_id.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_next_id = ls_manager_entry-supervisor_id.
        ELSE.
          lv_next_id = space.
        ENDIF.

        lv_current_id = lv_next_id.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    DATA lv_current_emp TYPE abap.char(20) VALUE lv_ceo_id.

    WHILE lv_current_emp IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_current_emp ] ).
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_current_emp TO lt_visited.

      READ TABLE lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry
        WITH KEY employee_id = lv_current_emp.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_current_emp = ls_entry-supervisor_id.
      ELSE.
        lv_current_emp = space.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_visited_count = lines( lt_visited ).
    lv_total_employees = lines( lt_all_employees ).

    IF lv_visited_count = lv_total_employees.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS .

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS is_valid_hierarchy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lt_all_employees TYPE TABLE OF abap_char20.
    DATA lt_employees_with_manager TYPE TABLE OF abap_char20.
    DATA ls_entry TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_employee_id TYPE abap_char20.
    DATA lv_supervisor_id TYPE abap_char20.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap_char20.
    DATA lv_connected_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF abap_char20.
    DATA lv_current TYPE abap_char20.
    DATA lv_next TYPE abap_char20.
    DATA lt_to_visit TYPE TABLE OF abap_char20.
    DATA lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i.

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SORT lt_org_structure BY employee_id supervisor_id.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_org_structure.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      lv_employee_id = ls_entry-employee_id.
      lv_supervisor_id = ls_entry-supervisor_id.

      IF lv_employee_id = lv_supervisor_id.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_employee_id TO lt_all_employees.
      APPEND lv_employee_id TO lt_employees_with_manager.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_all_employees.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_all_employees.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      APPEND ls_entry-supervisor_id TO lt_all_employees.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_all_employees.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_all_employees.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      lv_supervisor_id = ls_entry-supervisor_id.
      READ TABLE lt_employees_with_manager TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY table_line = lv_supervisor_id.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_supervisor_id.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      lv_employee_id = ls_entry-employee_id.
      lv_current = lv_employee_id.
      CLEAR lt_visited.
      lv_has_cycle = abap_false.

      DO 1000 TIMES.
        READ TABLE lt_visited TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
          WITH KEY table_line = lv_current.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        APPEND lv_current TO lt_visited.

        READ TABLE lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry
          WITH KEY employee_id = lv_current.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        lv_next = ls_entry-supervisor_id.
        IF lv_next IS INITIAL.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        lv_current = lv_next.
      ENDDO.

      IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    CLEAR lt_to_visit.
    lv_count = 0.

    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lt_to_visit.

    WHILE lt_to_visit IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_current = lt_to_visit[ 1 ].
      DELETE lt_to_visit INDEX 1.

      READ TABLE lt_visited TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY table_line = lv_current.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_current TO lt_visited.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.

      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry
        WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
        APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_to_visit.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_connected_count = lv_count.

    IF lv_connected_count = LINES( lt_all_employees ).
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_all_employees TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_connected_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_current TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_next TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_steps TYPE i.
    DATA lv_max_steps TYPE i.
    DATA lt_employees_with_manager TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_reachable TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_queue TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA ls_entry TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA ls_mgr TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA ls_direct TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_emp TYPE abap.char(20).

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = ls_entry-employee_id ] ).
        APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = ls_entry-supervisor_id ] ).
        APPEND ls_entry-supervisor_id TO lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_employees_with_manager.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO lv_emp.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_employees_with_manager[ table_line = lv_emp ] ).
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_emp.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_max_steps = lines( lt_all_employees ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO lv_current.
      CLEAR lt_visited.
      lv_steps = 0.
      lv_next = lv_current.

      WHILE lv_next IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_steps <= lv_max_steps.
        IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_next ] ).
          lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND lv_next TO lt_visited.

        READ TABLE lt_org_structure INTO ls_mgr
          WITH KEY employee_id = lv_next.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_next = ls_mgr-supervisor_id.
        ELSE.
          lv_next = space.
        ENDIF.
        lv_steps = lv_steps + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_steps > lv_max_steps.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lt_reachable.
    CLEAR lt_queue.
    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lt_queue.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INTO lv_current INDEX 1.
      DELETE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      APPEND lv_current TO lt_reachable.

      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_direct
        WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
        APPEND ls_direct-employee_id TO lt_queue.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_connected_count = lines( lt_reachable ).

    IF lv_connected_count = lines( lt_all_employees ).
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
