CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_all_employees TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_employee_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_supervisor_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_has_supervisor TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_current TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_next TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_visited_count TYPE i.
    DATA ls_org TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA rv_valid TYPE abap_bool.

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_org.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = ls_org-employee_id ] ).
        INSERT ls_org-employee_id INTO TABLE lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = ls_org-supervisor_id ] ).
        INSERT ls_org-supervisor_id INTO TABLE lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO lv_employee_id.
      lv_has_supervisor = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_org WHERE employee_id = lv_employee_id.
        IF lv_has_supervisor = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_has_supervisor = abap_true.
        lv_supervisor_id = ls_org-supervisor_id.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_has_supervisor = abap_false.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_employee_id.
        IF lv_ceo_count > 1.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    lv_current = lv_ceo_id.

    WHILE lv_current IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_current ] ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      INSERT lv_current INTO TABLE lt_visited.

      CLEAR lv_next.
      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_org WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current.
        IF lv_next IS NOT INITIAL.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_next = ls_org-employee_id.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_current = lv_next.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_visited_count = lines( lt_visited ).
    IF lv_visited_count <> lines( lt_all_employees ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_valid = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS is_valid_hierarchy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE string.
    DATA lt_all_employees TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_connected_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_supervisors TYPE TABLE OF string.
    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      APPEND ls_entry-supervisor_id TO lt_supervisors.
      APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_all_employees.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_all_employees.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_all_employees.

    SORT lt_supervisors.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_supervisors.

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO DATA(lv_emp).
      DATA(lv_is_supervisor) = abap_false.
      READ TABLE lt_supervisors TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY table_line = lv_emp BINARY SEARCH.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_is_supervisor = abap_true.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_is_supervisor = abap_false.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_emp.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_check)
        WHERE employee_id = ls_entry-employee_id.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_count > 1.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    IF has_cycle( lt_org_structure lv_ceo_id lt_visited ) = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    lv_connected_count = count_connected( lt_org_structure lv_ceo_id lt_visited ).

    IF lv_connected_count = LINES( lt_all_employees ).
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

FUNCTION has_cycle.
  IMPORTING
    pt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure
    pv_current_id TYPE string
    pt_visited TYPE TABLE OF string
  RETURNING
    VALUE(rv_has_cycle) TYPE abap_bool.

  rv_has_cycle = abap_false.

  READ TABLE pt_visited TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
    WITH KEY table_line = pv_current_id.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    rv_has_cycle = abap_true.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  APPEND pv_current_id TO pt_visited.

  LOOP AT pt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry)
    WHERE employee_id = pv_current_id.
    IF has_cycle( pt_org_structure ls_entry-supervisor_id pt_visited ) = abap_true.
      rv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFUNCTION.

FUNCTION count_connected.
  IMPORTING
    pt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure
    pv_current_id TYPE string
    pt_visited TYPE TABLE OF string
  RETURNING
    VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  rv_count = 0.

  READ TABLE pt_visited TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
    WITH KEY table_line = pv_current_id.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  APPEND pv_current_id TO pt_visited.
  rv_count = 1.

  LOOP AT pt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry)
    WHERE employee_id = pv_current_id.
    rv_count = rv_count + count_connected( pt_org_structure ls_entry-supervisor_id pt_visited ).
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFUNCTION.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS is_valid_hierarchy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE string.
    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_connected_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lt_manager_map TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lt_employee_set TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA lt_manager_set TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA lv_depth TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_max_depth TYPE i.

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      INSERT ls_entry-employee_id INTO TABLE lt_employee_set.
      INSERT ls_entry-supervisor_id INTO TABLE lt_manager_set.

      DATA(lv_existing) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_manager_map INTO DATA(ls_map).
        IF ls_map-employee_id = ls_entry-employee_id.
          lv_existing = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_existing = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      INSERT VALUE #( employee_id = ls_entry-employee_id supervisor_id = ls_entry-supervisor_id ) INTO TABLE lt_manager_map.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_manager_set INTO DATA(lv_manager).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_employee_set[ table_line = lv_manager ] ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_employee_set INTO DATA(lv_employee).
      DATA(lv_has_manager) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_manager_set INTO DATA(lv_mgr).
        IF lv_mgr = lv_employee.
          lv_has_manager = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_has_manager = abap_false.
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_employee.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    lv_max_depth = lines( lt_employee_set ).

    _check_cycle( EXPORTING pt_manager_map = lt_manager_map
                            pv_current = lv_ceo_id
                            pv_depth = lv_depth
                            pv_max_depth = lv_max_depth
                  IMPORTING pt_visited = lt_visited
                            pv_has_cycle = lv_has_cycle ).

    IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    _count_reachable( EXPORTING pt_manager_map = lt_manager_map
                               pv_current = lv_ceo_id
                      IMPORTING pt_visited = lt_visited
                                pv_count = lv_connected_count ).

    IF lv_connected_count = lines( lt_employee_set ).
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _check_cycle.
    IMPORTING pt_manager_map TYPE TABLE
              pv_current TYPE string
              pv_depth TYPE i
              pv_max_depth TYPE i
    IMPORTING pt_visited TYPE TABLE
              pv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool.

    IF pv_depth > pv_max_depth.
      pv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF line_exists( pt_visited[ table_line = pv_current ] ).
      pv_has_cycle = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT pv_current INTO TABLE pt_visited.

    LOOP AT pt_manager_map INTO DATA(ls_map).
      IF ls_map-employee_id = pv_current.
        _check_cycle( EXPORTING pt_manager_map = pt_manager_map
                               pv_current = ls_map-supervisor_id
                               pv_depth = pv_depth + 1
                               pv_max_depth = pv_max_depth
                      IMPORTING pt_visited = pt_visited
                                pv_has_cycle = pv_has_cycle ).
        IF pv_has_cycle = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _count_reachable.
    IMPORTING pt_manager_map TYPE TABLE
              pv_current TYPE string
    IMPORTING pt_visited TYPE TABLE
              pv_count TYPE i.

    IF line_exists( pt_visited[ table_line = pv_current ] ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT pv_current INTO TABLE pt_visited.
    pv_count = pv_count + 1.

    LOOP AT pt_manager_map INTO DATA(ls_map).
      IF ls_map-supervisor_id = pv_current.
        _count_reachable( EXPORTING pt_manager_map = pt_manager_map
                                   pv_current = ls_map-employee_id
                          IMPORTING pt_visited = pt_visited
                                    pv_count = pv_count ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS is_valid_hierarchy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_hierarchy.
    DATA lt_org_structure TYPE TABLE OF zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_ceo_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_ceo_id TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_all_employees TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_visited TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_has_cycle TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA lv_connected_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA ls_entry TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_emp TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_current TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_next TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA ls_manager TYPE zorg_structure.
    DATA lv_stack TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).
    DATA lv_current_emp TYPE abap.char(20).
    DATA lt_employees_with_manager TYPE TABLE OF abap.char(20).

    rv_valid = abap_false.

    SELECT * FROM zorg_structure INTO TABLE @lt_org_structure.

    IF lt_org_structure IS INITIAL.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = ls_entry-employee_id ] ).
        APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_all_employees[ table_line = ls_entry-supervisor_id ] ).
        APPEND ls_entry-supervisor_id TO lt_all_employees.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_employees_with_manager.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_all_employees INTO lv_emp.
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_employees_with_manager[ table_line = lv_emp ] ).
        lv_ceo_count = lv_ceo_count + 1.
        lv_ceo_id = lv_emp.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_ceo_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry.
      lv_current = ls_entry-employee_id.
      CLEAR lt_visited.

      WHILE lv_current IS NOT INITIAL.
        IF line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = lv_current ] ).
          lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND lv_current TO lt_visited.

        READ TABLE lt_org_structure INTO ls_manager
          WITH KEY employee_id = lv_current.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_next = ls_manager-supervisor_id.
        ELSE.
          CLEAR lv_next.
        ENDIF.

        lv_current = lv_next.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_has_cycle = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lt_visited.
    CLEAR lv_stack.
    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lv_stack.
    APPEND lv_ceo_id TO lt_visited.

    WHILE lv_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_current_emp = lv_stack[ 1 ].
      DELETE lv_stack INDEX 1.

      lv_connected_count = lv_connected_count + 1.

      LOOP AT lt_org_structure INTO ls_entry
        WHERE supervisor_id = lv_current_emp.
        IF NOT line_exists( lt_visited[ table_line = ls_entry-employee_id ] ).
          APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lt_visited.
          APPEND ls_entry-employee_id TO lv_stack.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_connected_count = lines( lt_all_employees ).
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_power IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_simple_power.
    DATA power TYPE i.
    DATA exponent TYPE i.

    result = abap_false.
    power = 1.

    IF n <= 0 OR n = 1.
      IF x = 1 AND n > 0.
        result = abap_true.

    WHILE power < x.
      power = power * n.
      exponent = exponent + 1.

    IF power = x.
      result = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_derivative DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING iv_coefficients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF F
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF F.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_derivative IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_derivative.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_coefficient TYPE f.
    DATA lv_derivative TYPE f.

    LOOP AT iv_coefficients INTO lv_coefficient FROM 2.
      lv_index = sy-tabix.
      lv_derivative = ( lv_index - 1 ) * lv_coefficient.
      APPEND lv_derivative TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_coefficients TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
    .

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_derivative IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD derivative.
    DATA: lt_coefficients TYPE TABLE OF f8,
          lt_result TYPE TABLE OF f8,
          lv_index TYPE i,
          lv_coefficient TYPE f8,
          lv_power TYPE i,
          lv_derivative_coeff TYPE f8,
          lv_input_str TYPE string,
          lv_output_str TYPE string,
          lv_token TYPE string,
          lv_pos TYPE i.

    lv_input_str = iv_coefficients.

    WHILE lv_input_str IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_pos = find( val = lv_input_str sub = ',' ).
      IF lv_pos > 0.
        lv_token = substring( val = lv_input_str len = lv_pos - 1 ).
        lv_input_str = substring( val = lv_input_str off = lv_pos + 1 ).
      ELSE.
        lv_token = lv_input_str.
        lv_input_str = ''.
      ENDIF.

      lv_token = condense( lv_token ).
      IF lv_token IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND CONV f8( lv_token ) TO lt_coefficients.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    CLEAR lt_result.

    lv_power = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_coefficients INTO lv_coefficient FROM 2.
      lv_derivative_coeff = lv_coefficient * lv_power.
      APPEND lv_derivative_coeff TO lt_result.
      lv_power = lv_power + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lv_output_str.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO lv_derivative_coeff.
      IF lv_output_str IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_output_str = lv_output_str && ','.
      ENDIF.
      lv_output_str = lv_output_str && |{ lv_derivative_coeff }|.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = lv_output_str.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    rv_encrypted = ''.

  METHOD rotate_char.
    DATA lv_char_code TYPE i.
    DATA lv_rotated_code TYPE i.
    DATA lv_is_lower TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_is_upper TYPE abap_bool.

    lv_char_code = cl_abap_char_utilities=>char_to_byte( iv_char ).

      lv_is_upper = abap_true.

      lv_rotated_code = lv_char_code + 4.
      IF lv_rotated_code > 122.
        lv_rotated_code = lv_rotated_code - 26.
      ENDIF.
      rv_rotated = cl_abap_char_utilities=>byte_to_char( lv_rotated_code ).
    ELSEIF lv_is_upper = abap_true.
      lv_rotated_code = lv_char_code + 4.
      IF lv_rotated_code > 90.
        lv_rotated_code = lv_rotated_code - 26.
      ENDIF.
      rv_rotated = cl_abap_char_utilities=>byte_to_char( lv_rotated_code ).

CLASS zcl_fibfib DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS compute_fibfib
      IMPORTING iv_n TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fibfib IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compute_fibfib.
    DATA lv_a TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_b TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_c TYPE i VALUE 1.
    DATA lv_temp TYPE i.

    IF iv_n = 0 OR iv_n = 1.
      rv_result = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_n = 2.
      rv_result = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO iv_n - 2 TIMES.
      lv_temp = lv_a + lv_b + lv_c.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_c.
      lv_c = lv_temp.
    ENDDO.

    rv_result = lv_c.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_fibfib DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS compute_fibfib
      IMPORTING n TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE i .
ENDCLASS .

CLASS z_fibfib IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compute_fibfib .
    DATA lv_n TYPE i .
    DATA lv_a TYPE i VALUE 0 .
    DATA lv_b TYPE i VALUE 0 .
    DATA lv_c TYPE i VALUE 1 .
    DATA lv_temp TYPE i .

    lv_n = n .

    IF lv_n = 0 OR lv_n = 1 .
      result = 0 .
      RETURN .
    ENDIF .

      WHILE num MOD divisor = 0.

CLASS z_algebra_evaluator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD evaluate.
    DATA: current_value TYPE i.
    DATA: temp_value TYPE i.
    DATA: operator_index TYPE i.
    DATA: operator TYPE char20.
    DATA: operand TYPE i.
    DATA: exponent_result TYPE i.
    DATA: exponent_count TYPE i.

    DATA: operators_with_precedence TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF char20.
    DATA: operands_with_precedence TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.

    APPEND LINES OF operators TO operators_with_precedence.
    APPEND LINES OF operands TO operands_with_precedence.

    operator_index = 1.
    WHILE operator_index <= lines( operators_with_precedence ).
      READ TABLE operators_with_precedence INDEX operator_index INTO operator.
      IF operator = '**'.
        READ TABLE operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index INTO current_value.
        READ TABLE operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index + 1 INTO operand.

        exponent_result = current_value.
        exponent_count = operand.
        WHILE exponent_count > 1.
          exponent_result = exponent_result * current_value.
          exponent_count = exponent_count - 1.
        ENDWHILE.

        MODIFY operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index FROM exponent_result.
        DELETE operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index + 1.
        DELETE operators_with_precedence INDEX operator_index.
      ELSE.
        operator_index = operator_index + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    operator_index = 1.
    WHILE operator_index <= lines( operators_with_precedence ).
      READ TABLE operators_with_precedence INDEX operator_index INTO operator.
      IF operator = '*' OR operator = '//'.
        READ TABLE operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index INTO current_value.
        READ TABLE operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index + 1 INTO operand.

        IF operator = '*'.
          temp_value = current_value * operand.
        ELSE.
          temp_value = current_value / operand.
        ENDIF.

        MODIFY operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index FROM temp_value.
        DELETE operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index + 1.
        DELETE operators_with_precedence INDEX operator_index.
      ELSE.
        operator_index = operator_index + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    READ TABLE operands_with_precedence INDEX 1 INTO current_value.
    operator_index = 1.
    WHILE operator_index <= lines( operators_with_precedence ).
      READ TABLE operators_with_precedence INDEX operator_index INTO operator.
      READ TABLE operands_with_precedence INDEX operator_index + 1 INTO operand.

      IF operator = '+'.
        current_value = current_value + operand.
      ELSEIF operator = '-'.
        current_value = current_value - operand.
      ENDIF.

      operator_index = operator_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = current_value.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_planets_between IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD bf.
    DATA: planets TYPE stringtab.
    DATA: index1 TYPE i VALUE -1.
    DATA: index2 TYPE i VALUE -1.
    DATA: start_index TYPE i.
    DATA: end_index TYPE i.
    DATA: temp_index TYPE i.
    DATA: planet TYPE string.

    planets = VALUE #(
      ( `Mercury` )
      ( `Venus` )
      ( `Earth` )
      ( `Mars` )
      ( `Jupiter` )
      ( `Saturn` )
      ( `Uranus` )
      ( `Neptune` )
    ).

    LOOP AT planets INTO planet.
      IF planet = planet1.
        index1 = sy-tabix - 1.
      ENDIF.
      IF planet = planet2.
        index2 = sy-tabix - 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF index1 = -1 OR index2 = -1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF index1 > index2.
      temp_index = index1.
      index1 = index2.
      index2 = temp_index.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR result.
    start_index = index1 + 1.
    end_index = index2 - 1.

    IF start_index <= end_index.
      LOOP AT planets INTO planet FROM start_index + 1 TO end_index + 1.
        APPEND planet TO result.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_is_palindrome DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_palindrome
      IMPORTING text TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool
      .

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_is_palindrome IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_palindrome.
    DATA: length TYPE i,
          i TYPE i,
          j TYPE i,
          char_i TYPE c,
          char_j TYPE c.

    length = strlen( text ).

    IF length = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    i = 0.
    j = length - 1.

    WHILE i < j.
      char_i = text+i(1).
      char_j = text+j(1).

      IF char_i <> char_j.
        result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      i = i + 1.
      j = j - 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_is_palindrome DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_palindrome
      IMPORTING text TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS z_is_palindrome IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_palindrome.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_char_left TYPE c.
    DATA lv_char_right TYPE c.

    lv_length = strlen( text ).
    result = abap_true.

    IF lv_length = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_index = 0.
    WHILE lv_index < lv_length / 2.
      lv_char_left = text+lv_index(1).
      lv_char_right = text+(lv_length - lv_index - 1)(1).

      IF lv_char_left <> lv_char_right.
        result = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_vowels_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_vowels.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_word_upper TYPE string.

    lv_word_upper = to_upper( iv_word ).
    lv_length = strlen( lv_word_upper ).

    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index - 1.
      lv_char = lv_word_upper+lv_index(1).

      IF lv_char = 'A' OR lv_char = 'E' OR lv_char = 'I' OR lv_char = 'O' OR lv_char = 'U'.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_char = 'Y' AND lv_index = lv_length - 1.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rv_count = lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_largest_prime_factor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_largest_prime_factor.
    DATA lv_n TYPE i.
    DATA lv_factor TYPE i.
    DATA lv_largest TYPE i.

    lv_n = iv_number.
    lv_largest = -1.

    lv_factor = 2.
    WHILE lv_factor * lv_factor <= lv_n.
      WHILE lv_n MOD lv_factor = 0.
        lv_largest = lv_factor.
        lv_n = lv_n / lv_factor.
      ENDWHILE.
      lv_factor = lv_factor + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_n > 1.
      lv_largest = lv_n.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = lv_largest.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcircular_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS circular_shift IMPORTING x TYPE i shift TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcircular_shift IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD circular_shift.
    DATA lv_x_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_len TYPE i.
    DATA lv_shift_normalized TYPE i.
    DATA lv_new_shift TYPE i.
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.
    DATA lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c.

    lv_x_str = CONV string( ABS( x ) ).
    lv_len = strlen( lv_x_str ).

    IF lv_len = 0.
      result = '0'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_shift_normalized = MOD( shift, lv_len ).

    IF lv_shift_normalized = 0.
      result = lv_x_str.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_new_shift = lv_len - lv_shift_normalized.

    lv_result = ''.
    DO lv_len TIMES.
      lv_i = sy-index - 1.
      lv_i = MOD( ( lv_i + lv_new_shift ), lv_len ).
      lv_char = lv_x_str+lv_i(1).
      CONCATENATE lv_result lv_char INTO lv_result.
    ENDDO.

    result = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcircular_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS: circular_shift
      IMPORTING
        x TYPE i
        shift TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcircular_shift IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD circular_shift.
    DATA lv_x_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_len TYPE i.
    DATA lv_actual_shift TYPE i.
    DATA lv_reversed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c.

    lv_x_str = CONV string( ABS( x ) ).
    lv_len = strlen( lv_x_str ).

    IF lv_len = 0.
      result = '0'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_actual_shift = MOD( shift, lv_len ).

    IF lv_actual_shift = 0.
      result = lv_x_str.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF shift > lv_len.
      lv_reversed = ''.
      DO lv_len TIMES.
        lv_i = lv_len - sy-index.
        lv_char = lv_x_str+lv_i(1).
        CONCATENATE lv_reversed lv_char INTO lv_reversed.
      ENDDO.
      result = lv_reversed.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    result = lv_x_str+lv_len-lv_actual_shift(lv_actual_shift) && lv_x_str(lv_len - lv_actual_shift).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcircular_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS circular_shift
      IMPORTING
        x     TYPE i
        shift TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE string
    .

CLASS zcircular_shift IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD circular_shift.
    DATA lv_x_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_len TYPE i.
    DATA lv_actual_shift TYPE i.
    DATA lv_start_pos TYPE i.
    DATA lv_part1 TYPE string.
    DATA lv_part2 TYPE string.

    lv_x_str = CONV string( ABS( x ) ).
    lv_len = strlen( lv_x_str ).

    IF lv_len = 0.
      result = '0'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF shift > lv_len.
      result = lv_x_str.
      result = reverse( result ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_actual_shift = MOD( shift, lv_len ).

    IF lv_actual_shift = 0.
      result = lv_x_str.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_start_pos = lv_len - lv_actual_shift + 1.
    lv_part1 = substring( val = lv_x_str off = lv_start_pos - 1 len = lv_actual_shift ).
    lv_part2 = substring( val = lv_x_str off = 0 len = lv_len - lv_actual_shift ).

    result = lv_part1 && lv_part2.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

      result = lv_x_str.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF shift > lv_len.
      result = lv_x_str.
      REVERSE result.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_effective_shift = shift MOD lv_len.

    IF lv_effective_shift = 0.
      result = lv_x_str.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_start_pos = lv_len - lv_effective_shift + 1.

    result = substring( val = lv_x_str
                        off = lv_start_pos - 1
                        len = lv_effective_shift ) &&
             substring( val = lv_x_str
                        off = 0
                        len = lv_len - lv_effective_shift ).
  ENDMETHOD.

      lv_index = ( lv_index + lv_new_shift ) MOD lv_len.

CLASS z_fruit_distribution IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_mangoes.
    DATA: lv_apples TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_oranges TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_space_pos TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_apples_str TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_oranges_str TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_and_pos TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_parts TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.

    SPLIT s AT ' ' INTO TABLE lv_parts.

    READ TABLE lv_parts INTO lv_apples_str INDEX 1.
    lv_apples = lv_apples_str.

    READ TABLE lv_parts INTO lv_oranges_str INDEX 3.
    lv_oranges = lv_oranges_str.

    r_mangoes = n - lv_apples - lv_oranges.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_fruit_distribution IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_mangoes.
    DATA: lv_apples TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_oranges TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_and_pos TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_apples_str TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_oranges_str TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_remaining_str TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_space_pos TYPE i.

    lv_and_pos = find( val = s sub = 'and' ).
    lv_apples_str = substring( val = s off = 0 len = lv_and_pos - 1 ).
    CONDENSE lv_apples_str.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'apples' IN lv_apples_str WITH ''.
    CONDENSE lv_apples_str.
    lv_apples = lv_apples_str.

    lv_remaining_str = substring( val = s off = lv_and_pos + 4 ).
    CONDENSE lv_remaining_str.
    lv_space_pos = find( val = lv_remaining_str sub = 'oranges' ).
    IF lv_space_pos > 0.
      lv_oranges_str = substring( val = lv_remaining_str off = 0 len = lv_space_pos - 1 ).
    ELSE.
      lv_oranges_str = lv_remaining_str.
    ENDIF.
    CONDENSE lv_oranges_str.
    lv_oranges = lv_oranges_str.

    r_mangoes = n - lv_apples - lv_oranges.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fruit_distribution IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_mangos.
    DATA lv_apples TYPE i.
    DATA lv_oranges TYPE i.
    DATA lv_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_pos_apples TYPE i.
    DATA lv_pos_oranges TYPE i.
    DATA lv_pos_and TYPE i.
    DATA lv_substring TYPE string.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.

    lv_string = is_fruit_string.

    lv_pos_apples = FIND( lv_string, 'apples' ).
    IF lv_pos_apples > 0.
      lv_substring = lv_string(lv_pos_apples - 1).
      lv_substring = CONDENSE( lv_substring ).
      lv_apples = CONV i( lv_substring ).
    ENDIF.

    lv_pos_and = FIND( lv_string, 'and' ).
    lv_pos_oranges = FIND( lv_string, 'oranges' ).
    IF lv_pos_oranges > 0 AND lv_pos_and > 0.
      lv_length = lv_pos_oranges - lv_pos_and - 3.
      lv_substring = lv_string+lv_pos_and(lv_length).
      lv_substring = CONDENSE( lv_substring ).
      lv_oranges = CONV i( lv_substring ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_mangos = iv_total_fruits - lv_apples - lv_oranges.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fruit_distribution IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_mangoes.
    DATA lv_apples TYPE i.
    DATA lv_oranges TYPE i.
    DATA lv_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_pos TYPE i.
    DATA lv_number_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_and_pos TYPE i.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c.

    lv_string = is_fruit_string.

    lv_pos = 0.
    lv_number_str = ''.
    WHILE lv_pos < strlen( lv_string ).
      lv_char = lv_string+lv_pos(1).
      IF lv_char >= '0' AND lv_char <= '9'.
        lv_number_str = lv_number_str && lv_char.
      ELSEIF lv_number_str <> ''.
        lv_apples = lv_number_str.
        lv_number_str = ''.
      ENDIF.
      lv_pos = lv_pos + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_and_pos = find( lv_string, 'and' ).
    lv_pos = lv_and_pos + 2.
    lv_number_str = ''.
    WHILE lv_pos < strlen( lv_string ).
      lv_char = lv_string+lv_pos(1).
      IF lv_char >= '0' AND lv_char <= '9'.
        lv_number_str = lv_number_str && lv_char.
      ELSEIF lv_number_str <> ''.
        lv_oranges = lv_number_str.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_pos = lv_pos + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_mangoes = iv_total_fruits - lv_apples - lv_oranges.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_fruit_distribution IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_mangoes.
    DATA: lv_apples TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_oranges TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_numbers TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: lv_temp_str TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_word TYPE string.

    lv_temp_str = s.

    SPLIT lv_temp_str AT ' ' INTO TABLE lv_numbers.

    LOOP AT lv_numbers INTO lv_word.
      lv_index = sy-tabix.
      IF lv_word = 'apples'.
        lv_apples = lv_numbers[ lv_index - 1 ].
      ELSEIF lv_word = 'oranges'.
        lv_oranges = lv_numbers[ lv_index - 1 ].
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    r_mangoes = n - lv_apples - lv_oranges.

CLASS z_fruit_distribution DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

        i_total_fruits TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(r_mangoes) TYPE i.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_fruit_distribution IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_mangoes.
    DATA lv_apples TYPE i.
    DATA lv_oranges TYPE i.
    DATA lv_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_number_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c.
    DATA lv_and_pos TYPE i.

    lv_string = i_fruit_string.

    lv_index = 0.
    lv_number_str = ''.
    WHILE lv_index < strlen( lv_string ).
      lv_char = lv_string+lv_index(1).
      IF lv_char >= '0' AND lv_char <= '9'.
        lv_number_str = lv_number_str && lv_char.
      ELSE.
        IF lv_number_str <> ''.
          lv_apples = lv_number_str.
          lv_number_str = ''.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_and_pos = find( lv_string, 'and' ).
    lv_and_pos = lv_and_pos + 3.
    lv_number_str = ''.

    WHILE lv_and_pos < strlen( lv_string )
      lv_char = lv_string+lv_and_pos(1).
      IF lv_char >= '0' AND lv_char <= '9'.
        lv_number_str = lv_number_str && lv_char.
      ENDIF.
      lv_and_pos = lv_and_pos + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_number_str <> ''.
      lv_oranges = lv_number_str.
    ENDIF.

    r_mangoes = i_total_fruits - lv_apples - lv_oranges.

  ENDMETHOD.

    lv_decimal = lv_number - lv_integer.

        result = lv_integer - 1.

CLASS zcl_will_it_fly DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_flight
      IMPORTING it_weights TYPE TABLE OF I
                iv_max_weight TYPE I
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_will_it_fly IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_flight.
    DATA lv_sum TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_size TYPE i.
    DATA lv_is_palindrome TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

    lv_size = LINES( it_weights ).

    IF lv_size = 0.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_weights INTO DATA(lv_weight).
      lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_weight.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_sum > iv_max_weight.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_index = 1.
    WHILE lv_index <= lv_size / 2.
      IF it_weights[ lv_index ] <> it_weights[ lv_size - lv_index + 1 ].
        lv_is_palindrome = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = lv_is_palindrome.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_largest_prime_digit_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS execute
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF numc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE numc.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_prime
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE numc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_prime) TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS-METHODS sum_of_digits
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE numc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE numc.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_largest_prime_digit_sum IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lv_largest_prime TYPE numc VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_number TYPE numc.

    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO lv_number.
      IF is_prime( lv_number ) = abap_true.
        IF lv_number > lv_largest_prime.
          lv_largest_prime = lv_number.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_largest_prime > 0.
      rv_result = sum_of_digits( lv_largest_prime ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_prime.
    rv_is_prime = abap_false.

    IF iv_number < 2.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number = 2.
      rv_is_prime = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number MOD 2 = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lv_i TYPE numc.
    DATA: lv_sqrt TYPE numc.

    lv_sqrt = SQRT( iv_number ).

    LOOP AT VALUE #( FOR i = 3 WHILE i <= lv_sqrt STEP 2 ( i ) ) INTO lv_i.
      IF iv_number MOD lv_i = 0.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_is_prime = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD sum_of_digits.
    DATA: lv_number TYPE numc.
    DATA: lv_digit TYPE numc.

    lv_number = iv_number.
    rv_sum = 0.

    WHILE lv_number > 0.
      lv_digit = lv_number MOD 10.
      rv_sum = rv_sum + lv_digit.
      lv_number = lv_number / 10.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_largest_prime_digit_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS execute
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF I
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE I.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_largest_prime_digit_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA lv_largest_prime TYPE I VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_current_number TYPE I.
    DATA lv_i TYPE I.
    DATA lv_sqrt TYPE I.
    DATA lv_is_prime TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_number TYPE I.
    DATA lv_digit TYPE I.
    DATA lv_sum TYPE I.

    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO lv_current_number.
      lv_is_prime = abap_true.

      IF lv_current_number < 2.
        lv_is_prime = abap_false.
      ELSEIF lv_current_number = 2.
        lv_is_prime = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lv_current_number MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_is_prime = abap_false.
      ELSE.
        lv_sqrt = SQRT( lv_current_number ).
        lv_i = 3.
        WHILE lv_i <= lv_sqrt.
          IF lv_current_number MOD lv_i = 0.
            lv_is_prime = abap_false.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          lv_i = lv_i + 2.
        ENDWHILE.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_is_prime = abap_true.
        IF lv_current_number > lv_largest_prime.
          lv_largest_prime = lv_current_number.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_largest_prime > 0.
      lv_number = lv_largest_prime.
      lv_sum = 0.
      WHILE lv_number > 0.
        lv_digit = lv_number MOD 10.
        lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_digit.
        lv_number = lv_number / 10.
      ENDWHILE.
      rv_result = lv_sum.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_largest_prime_digit_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF P
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE P.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_prime
      IMPORTING
        iv_number        TYPE P
      RETURNING

    CLASS-METHODS sum_of_digits
      IMPORTING

CLASS z_largest_prime_digit_sum IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_largest_prime_digit_sum.
    DATA lv_largest_prime TYPE P VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_number TYPE P.

    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO lv_number.
      IF is_prime( lv_number ) = abap_true.
        IF lv_number > lv_largest_prime.
          lv_largest_prime = lv_number.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_largest_prime > 0.
      rv_result = sum_of_digits( lv_largest_prime ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_prime.
    rv_result = abap_false.

    IF iv_number < 2.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number = 2.
      rv_result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number MOD 2 = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_i TYPE P.
    DATA lv_sqrt TYPE P.

    lv_sqrt = SQRT( iv_number ).

    DO lv_sqrt TIMES.
      lv_i = lv_i + 1.
      IF lv_i < 2.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      IF iv_number MOD lv_i = 0.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rv_result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD sum_of_digits.
    DATA lv_number TYPE P.

CLASS zcl_check_dict_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_dict_case
      IMPORTING it_dict TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_dict_case IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_dict_case.
    DATA lv_is_lower TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
    DATA lv_is_upper TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
    DATA lv_key TYPE string.
    DATA lv_key_lower TYPE string.
    DATA lv_key_upper TYPE string.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    rv_result = abap_false.

    LOOP AT it_dict ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_entry>).
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <ls_entry> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_key>).
      IF <lv_key> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_key = <lv_key>.

      IF lv_key IS INITIAL.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_key_lower = lv_key.
      lv_key_upper = lv_key.

      TRANSLATE lv_key_lower TO LOWER CASE.
      TRANSLATE lv_key_upper TO UPPER CASE.

      IF lv_key <> lv_key_lower.
        lv_is_lower = abap_false.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_key <> lv_key_upper.
        lv_is_upper = abap_false.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_is_lower = abap_false AND lv_is_upper = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_is_lower = abap_true OR lv_is_upper = abap_true.
      rv_result = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_dict_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_dict_case IMPORTING it_dict TYPE ANY RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_dict_case IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_dict_case.
    DATA: lv_is_lower TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
    DATA: lv_is_upper TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
    DATA: lv_key_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_current_key TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_key_lower TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_key_upper TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE abap_component_tab.

    rv_result = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_dict ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
          rv_result = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          lv_current_key = ls_component-name.
          lv_key_count = lv_key_count + 1.

          lv_key_lower = lv_current_key.
          lv_key_upper = lv_current_key.

          TRANSLATE lv_key_lower TO LOWER CASE.
          TRANSLATE lv_key_upper TO UPPER CASE.

          IF lv_current_key <> lv_key_lower.
            lv_is_lower = abap_false.
          ENDIF.

          IF lv_current_key <> lv_key_upper.
            lv_is_upper = abap_false.
          ENDIF.

        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_key_count = 0.
          rv_result = abap_false.
        ELSEIF lv_is_lower = abap_true OR lv_is_upper = abap_true.
          rv_result = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_result = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_dict_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_dict_case
      IMPORTING iv_dict TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_dict_case IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_dict_case.
    DATA: lt_keys TYPE TABLE OF string,
          lv_key TYPE string,
          lv_key_lower TYPE string,
          lv_key_upper TYPE string,
          lv_pos TYPE i,
          lv_char TYPE c,
          lv_all_lower TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_all_upper TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_key_count TYPE i,
          lv_dict TYPE string,
          lv_len TYPE i,
          lv_in_key TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_current_key TYPE string.

    rv_result = abap_false.

    lv_dict = iv_dict.
    lv_len = strlen( lv_dict ).

    IF lv_len < 3.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_dict = lv_dict+1(lv_len - 2).

    lv_pos = 0.
    lv_in_key = abap_false.
    lv_current_key = ''.

    DO strlen( lv_dict ) TIMES.
      lv_char = lv_dict+lv_pos(1).

      CASE lv_char.
        WHEN '"'.
          IF lv_in_key = abap_false.
            lv_in_key = abap_true.

CLASS zcl_right_angle_triangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_right_angle_triangle .
    DATA: lv_a_squared TYPE p DECIMALS 4,
          lv_b_squared TYPE p DECIMALS 4,
          lv_c_squared TYPE p DECIMALS 4,
          lv_sum TYPE p DECIMALS 4.

    lv_a_squared = iv_side_a * iv_side_a.
    lv_b_squared = iv_side_b * iv_side_b.
    lv_c_squared = iv_side_c * iv_side_c.

    lv_sum = lv_a_squared + lv_b_squared.

    IF lv_sum = lv_c_squared.
      rv_is_right_angle = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      lv_sum = lv_a_squared + lv_c_squared.
      IF lv_sum = lv_b_squared.
        rv_is_right_angle = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        lv_sum = lv_b_squared + lv_c_squared.
        IF lv_sum = lv_a_squared.
          rv_is_right_angle = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_right_angle = abap_false.

      ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_right_angle_triangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_right_angle_triangle.
    DATA lv_side_1 TYPE f.
    DATA lv_side_2 TYPE f.
    DATA lv_side_3 TYPE f.
    DATA lv_sum_squares TYPE f.
    DATA lv_hypotenuse_square TYPE f.
    DATA lv_tolerance TYPE f.

    lv_tolerance = 0.0000001.

    lv_side_1 = iv_side_a.
    lv_side_2 = iv_side_b.
    lv_side_3 = iv_side_c.

    IF lv_side_1 <= 0 OR lv_side_2 <= 0 OR lv_side_3 <= 0.
      rv_result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_side_1 > lv_side_2 AND lv_side_1 > lv_side_3.
      lv_sum_squares = lv_side_2 * lv_side_2 + lv_side_3 * lv_side_3.
      lv_hypotenuse_square = lv_side_1 * lv_side_1.
    ELSEIF lv_side_2 > lv_side_1 AND lv_side_2 > lv_side_3.
      lv_sum_squares = lv_side_1 * lv_side_1 + lv_side_3 * lv_side_3.
      lv_hypotenuse_square = lv_side_2 * lv_side_2.
    ELSE.
      lv_sum_squares = lv_side_1 * lv_side_1 + lv_side_2 * lv_side_2.
      lv_hypotenuse_square = lv_side_3 * lv_side_3.
    ENDIF.

    IF ABS( lv_sum_squares - lv_hypotenuse_square ) < lv_tolerance.
      rv_result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_parse_nested_parens IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD parse_nested_parens.
    DATA: groups TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: group TYPE string.
    DATA: char TYPE c.
    DATA: current_depth TYPE i.
    DATA: max_depth TYPE i.
    DATA: idx TYPE i.
    DATA: len TYPE i.

    CLEAR result.

    SPLIT paren_string AT space INTO TABLE groups.

    LOOP AT groups INTO group.
      CLEAR current_depth.
      CLEAR max_depth.
      len = strlen( group ).

      DO len TIMES.
        idx = sy-index - 1.
        char = group+idx(1).

        IF char = '('.
          ADD 1 TO current_depth.
          IF current_depth > max_depth.
            max_depth = current_depth.
          ENDIF.
        ELSEIF char = ')'.
          SUBTRACT 1 FROM current_depth.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.

      APPEND max_depth TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA: group TYPE string.
    DATA: char TYPE c.
    DATA: current_depth TYPE i.
    DATA: max_depth TYPE i.
    DATA: idx TYPE i.
    DATA: len TYPE i.

    SPLIT paren_string BY space INTO TABLE groups.

    LOOP AT groups INTO group.
      current_depth = 0.
      max_depth = 0.
      len = strlen( group ).

      DO len TIMES.
        idx = sy-index - 1.
        char = group+idx(1).

        IF char = '('.

          IF current_depth > max_depth.
            max_depth = current_depth.
          ENDIF.
        ELSEIF char = ')'.
          current_depth = current_depth - 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.

      APPEND max_depth TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

CLASS z_file_name_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_file_name.
    DATA: dot_count TYPE i,
          dot_pos TYPE i,
          name_part TYPE string,
          ext_part TYPE string,
          digit_count TYPE i,
          i TYPE i,
          char TYPE c,
          valid_ext TYPE abap_bool,
          len TYPE i.

    result = 'No'.

    IF file_name IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    len = strlen( file_name ).

    DO len TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      char = file_name+i(1).
      IF char = '.'.
        dot_count = dot_count + 1.
        dot_pos = i.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF dot_count <> 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF dot_pos = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    name_part = file_name(dot_pos).
    ext_part = file_name+dot_pos+1.

    IF ext_part IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF ext_part = 'txt' OR ext_part = 'exe' OR ext_part = 'dll'.
      valid_ext = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    IF valid_ext = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    char = name_part(1).
    IF ( char >= 'a' AND char <= 'z' ) OR ( char >= 'A' AND char <= 'Z' ).
    ELSE.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    digit_count = 0.
    len = strlen( name_part ).
    DO len TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      char = name_part+i(1).
      IF char >= '0' AND char <= '9'.
        digit_count = digit_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF digit_count > 3.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    result = 'Yes'.

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA i TYPE i.
    DATA char TYPE c.
    DATA valid_ext TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA second_dot TYPE i.

    result = 'No'.

    dot_pos = find( val = file_name sub = '.' ).

    IF dot_pos = 0 OR dot_pos = strlen( file_name ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    name_part = substring( val = file_name off = 0 len = dot_pos ).
    ext_part = substring( val = file_name off = dot_pos + 1 ).

    char = name_part+0(1).
    IF NOT ( ( char >= 'a' AND char <= 'z' ) OR ( char >= 'A' AND char <= 'Z' ) ).

        digit_count = digit_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF digit_count > 3.

    ENDIF.

    valid_ext = abap_false.

CLASS zcl_search_greatest_integer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search.

    DATA: lv_frequency TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_current_value TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_max_value TYPE i VALUE -1.
    DATA: lv_check_value TYPE i.

    IF it_list IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = -1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_list INTO lv_current_value.
      lv_frequency = 0.
      LOOP AT it_list INTO lv_check_value.
        IF lv_check_value = lv_current_value.
          lv_frequency = lv_frequency + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_frequency >= lv_current_value AND lv_current_value > 0.
        IF lv_current_value > lv_max_value.
          lv_max_value = lv_current_value.
          lv_result = lv_current_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_check> TYPE i.

    IF it_list IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = -1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_list ASSIGNING <fs_value>.
      lv_value = <fs_value>.

      IF lv_value > 0.
        lv_frequency = 0.
        LOOP AT it_list ASSIGNING <fs_check>.
          IF <fs_check> = lv_value.
            lv_frequency = lv_frequency + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_frequency >= lv_value AND lv_value > lv_max_result.
          lv_max_result = lv_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = lv_max_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_search_integer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS search
      IMPORTING
        lst TYPE TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE i .

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_search_integer IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD search.
    DATA: current_value TYPE i.
    DATA: max_result TYPE i VALUE -1.
    DATA: count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: prev_value TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: freq_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF RECORD ( value TYPE i, freq TYPE i ) WITH UNIQUE KEY value.
    DATA: freq_entry TYPE RECORD ( value TYPE i, freq TYPE i ).

    result = -1.

    IF lst IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SORT lst.

    LOOP AT lst INTO current_value.
      IF current_value <> prev_value.
        IF prev_value > 0 AND count > 0.
          freq_entry-value = prev_value.
          freq_entry-freq = count.
          INSERT freq_entry INTO TABLE freq_table.
        ENDIF.
        prev_value = current_value.
        count = 1.
      ELSE.
        count = count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF prev_value > 0 AND count > 0.
      freq_entry-value = prev_value.
      freq_entry-freq = count.
      INSERT freq_entry INTO TABLE freq_table.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT freq_table INTO freq_entry.
      IF freq_entry-freq >= freq_entry-value AND freq_entry-value > 0.
        IF freq_entry-value > max_result.
          max_result = freq_entry-value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    result = max_result.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_fraction_simplify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS simplify
      IMPORTING
        x TYPE string
        n TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_fraction_simplify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simplify.
    DATA x_num TYPE i.
    DATA x_den TYPE i.
    DATA n_num TYPE i.
    DATA n_den TYPE i.
    DATA slash_pos TYPE i.
    DATA product_num TYPE i.
    DATA product_den TYPE i.

    slash_pos = FIND( x, '/' ).
    x_num = SUBSTRING( x, 1, slash_pos - 1 ).
    x_den = SUBSTRING( x, slash_pos + 1 ).

    slash_pos = FIND( n, '/' ).
    n_num = SUBSTRING( n, 1, slash_pos - 1 ).
    n_den = SUBSTRING( n, slash_pos + 1 ).

    product_num = x_num * n_num.
    product_den = x_den * n_den.

    IF product_num MOD product_den = 0.
      result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_simplify_fraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS simplify
      IMPORTING x TYPE string n TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_simplify_fraction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simplify.
    DATA lv_x_num TYPE i.
    DATA lv_x_den TYPE i.
    DATA lv_n_num TYPE i.
    DATA lv_n_den TYPE i.
    DATA lv_result_num TYPE i.
    DATA lv_result_den TYPE i.
    DATA lv_gcd TYPE i.
    DATA lv_temp TYPE i.
    DATA lv_remainder TYPE i.
    DATA lv_x_part1 TYPE string.
    DATA lv_x_part2 TYPE string.
    DATA lv_n_part1 TYPE string.
    DATA lv_n_part2 TYPE string.

    SPLIT x AT '/' INTO lv_x_part1 lv_x_part2.
    lv_x_num = lv_x_part1.
    lv_x_den = lv_x_part2.

    SPLIT n AT '/' INTO lv_n_part1 lv_n_part2.
    lv_n_num = lv_n_part1.
    lv_n_den = lv_n_part2.

    lv_result_num = lv_x_num * lv_n_num.
    lv_result_den = lv_x_den * lv_n_den.

    lv_gcd = lv_result_num.
    lv_temp = lv_result_den.

    WHILE lv_temp <> 0.
      lv_remainder = lv_gcd MOD lv_temp.
      lv_gcd = lv_temp.
      lv_temp = lv_remainder.
    ENDWHILE.

    lv_result_num = lv_result_num / lv_gcd.
    lv_result_den = lv_result_den / lv_gcd.

    IF lv_result_den = 1.
      result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA product_num TYPE i.
    DATA product_den TYPE i.
    DATA gcd_value TYPE i.
    DATA temp TYPE i.
    DATA num_a TYPE i.
    DATA num_b TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_order_by_points DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS order_by_points
      IMPORTING iv_numbers TYPE STRING
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE STRING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_by_points IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD order_by_points.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number,
             value TYPE i,
             index TYPE i,
             digit_sum TYPE i,
           END OF ty_number.

    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF ty_number.
    DATA: lt_sorted TYPE TABLE OF ty_number.
    DATA: ls_number TYPE ty_number.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_number TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE STRING.
    DATA: lv_token TYPE STRING.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_length TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_digit TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_num TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_negative TYPE abap_bool.

    IF iv_numbers IS INITIAL OR iv_numbers = ''.
      rv_result = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_offset < strlen( iv_numbers ).
      lv_length = FIND( iv_numbers, ',', lv_offset ) - lv_offset.
      IF lv_length < 0.
        lv_length = strlen( iv_numbers ) - lv_offset.
      ENDIF.

      lv_token = substring( iv_numbers, lv_offset, lv_length ).
      lv_token = condense( lv_token ).

      IF lv_token IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_number = lv_token.
        ls_number-value = lv_number.
        ls_number-index = lv_index.

        lv_num = lv_number.
        lv_sum = 0.
        lv_negative = abap_false.

        IF lv_num < 0.
          lv_negative = abap_true.
          lv_num = lv_num * -1.
        ENDIF.

        WHILE lv_num > 0.
          lv_digit = lv_num MOD 10.
          lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_digit.
          lv_num = lv_num DIV 10.
        ENDWHILE.

        IF lv_negative = abap_true.
          lv_sum = lv_sum * -1.
        ENDIF.

        ls_number-digit_sum = lv_sum.
        APPEND ls_number TO lt_numbers.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDIF.

      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_length + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    lt_sorted = lt_numbers.
    SORT lt_sorted BY digit_sum ASCENDING index ASCENDING.

    CLEAR lv_result.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted INTO ls_number.
      IF lv_result IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_result = lv_result && ', '.
      ENDIF.
      lv_result = lv_result && ls_number-value.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    CLASS METHODS sort_by_digit_sum
      IMPORTING iv_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i .
ENDCLASS .

CLASS zcl_order_by_points IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_by_digit_sum .
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number_info,
             value TYPE i,
             digit_sum TYPE i,
             original_index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_number_info.

    DATA lt_number_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number_info.
    DATA ls_number_info TYPE ty_number_info.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_abs_value TYPE i.
    DATA lv_digit_sum TYPE i.
    DATA lv_digit TYPE i.
    DATA lv_temp TYPE i.

    LOOP AT iv_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      lv_index = sy-tabix - 1.
      lv_abs_value = ABS( lv_number ).
      lv_digit_sum = 0.
      lv_temp = lv_abs_value.

      WHILE lv_temp > 0.
        lv_digit = MOD( lv_temp, 10 ).
        lv_digit_sum = lv_digit_sum + lv_digit.
        lv_temp = lv_temp / 10.
      ENDWHILE.

      ls_number_info-value = lv_number.
      ls_number_info-digit_sum = lv_digit_sum.
      ls_number_info-original_index = lv_index.
      APPEND ls_number_info TO lt_number_info.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_number_info BY digit_sum ASCENDING original_index ASCENDING.

    LOOP AT lt_number_info INTO ls_number_info.
      APPEND ls_number_info-value TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD .
ENDCLASS .

CLASS zcl_order_by_points IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD order_by_points.
    DATA: lt_temp TYPE TABLE OF RECORD
            (
              value TYPE i,
              digit_sum TYPE i,
              original_index TYPE i
            ),
          ls_temp LIKE LINE OF lt_temp,
          lv_digit_sum TYPE i,
          lv_abs_value TYPE i,
          lv_digit TYPE i,
          lv_index TYPE i.

    CLEAR result.

    IF lines( nums ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_index = 0.
    LOOP AT nums INTO DATA(lv_num).
      lv_index = sy-tabix - 1.
      lv_abs_value = ABS( lv_num ).
      lv_digit_sum = 0.

      IF lv_abs_value = 0.
        lv_digit_sum = 0.
      ELSE.
        WHILE lv_abs_value > 0.
          lv_digit = MOD( lv_abs_value, 10 ).
          lv_digit_sum = lv_digit_sum + lv_digit.
          lv_abs_value = lv_abs_value / 10.
        ENDWHILE.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_num < 0.
        lv_digit_sum = lv_digit_sum * -1.
      ENDIF.

      ls_temp-value = lv_num.
      ls_temp-digit_sum = lv_digit_sum.

    DATA: lv_coordinate TYPE string.

    DATA lv_search_value TYPE string.
    DATA lv_coord_string TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_row> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_cell> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_row> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    rt_coordinates = VALUE #( ).
    lv_search_value = iv_value.

    ASSIGN it_matrix TO <lt_table>.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_row>.
      lv_row_coords = VALUE #( ).
      lv_col_index = 0.

      TRY.
          ASSIGN <ls_row> TO <lt_row>.

          LOOP AT <lt_row> ASSIGNING <lv_cell>.
            lv_cell_value = <lv_cell>.

            IF lv_cell_value = lv_search_value.
              lv_coord_string = |({ lv_row_index }, { lv_col_index })|.
              INSERT lv_coord_string INTO lv_row_coords INDEX 1.
            ENDIF.

            lv_col_index = lv_col_index + 1.
          ENDLOOP.

          APPEND LINES OF lv_row_coords TO rt_coordinates.

        CATCH cx_root.
      ENDTRY.

      lv_row_index = lv_row_index + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_find_coordinates IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_value.
    DATA: coordinates TYPE stringtab.
    DATA: row_index TYPE i.
    DATA: col_index TYPE i.
    DATA: cell_value TYPE string.
    DATA: coord_string TYPE string.
    DATA: search_string TYPE string.
    DATA: row_coords TYPE stringtab.
    DATA: row_num TYPE i.
    DATA: col_num TYPE i.
    DATA: max_col TYPE i.
    DATA: temp_coord TYPE string.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: j TYPE i.
    DATA: coord_row TYPE i.
    DATA: coord_col TYPE i.
    DATA: coord_row_str TYPE string.
    DATA: coord_col_str TYPE string.
    DATA: paren_pos TYPE i.
    DATA: field_value TYPE string.
    DATA: temp_str TYPE string.
    DATA: start_pos TYPE i.
    DATA: end_pos TYPE i.

    CLEAR result.
    CLEAR coordinates.

    search_string = CONV string( search_val ).

    row_index = 0.

    LOOP AT data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<row>).
      col_index = 0.
      LOOP AT <row> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<cell>).
        field_value = CONV string( <cell> ).
        IF field_value = search_string.
          coord_string = |({ row_index }, { col_index })|.
          APPEND coord_string TO coordinates.
        ENDIF.
        col_index = col_index + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      row_index = row_index + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR row_coords.
    CLEAR row_num.

    LOOP AT coordinates INTO coord_string.
      temp_str = coord_string.
      start_pos = 1.
      end_pos = STRLEN( temp_str ) - 2.
      temp_str = temp_str+start_pos(end_pos).

      SPLIT temp_str AT ',' INTO coord_row_str coord_col_str.
      CONDENSE coord_row_str.
      CONDENSE coord_col_str.

      coord_row = CONV i( coord_row_str ).
      coord_col = CONV i( coord_col_str ).

      IF row_num <> coord_row.
        IF row_coords IS NOT INITIAL.
          i = 0.
          j = 0.
          WHILE i < LINES( row_coords ) - 1.
            j = i + 1.
            WHILE j <= LINES( row_coords ).
              SPLIT row_coords[ i ] AT ',' INTO coord_row_str coord_col_str.
              CONDENSE coord_col_str.
              max_col = CONV i( coord_col_str ).

              SPLIT row_coords[ j ] AT ',' INTO coord_row_str coord_col_str.
              CONDENSE coord_col_str.
              col_num = CONV i( coord_col_str ).

              IF col_num > max_col.
                temp_coord = row_coords[ i ].
                row_coords[ i ] = row_coords[ j ].
                row_coords[ j ] = temp_coord.
              ENDIF.
              j = j + 1.
            ENDWHILE.
            i = i + 1.
          ENDWHILE.

          LOOP AT row_coords INTO temp_coord.
            APPEND temp_coord TO result.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR row_coords.
        row_num = coord_row.
      ENDIF.

      temp_coord = |{ coord_row }, { coord_col }|.
      APPEND temp_coord TO row_coords.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF row_coords IS NOT INITIAL.
      i = 0.
      j = 0.
      WHILE i < LINES( row_coords ) - 1.
        j = i + 1.
        WHILE j <= LINES( row_coords ).
          SPLIT row_coords[ i ] AT ',' INTO coord_row_str coord_col_str.
          CONDENSE coord_col_str.
          max_col = CONV i( coord_col_str ).

          SPLIT row_coords[ j ] AT ',' INTO coord_row_str coord_col_str.
          CONDENSE coord_col_str.
          col_num = CONV i( coord_col_str ).

          IF col_num > max_col.
            temp_coord = row_coords[ i ].
            row_coords[ i ] = row_coords[ j ].
            row_coords[ j ] = temp_coord.
          ENDIF.
          j = j + 1.
        ENDWHILE.
        i = i + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      LOOP AT row_coords INTO temp_coord.
        APPEND temp_coord TO result.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

                      LOOP AT lst INTO lv_row_data.
                        IF lv_row_index = sy-tabix - 1.
                          lv_current_val = lv_row_data.
                          IF lv_current_val = lv_search_str.
                            lv_row_str = lv_row_index.
                            lv_col_str = lv_col_index.
                            CONCATENATE lv_row_str ',' lv_col_str INTO lv_coord_str.
                            APPEND lv_coord_str TO lt_row_coords.
                          ENDIF.
                          lv_col_index = lv_col_index + 1.
                        ENDIF.
                      ENDLOOP.
                    ENDIF.
                  ENDLOOP.
                ENDIF.
              ENDLOOP.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.

          lv_col_count = LINES( lt_row_coords ).
          lv_i = 1.
          WHILE lv_i <= lv_col_count.
            lv_j = lv_i + 1.
            WHILE lv_j <= lv_col_count.
              READ TABLE lt_row_coords INDEX lv_i INTO lv_temp_str.
              READ TABLE lt_row_coords INDEX lv_j INTO lv_swap_str.

              IF lv_swap_str > lv_temp_str.
                MODIFY lt_row_coords INDEX lv_i FROM lv_swap_str.
                MODIFY lt_row_coords INDEX lv_j FROM lv_temp_str.
              ENDIF.

              lv_j = lv_j + 1.
            ENDWHILE.
            lv_i = lv_i + 1.
          ENDWHILE.

          LOOP AT lt_row_coords INTO lv_coord_str.
            APPEND lv_coord_str TO lt_coordinates.
          ENDLOOP.

          lv_row_index = lv_row_index + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    result = lt_coordinates.

  ENDMETHOD.

          lv_index = sy-index - 1.

            rv_result = rv_result && cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( source = lv_shifted_code ).
          ELSE.
            rv_result = rv_result && lv_char.

      WHEN 'DECODE'.
        DO lv_length TIMES.
          lv_index = sy-index - 1.
          lv_char = iv_input_string+lv_index(1).
          lv_char_code = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( source = lv_char ).

          IF lv_char_code >= 97 AND lv_char_code <= 122.
            lv_shifted_code = ( ( lv_char_code - 5 - 97 + 26 ) MOD 26 ) + 97.
            rv_result = rv_result && cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( source = lv_shifted_code ).
          ELSE.
            rv_result = rv_result && lv_char.

CLASS zcl_change_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_base.
    DATA lv_quotient TYPE i.
    DATA lv_remainder TYPE i.
    DATA lv_temp TYPE i.
    DATA lt_digits TYPE TABLE OF string.

    lv_temp = iv_number.

    IF lv_temp = 0.
      rv_result = '0'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_temp > 0.
      lv_quotient = lv_temp DIV iv_base.
      lv_remainder = lv_temp MOD iv_base.
      INSERT CONV string( lv_remainder ) INTO lt_digits INDEX 1.
      lv_temp = lv_quotient.
    ENDWHILE.

    CONCATENATE LINES OF lt_digits INTO rv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD check_close_elements.
    DATA lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA lv_j TYPE i.
    DATA lv_diff TYPE f.
    DATA lv_size TYPE i.

    result = abap_false.
    lv_size = lines( numbers ).

    IF lv_size < 2.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_i = 1.
    WHILE lv_i <= lv_size.
      lv_j = lv_i + 1.
      WHILE lv_j <= lv_size.
        lv_diff = ABS( numbers[ lv_i ] - numbers[ lv_j ] ).
        IF lv_diff < threshold.
          result = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_j = lv_j + 1.
      ENDWHILE.
      lv_i = lv_i + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_fib4 IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD compute.
    DATA fib0 TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA fib1 TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA fib2 TYPE i VALUE 2.
    DATA fib3 TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA fib_next TYPE i.

    IF n = 0 OR n = 1 OR n = 3.
      result = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF n = 2.
      result = 2.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO n - 3 TIMES.
      fib_next = fib0 + fib1 + fib2 + fib3.
      fib0 = fib1.
      fib1 = fib2.
      fib2 = fib3.
      fib3 = fib_next.
    ENDDO.

    result = fib_next.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA fib_next TYPE i.
    DATA i TYPE i.

    CASE n.

        result = 0.

        result = 0.
      WHEN 2.
        result = 2.

    DATA lv_length TYPE i.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    lv_start = 0.

    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index - 1.

          lv_sentence = iv_text+lv_start(lv_index - lv_start).
          lv_trimmed = lv_sentence.
          SHIFT lv_trimmed LEFT DELETING LEADING space.

    IF lv_start < lv_length.
      lv_sentence = iv_text+lv_start.
      lv_trimmed = lv_sentence.
      SHIFT lv_trimmed LEFT DELETING LEADING space.
      IF strlen( lv_trimmed ) > 0.

        IF lv_trimmed(1) = 'I' AND ( strlen( lv_trimmed ) = 1 OR lv_trimmed+1(1) = ' ' ).

    DATA: a TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: idx TYPE i.

    DATA: count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: remainder_0 TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: remainder_1 TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: remainder_2 TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DO n TIMES.
      idx = sy-index.
      APPEND idx * idx - idx + 1 TO a.

CLASS zcl_digit_sum_binary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD solve.
    DATA digit_sum TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA binary_string TYPE string VALUE ''.
    DATA remainder TYPE i.
    DATA temp_sum TYPE i.

    temp_sum = n.

    WHILE temp_sum > 0.
      digit_sum = digit_sum + ( temp_sum MOD 10 ).
      temp_sum = temp_sum / 10.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF digit_sum = 0.
      result = '0'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    temp_sum = digit_sum.

    WHILE temp_sum > 0.
      remainder = temp_sum MOD 2.
      binary_string = CONV string( remainder ) && binary_string.
      temp_sum = temp_sum / 2.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = binary_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_next_smallest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_smallest.
    DATA lt_sorted TYPE TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA lv_prev TYPE INT4.
    DATA lv_first TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

    IF it_list IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lt_sorted = it_list.
    SORT lt_sorted.

    lv_prev = lt_sorted[ 1 ].

      IF lv_value <> lv_prev.
        CREATE DATA rv_result.

      ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_separate_paren_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

      IMPORTING paren_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE stringtab.

CLASS zcl_separate_paren_groups IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD separate_paren_groups.
    DATA cleaned_string TYPE string.
    DATA current_group TYPE string.
    DATA paren_count TYPE i.
    DATA char TYPE c.
    DATA i TYPE i.
    DATA length TYPE i.

    result = VALUE #( ).

    cleaned_string = paren_string.
    TRANSLATE cleaned_string USING ' '.

    length = strlen( cleaned_string ).
    paren_count = 0.
    current_group = ''.

    DO length TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      char = cleaned_string+i(1).

      IF char = '(' OR char = ')'.
        current_group = current_group && char.

        IF char = '('.
          paren_count = paren_count + 1.
        ELSE.
          paren_count = paren_count - 1.
        ENDIF.

        IF paren_count = 0 AND current_group IS NOT INITIAL.
          APPEND current_group TO result.
          current_group = ''.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

  ENDMETHOD.

      IMPORTING paren_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE stringtab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_separate_paren_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD separate_paren_groups.
    DATA cleaned_string TYPE string.
    DATA current_group TYPE string.
    DATA paren_count TYPE i.
    DATA char TYPE c.
    DATA i TYPE i.
    DATA length TYPE i.

    result = VALUE stringtab( ).
    cleaned_string = paren_string.
    TRANSLATE cleaned_string USING ' '.

    paren_count = 0.
    current_group = ''.
    length = strlen( cleaned_string ).

    DO length TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      char = cleaned_string+i(1).

      IF char = '('.
        paren_count = paren_count + 1.
        current_group = current_group && char.
      ELSEIF char = ')'.
        paren_count = paren_count - 1.
        current_group = current_group && char.

        IF paren_count = 0 AND current_group IS NOT INITIAL.
          APPEND current_group TO result.
          current_group = ''.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_position_processor IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD process_sales_positions.
    DATA lt_positions TYPE ANY TABLE.
    DATA lt_aggr TYPE ANY TABLE.
    DATA ls_aggr TYPE any.
    DATA ls_position TYPE any.
    DATA lv_found TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_index TYPE sy-tabix.
    DATA lv_zname TYPE c LENGTH 20.
    DATA lv_zarticle TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    DATA lv_zcurrency TYPE c LENGTH 5.
    DATA lv_zrev TYPE p LENGTH 13 DECIMALS 2.

    TRY.
        SELECT * FROM zsales_positions INTO TABLE @lt_positions.

        IF lt_positions IS NOT INITIAL.
          DELETE FROM zsales_aggr.

          LOOP AT lt_positions INTO ls_position.
            CLEAR lv_found.
            CLEAR lv_index.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZNAME' OF STRUCTURE ls_position TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<zname>).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZARTICLE' OF STRUCTURE ls_position TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<zarticle>).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZCURRENCY' OF STRUCTURE ls_position TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<zcurrency>).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZREV' OF STRUCTURE ls_position TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<zrev>).

            LOOP AT lt_aggr INTO ls_aggr.
              lv_index = sy-tabix.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZNAME' OF STRUCTURE ls_aggr TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<aggr_zname>).
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZARTICLE' OF STRUCTURE ls_aggr TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<aggr_zarticle>).
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZCURRENCY' OF STRUCTURE ls_aggr TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<aggr_zcurrency>).
              IF <aggr_zname> = <zname> AND
                 <aggr_zarticle> = <zarticle> AND
                 <aggr_zcurrency> = <zcurrency>.
                lv_found = abap_true.
                EXIT.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.

            IF lv_found = abap_true.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZREV' OF STRUCTURE ls_aggr TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<aggr_zrev>).
              <aggr_zrev> = <aggr_zrev> + <zrev>.
              MODIFY lt_aggr FROM ls_aggr INDEX lv_index.
            ELSE.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZNAME' OF STRUCTURE ls_aggr TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<new_zname>).
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ZARTICLE' OF STRUCTURE ls_aggr TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<new_zarticle>).

              <new_zname> = <zname>.
              <new_zarticle> = <zarticle>.
              <new_zcurrency> = <zcurrency>.
              <new_zrev> = <zrev>.
              APPEND ls_aggr TO lt_aggr.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.

          INSERT zsales_aggr FROM TABLE @lt_aggr.

          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_result = 'SUCCESS'.
          ELSE.
            rv_result = 'INSERT_FAILED'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'NO_DATA'.
        ENDIF.

        rv_result = 'ERROR: ' && lx_error->get_text( ).

CLASS zcl_find_closest_elements IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_closest_elements.
    DATA: sorted_numbers TYPE TABLE OF f.
    DATA: min_distance TYPE f VALUE '999999999'.
    DATA: current_distance TYPE f.
    DATA: index TYPE i.
    DATA: num1 TYPE f.
    DATA: num2 TYPE f.

    sorted_numbers = numbers.
    SORT sorted_numbers.

    LOOP AT sorted_numbers INTO num1.
      index = sy-tabix.
      IF index < LINES( sorted_numbers ).
        num2 = sorted_numbers[ index + 1 ].
        current_distance = num2 - num1.
        IF current_distance < min_distance.
          min_distance = current_distance.
          result-first = num1.
          result-second = num2.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

      IMPORTING arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF I
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_move_one_ball IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_sorted_after_rotation.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_size TYPE i.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_next_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_element TYPE i.
    DATA lv_next_element TYPE i.
    DATA lv_first TYPE i.
    DATA lv_last TYPE i.

    lv_size = lines( arr ).

    IF lv_size = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT arr INTO lv_element.
      lv_index = sy-tabix.
      IF lv_index < lv_size.
        lv_next_index = lv_index + 1.
        READ TABLE arr INDEX lv_next_index INTO lv_next_element.
        IF lv_element > lv_next_element.
          lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_count = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_count > 1.
      result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE arr INDEX 1 INTO lv_first.
    READ TABLE arr INDEX lv_size INTO lv_last.

    IF lv_last <= lv_first.
      result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_one_ball DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_sorted_after_rotation
      IMPORTING arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF I
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_move_one_ball IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_sorted_after_rotation.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_size TYPE i.
    DATA lv_prev TYPE i.
    DATA lv_curr TYPE i.

    lv_size = LINES( arr ).

    IF lv_size = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT arr INTO lv_curr.
      lv_index = sy-tabix.

      IF lv_index = 1.
        lv_prev = lv_curr.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_curr < lv_prev.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.

      lv_prev = lv_curr.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_count = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_count > 1.
      result = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE arr INDEX 1 INTO lv_curr.
    READ TABLE arr INDEX lv_size INTO lv_prev.

    IF lv_curr >= lv_prev.
      result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_one_ball DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool.
