  METHOD check_sorted_after_rotation.
    DATA lv_size TYPE i.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_next_index TYPE i.

    lv_size = LINES( arr ).

    IF lv_size = 0.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_count = 0.

    DO lv_size TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index - 1.
      lv_next_index = lv_index + 1.

      IF lv_next_index >= lv_size.
        lv_next_index = 0.
      ENDIF.

      IF arr[ lv_index + 1 ] > arr[ lv_next_index + 1 ].
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF lv_count <= 1.
      result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_move_one_ball IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD move_one_ball.
    DATA lv_len TYPE I.
    DATA lv_count TYPE I.
    DATA lv_i TYPE I.
    DATA lv_rotation_point TYPE I.
    DATA lv_found_rotation TYPE ABAP_BOOL.

    result = ABAP_TRUE.

    lv_len = LINES( arr ).

    IF lv_len = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_len = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_count = 0.
    lv_found_rotation = ABAP_FALSE.
    lv_rotation_point = -1.

    DO lv_len - 1 TIMES.
      lv_i = sy-index - 1.
      IF arr[ lv_i + 1 ] > arr[ lv_i + 2 ].
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        IF lv_count > 1.
          result = ABAP_FALSE.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_rotation_point = lv_i + 1.
        lv_found_rotation = ABAP_TRUE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF lv_found_rotation = ABAP_FALSE.
      result = ABAP_TRUE.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF arr[ lv_len ] > arr[ 1 ].
      result = ABAP_FALSE.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    result = ABAP_TRUE.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA num TYPE i.
    DATA digit_sum TYPE i.
    DATA current_num TYPE i.
    DATA is_negative TYPE i.
    DATA digit TYPE i.

    LOOP AT arr INTO num.
      digit_sum = 0.
      current_num = num.
      is_negative = 0.

        is_negative = 1.
        current_num = current_num * -1.

          ELSE.
            digit_sum = digit_sum + digit.
          ENDIF.
          current_num = current_num / 10.

      IF digit_sum > 0.
        result = result + 1.

CLASS zcl_maximum_k_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_maximum.
    DATA: sorted_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF numc.
    DATA: count TYPE numc.

    sorted_arr = arr.
    SORT sorted_arr DESCENDING.

    CLEAR result.

    count = LINES( sorted_arr ).
    IF k > count.
      k = count.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT sorted_arr INTO DATA(value) FROM 1 UP TO k.
      APPEND value TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT result ASCENDING.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_maximum.

    DATA: arr_length TYPE n.

    sorted_arr = arr.
    arr_length = LINES( sorted_arr ).

    SORT sorted_arr DESCENDING.

    CLEAR result.

    IF k > 0 AND k <= arr_length.
      LOOP AT sorted_arr INTO DATA(element) FROM 1 UP TO k.
        APPEND element TO result.

CLASS zcl_maximum_k_elements IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_maximum.
    DATA: sorted_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum.
    DATA: i TYPE sy-index.
    DATA: arr_len TYPE sy-index.

    sorted_arr = arr.
    arr_len = LINES( sorted_arr ).

    IF k = 0 OR arr_len = 0.
      CLEAR result.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SORT sorted_arr ASCENDING.

    CLEAR result.

    IF k >= arr_len.
      result = sorted_arr.
    ELSE.
      i = arr_len - k + 1.
      WHILE i <= arr_len.
        APPEND sorted_arr[ i ] TO result.
        i = i + 1.
      ENDWHILE.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_maximum_k_elements IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_maximum.
    DATA: sorted_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF numc,
          i           TYPE numc,
          j           TYPE numc,
          temp        TYPE numc,
          arr_len     TYPE numc,
          idx         TYPE numc.

    arr_len = LINES( arr ).

    IF k = 0 OR arr_len = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    sorted_arr = arr.

    DO arr_len TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      DO arr_len - i TIMES.
        j = sy-index.
        IF j < arr_len.
          IF sorted_arr[ j ] < sorted_arr[ j + 1 ].
            temp = sorted_arr[ j ].
            sorted_arr[ j ] = sorted_arr[ j + 1 ].
            sorted_arr[ j + 1 ] = temp.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    DO k TIMES.
      idx = sy-index.
      APPEND sorted_arr[ idx ] TO result.
    ENDDO.

    DO k TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      DO k - i TIMES.
        j = sy-index.
        IF j < k.
          IF result[ j ] > result[ j + 1 ].
            temp = result[ j ].
            result[ j ] = result[ j + 1 ].
            result[ j + 1 ] = temp.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_maximum_k_elements IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_maximum.
    DATA: sorted_arr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF INT4.
    DATA: idx TYPE INT4.
    DATA: jdx TYPE INT4.
    DATA: temp TYPE INT4.
    DATA: arr_size TYPE INT4.
    DATA: swapped TYPE c.

    arr_size = LINES( arr ).

    sorted_arr = arr.

    IF k = 0 OR arr_size = 0.
      CLEAR result.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF k > arr_size.
      result = sorted_arr.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    idx = 1.
    WHILE idx < arr_size.
      swapped = space.
      jdx = 1.
      WHILE jdx <= arr_size - idx.
        IF sorted_arr[ jdx ] > sorted_arr[ jdx + 1 ].
          temp = sorted_arr[ jdx ].
          sorted_arr[ jdx ] = sorted_arr[ jdx + 1 ].
          sorted_arr[ jdx + 1 ] = temp.
          swapped = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
        jdx = jdx + 1.
      ENDWHILE.
      IF swapped = space.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      idx = idx + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    CLEAR result.
    idx = arr_size - k + 1.
    WHILE idx <= arr_size.
      APPEND sorted_arr[ idx ] TO result.
      idx = idx + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD check_if_last_char_is_a_letter.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.

    lv_length = strlen( txt ).

CLASS zcl_rescale_to_unit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        numbers TYPE TABLE OF c
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF c.

CLASS zcl_rescale_to_unit IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD rescale_to_unit.
    DATA: min_value TYPE f,
          max_value TYPE f,
          range TYPE f,
          rescaled_value TYPE f,
          num_value TYPE f,
          num_string TYPE c LENGTH 255.

    IF lines( numbers ) < 2.
      result = numbers.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    min_value = CONV f( numbers[ 1 ] ).
    max_value = CONV f( numbers[ 1 ] ).

    LOOP AT numbers INTO num_string.
      num_value = CONV f( num_string ).
      IF num_value < min_value.
        min_value = num_value.
      ENDIF.
      IF num_value > max_value.
        max_value = num_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    range = max_value - min_value.

    IF range = 0.
      LOOP AT numbers INTO num_string.
        APPEND '0.0' TO result.
      ENDLOOP.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT numbers INTO num_string.
      num_value = CONV f( num_string ).
      rescaled_value = ( num_value - min_value ) / range.
      APPEND CONV c( rescaled_value ) TO result.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING country TYPE string region TYPE string customer_type TYPE string digit_id TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(customer_id) TYPE string.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcustomer_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD generate_customer_id.
    DATA lv_country_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_type_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_digit_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_country_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_customer_type_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_country_upper TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_upper TYPE string.
    DATA lv_customer_type_upper TYPE string.
    DATA lv_words TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA lv_word TYPE string.
    DATA lv_abbrev TYPE string.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.

    lv_country_trimmed = TRIM( country ).
    lv_region_trimmed = TRIM( region ).
    lv_customer_type_trimmed = TRIM( customer_type ).

    lv_country_upper = to_upper( lv_country_trimmed ).

    CASE lv_country_upper.
      WHEN 'GERMANY'.
        lv_country_code = '0049'.
      WHEN 'AUSTRIA'.
        lv_country_code = '0043'.
      WHEN 'SWITZERLAND'.
        lv_country_code = '0041'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        SELECT SINGLE country_code
          FROM zcountry_codes
          WHERE UPPER( country_name ) = lv_country_upper
          INTO lv_country_code.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_country_code = 'XXXX'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

    lv_region_upper = to_upper( lv_region_trimmed ).

    SELECT SINGLE region_code
      FROM zregion_codes
      WHERE country_code = lv_country_code
        AND UPPER( region_name ) = lv_region_upper
      INTO lv_region_code.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      SPLIT lv_region_upper BY space INTO TABLE lv_words.
      lv_abbrev = ''.
      lv_index = 0.

      LOOP AT lv_words INTO lv_word.
        IF lv_index < 2 AND lv_word <> ''.
          lv_abbrev = lv_abbrev && lv_word(1).
          lv_index = lv_index + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF strlen( lv_abbrev ) > 2.
        lv_region_code = lv_abbrev(2).
      ELSEIF lv_abbrev = ''.
        lv_region_code = 'XX'.
      ELSE.
        lv_region_code = lv_abbrev.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    lv_customer_type_upper = to_upper( lv_customer_type_trimmed ).

    CASE lv_customer_type_upper.
      WHEN 'BUSINESS_CUSTOMER'.
        lv_type_code = 'B'.
      WHEN 'PRIVATE_CUSTOMER'.
        lv_type_code = 'P'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        SELECT SINGLE type_code
          FROM zcustomer_types
          WHERE UPPER( customer_type ) = lv_customer_type_upper
          INTO lv_type_code.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_type_code = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

    lv_digit_string = |{ digit_id ALIGN = RIGHT PAD = '0' WIDTH = 5 }|.

    customer_id = lv_country_code && lv_region_code && lv_type_code && lv_digit_string.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcustomer_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD generate_customer_id.
    DATA lv_country_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_type_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_id_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_country_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_customer_type_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_abbr TYPE string.
    DATA lv_word_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_word_start TYPE i.
    DATA lv_char TYPE string.
    DATA lv_abbr_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_region_len TYPE i.

    lv_country_trimmed = country.
    lv_region_trimmed = region.
    lv_customer_type_trimmed = customer_type.

    lv_country_trimmed = CONDENSE( lv_country_trimmed ).
    lv_region_trimmed = CONDENSE( lv_region_trimmed ).
    lv_customer_type_trimmed = CONDENSE( lv_customer_type_trimmed ).

    CASE lv_country_trimmed.
      WHEN 'Germany'.
        lv_country_code = '0049'.
      WHEN 'Austria'.
        lv_country_code = '0043'.
      WHEN 'Switzerland'.
        lv_country_code = '0041'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_country_code = 'XXXX'.
    ENDCASE.

    lv_region_code = 'XX'.
    IF lv_region_trimmed IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_region_abbr = ''.
      lv_abbr_index = 0.
      lv_word_start = 0.
      lv_region_len = strlen( lv_region_trimmed ).
      lv_word_index = 0.

      WHILE lv_word_index < lv_region_len AND lv_abbr_index < 2.
        lv_char = lv_region_trimmed+lv_word_index(1).

        IF lv_char = ' '.
          IF lv_word_index > lv_word_start.
            lv_char = lv_region_trimmed+lv_word_start(1).
            lv_region_abbr = lv_region_abbr && lv_char.
            lv_abbr_index = lv_abbr_index + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_word_start = lv_word_index + 1.
        ENDIF.

        lv_word_index = lv_word_index + 1.
      ENDWHILE.

      IF lv_word_index > lv_word_start AND lv_abbr_index < 2.
        lv_char = lv_region_trimmed+lv_word_start(1).
        lv_region_abbr = lv_region_abbr && lv_char.
        lv_abbr_index = lv_abbr_index + 1.
      ENDIF.

      IF strlen( lv_region_abbr ) >= 2.
        lv_region_code = lv_region_abbr(2).
      ELSEIF strlen( lv_region_abbr ) = 1.
        lv_region_code = lv_region_abbr && 'X'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    lv_type_code = 'X'.
    CASE lv_customer_type_trimmed.
      WHEN 'Business_Customer'.
        lv_type_code = 'B'.
      WHEN 'Private_Customer'.
        lv_type_code = 'P'.
    ENDCASE.

    lv_id_string = |{ digit_id ALIGN = RIGHT WIDTH = 5 PAD = '0' }|.

    customer_id = lv_country_code && lv_region_code && lv_type_code && lv_id_string.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcustomer_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD generate_customer_id.
    DATA lv_country_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_type_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_id_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_country_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_customer_type_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_abbr TYPE string.
    DATA lt_words TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA lv_abbr_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_len TYPE i.

    " Trim input parameters
    lv_country_trimmed = country.
    lv_region_trimmed = region.
    lv_customer_type_trimmed = customer_type.

    " Remove leading spaces from country
    WHILE lv_country_trimmed IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_country_trimmed(1) = ' '.
      lv_country_trimmed = lv_country_trimmed+1.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove trailing spaces from country
    lv_len = strlen( lv_country_trimmed ).
    WHILE lv_len > 0.
      IF lv_country_trimmed+lv_len-1(1) = ' '.
        lv_country_trimmed = lv_country_trimmed(lv_len - 1).
        lv_len = strlen( lv_country_trimmed ).
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove leading spaces from region
    WHILE lv_region_trimmed IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_region_trimmed(1) = ' '.
      lv_region_trimmed = lv_region_trimmed+1.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove trailing spaces from region
    lv_len = strlen( lv_region_trimmed ).
    WHILE lv_len > 0.
      IF lv_region_trimmed+lv_len-1(1) = ' '.
        lv_region_trimmed = lv_region_trimmed(lv_len - 1).
        lv_len = strlen( lv_region_trimmed ).
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove leading spaces from customer_type
    WHILE lv_customer_type_trimmed IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_customer_type_trimmed(1) = ' '.
      lv_customer_type_trimmed = lv_customer_type_trimmed+1.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Remove trailing spaces from customer_type
    lv_len = strlen( lv_customer_type_trimmed ).
    WHILE lv_len > 0.
      IF lv_customer_type_trimmed+lv_len-1(1) = ' '.
        lv_customer_type_trimmed = lv_customer_type_trimmed(lv_len - 1).
        lv_len = strlen( lv_customer_type_trimmed ).
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Map country to country code
    CASE lv_country_trimmed.
      WHEN 'Germany'.
        lv_country_code = '0049'.
      WHEN 'Austria'.
        lv_country_code = '0043'.
      WHEN 'Switzerland'.
        lv_country_code = '0041'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_country_code = 'XXXX'.
    ENDCASE.

    " Extract region code from region name
    IF lv_region_trimmed IS NOT INITIAL.
      SPLIT lv_region_trimmed AT ' ' INTO TABLE lt_words.
      lv_region_abbr = 'XX'.
      lv_abbr_index = 0.

      LOOP AT lt_words INTO DATA(lv_word).
        IF lv_abbr_index < 2 AND lv_word IS NOT INITIAL.
          IF lv_abbr_index = 0.
            lv_region_abbr = lv_word(1).
          ELSE.
            lv_region_abbr = lv_region_abbr && lv_word(1).
          ENDIF.
          lv_abbr_index = lv_abbr_index + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_region_code = lv_region_abbr.
    ELSE.
      lv_region_code = 'XX'.
    ENDIF.

    " Map customer type to type code
    CASE lv_customer_type_trimmed.
      WHEN 'Business_Customer'.
        lv_type_code = 'B'.
      WHEN 'Private_Customer'.
        lv_type_code = 'P'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_type_code = 'X'.
    ENDCASE.

    " Format ID with leading zeros (5 digits)
    lv_id_string = |{ digit_id ALIGN = RIGHT WIDTH = 5 PAD = '0' }|.

    " Construct customer ID (12 characters)
    customer_id = lv_country_code && lv_region_code && lv_type_code && lv_id_string.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcustomer_id_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS generate_customer_id
      IMPORTING
        country       TYPE string
        region        TYPE string
        customer_type TYPE string
        digit_id      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(customer_id) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_country_code
      IMPORTING
        country TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(country_code) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS get_region_code
      IMPORTING
        country TYPE string
        region  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(region_code) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS get_type_code
      IMPORTING
        customer_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(type_code) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS extract_abbreviation
      IMPORTING
        text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(abbreviation) TYPE string.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcustomer_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD generate_customer_id.
    DATA lv_country_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_type_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_digit_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_country_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_customer_type_trimmed TYPE string.

    lv_country_trimmed = country.
    lv_region_trimmed = region.
    lv_customer_type_trimmed = customer_type.

    lv_country_code = get_country_code( lv_country_trimmed ).
    lv_region_code = get_region_code( country = lv_country_trimmed region = lv_region_trimmed ).
    lv_type_code = get_type_code( lv_customer_type_trimmed ).

    lv_digit_str = |{ digit_id ALIGN = RIGHT PAD = '0' WIDTH = 5 }|.

    customer_id = |{ lv_country_code }{ lv_region_code }{ lv_type_code }{ lv_digit_str }|.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_country_code.
    DATA lv_country_upper TYPE string.
    DATA lv_country_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.

    lv_country_trimmed = country.
    lv_country_upper = lv_country_trimmed.
    TRANSLATE lv_country_upper TO UPPER CASE.

    CASE lv_country_upper.
      WHEN 'GERMANY'.
        country_code = '0049'.
      WHEN 'AUSTRIA'.
        country_code = '0043'.
      WHEN 'SWITZERLAND'.
        country_code = '0041'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        TRY.
            SELECT SINGLE country_code INTO lv_result
              FROM zcountry_codes
              WHERE UPPER( country_name ) = @lv_country_upper.
            country_code = lv_result.
          CATCH cx_sy_sql_error.
            country_code = 'XXXX'.
        ENDTRY.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          country_code = 'XXXX'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_region_code.
    DATA lv_region_upper TYPE string.
    DATA lv_country_code TYPE string.
    DATA lv_region_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.

    lv_region_trimmed = region.
    lv_region_upper = lv_region_trimmed.
    TRANSLATE lv_region_upper TO UPPER CASE.

    lv_country_code = get_country_code( country ).

    TRY.
        SELECT SINGLE region_code INTO lv_result
          FROM zregion_codes
          WHERE country_code = @lv_country_code
            AND UPPER( region_name ) = @lv_region_upper.
        region_code = lv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error.
        region_code = extract_abbreviation( region ).
        IF region_code = '' OR region_code = ' '.
          region_code = 'XX'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      region_code = extract_abbreviation( region ).
      IF region_code = '' OR region_code = ' '.
        region_code = 'XX'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_type_code.
    DATA lv_type_upper TYPE string.
    DATA lv_type_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.

    lv_type_trimmed = customer_type.
    lv_type_upper = lv_type_trimmed.
    TRANSLATE lv_type_upper TO UPPER CASE.

    CASE lv_type_upper.
      WHEN 'BUSINESS_CUSTOMER'.
        type_code = 'B'.
      WHEN 'PRIVATE_CUSTOMER'.
        type_code = 'P'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        TRY.
            SELECT SINGLE type_code INTO lv_result
              FROM zcustomer_types
              WHERE UPPER( customer_type ) = @lv_type_upper.
            type_code = lv_result.
          CATCH cx_sy_sql_error.
            type_code = 'X'.
        ENDTRY.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          type_code = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD extract_abbreviation.
    DATA lv_text_trimmed TYPE string.
    DATA lv_words TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA lv_word TYPE string.
    DATA lv_abbr TYPE string VALUE ''.

    lv_text_trimmed = text.
    SPLIT lv_text_trimmed AT ' ' INTO TABLE lv_words.

    LOOP AT lv_words INTO lv_word.
      IF lv_word <> ''.
        lv_abbr = |{ lv_abbr }{ lv_word(1) }|.
        IF strlen( lv_abbr ) >= 2.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    abbreviation = lv_abbr.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

          index TYPE I,
          sorted_even TYPE TABLE OF I,

    even_count = 0.

    LOOP AT l INTO DATA(value).

  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_compare_one IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_one.
    DATA lv_a_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_b_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_a_num TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA lv_b_num TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA lv_a_normalized TYPE string.
    DATA lv_b_normalized TYPE string.

    lv_a_str = CONV string( iv_a ).
    lv_b_str = CONV string( iv_b ).

    lv_a_normalized = REPLACE( val = lv_a_str sub = ',' with = '.' ).
    lv_b_normalized = REPLACE( val = lv_b_str sub = ',' with = '.' ).

    TRY.
        lv_a_num = CONV decfloat34( lv_a_normalized ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        lv_a_num = 0.
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lv_b_num = CONV decfloat34( lv_b_normalized ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        lv_b_num = 0.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lv_a_num = lv_b_num.
      rv_result = ''.
    ELSEIF lv_a_num > lv_b_num.
      rv_result = lv_a_str.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = lv_b_str.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING a TYPE ANY
                b TYPE ANY

CLASS zcl_compare_one IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD compare_one.
    DATA lv_a_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_b_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_a_num TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 10.
    DATA lv_b_num TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 10.
    DATA lv_a_orig TYPE string.
    DATA lv_b_orig TYPE string.

    IF a IS INITIAL.
      lv_a_str = ''.
      lv_a_orig = ''.
    ELSE.
      lv_a_str = CONV string( a ).
      lv_a_orig = lv_a_str.
    ENDIF.

    IF b IS INITIAL.
      lv_b_str = ''.
      lv_b_orig = ''.
    ELSE.
      lv_b_str = CONV string( b ).
      lv_b_orig = lv_b_str.
    ENDIF.

    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',' IN lv_a_str WITH '.'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',' IN lv_b_str WITH '.'.

    TRY.
        lv_a_num = CONV p( lv_a_str ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        result = SPACE.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lv_b_num = CONV p( lv_b_str ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        result = SPACE.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lv_a_num > lv_b_num.
      result = lv_a_orig.
    ELSEIF lv_b_num > lv_a_num.
      result = lv_b_orig.
    ELSE.
      result = SPACE.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS z_odd_collatz IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_odd_collatz.
    DATA: current_n TYPE i.
    DATA: odd_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i.
    DATA: sorted_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i.

    current_n = n.

    WHILE current_n <> 1.
      IF current_n MOD 2 = 1.
        APPEND current_n TO odd_numbers.
      ENDIF.

      IF current_n MOD 2 = 0.
        current_n = current_n / 2.
      ELSE.
        current_n = current_n * 3 + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    APPEND 1 TO odd_numbers.

    sorted_numbers = odd_numbers.
    SORT sorted_numbers.

    result = sorted_numbers.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_remove_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF count_entry,
             num TYPE i,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF count_entry.

    DATA: count_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF count_entry.
    DATA: entry TYPE count_entry.
    DATA: num TYPE i.

    CLEAR result.

    LOOP AT numbers INTO num.
      READ TABLE count_map INTO entry WITH KEY num = num.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        entry-count = entry-count + 1.
        MODIFY count_map FROM entry.
      ELSE.
        entry-num = num.
        entry-count = 1.
        INSERT entry INTO count_map.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT numbers INTO num.
      READ TABLE count_map INTO entry WITH KEY num = num.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND entry-count = 1.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS find_zero
      IMPORTING
        coefficients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE f.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA: x_current TYPE f VALUE 1.0.
    DATA: x_next TYPE f.
    DATA: poly_value TYPE f.
    DATA: poly_deriv TYPE f.
    DATA: iteration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 100.
    DATA: tolerance TYPE f VALUE 0.000001.
    DATA: difference TYPE f.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: power TYPE f.
    DATA: coeff TYPE f.

    WHILE iteration < max_iterations.
      poly_value = 0.
      LOOP AT coefficients INTO coeff.
        i = sy-tabix - 1.
        power = x_current ** i.
        poly_value = poly_value + ( coeff * power ).
      ENDLOOP.

      poly_deriv = 0.
      LOOP AT coefficients INTO coeff.
        i = sy-tabix - 1.
        IF i > 0.
          power = x_current ** ( i - 1 ).
          poly_deriv = poly_deriv + ( i * coeff * power ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF poly_deriv = 0.
        x_next = x_current - 0.01.
      ELSE.
        x_next = x_current - ( poly_value / poly_deriv ).
      ENDIF.

      difference = x_next - x_current.
      IF difference < 0.
        difference = difference * -1.
      ENDIF.

      IF difference < tolerance.
        result = x_next.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      x_current = x_next.
      iteration = iteration + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = x_current.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS find_zero IMPORTING iv_coefficients TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_zero) TYPE f.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA lt_coefficients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f.
    DATA lv_coefficient TYPE f.
    DATA lv_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.
    DATA lv_current_char TYPE c.
    DATA lv_number_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_x TYPE f.
    DATA lv_fx TYPE f.
    DATA lv_fpx TYPE f.
    DATA lv_x_next TYPE f.
    DATA lv_tolerance TYPE f.
    DATA lv_max_iterations TYPE i.
    DATA lv_iteration TYPE i.
    DATA lv_power TYPE f.
    DATA lv_term TYPE f.
    DATA lv_coeff TYPE f.
    DATA lv_tabix TYPE i.

    lv_string = iv_coefficients.
    lv_length = strlen( lv_string ).
    lv_number_str = ''.

    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_current_char = lv_string+lv_index(1).

      IF lv_current_char = ',' OR lv_current_char = ' ' OR lv_current_char = '[' OR lv_current_char = ']'.
        IF lv_number_str IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_coefficient = lv_number_str.
          APPEND lv_coefficient TO lt_coefficients.
          lv_number_str = ''.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        CONCATENATE lv_number_str lv_current_char INTO lv_number_str.
      ENDIF.

      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDDO.

    IF lv_number_str IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_coefficient = lv_number_str.
      APPEND lv_coefficient TO lt_coefficients.
    ENDIF.

    lv_x = 1.0.
    lv_tolerance = 0.00001.
    lv_max_iterations = 100.
    lv_iteration = 0.

    DO lv_max_iterations TIMES.
      lv_fx = 0.0.
      LOOP AT lt_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_tabix = sy-tabix - 1.
        lv_power = lv_x ** lv_tabix.
        lv_term = lv_coeff * lv_power.
        lv_fx = lv_fx + lv_term.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_fpx = 0.0.
      LOOP AT lt_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_tabix = sy-tabix - 1.
        IF lv_tabix > 0.
          lv_power = lv_x ** ( lv_tabix - 1 ).
          lv_term = lv_tabix * lv_coeff * lv_power.
          lv_fpx = lv_fpx + lv_term.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_fpx = 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_next = lv_x - ( lv_fx / lv_fpx ).

      IF abs( lv_x_next - lv_x ) < lv_tolerance.
        lv_x = lv_x_next.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x = lv_x_next.
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.
    ENDDO.

    rv_zero = lv_x.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA lt_coefficients TYPE TABLE OF f.
    DATA lv_x TYPE f.
    DATA lv_fx TYPE f.
    DATA lv_fpx TYPE f.
    DATA lv_x_new TYPE f.
    DATA lv_tolerance TYPE f.
    DATA lv_max_iterations TYPE i.
    DATA lv_iteration TYPE i.
    DATA lv_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.
    DATA lv_current_char TYPE c.
    DATA lv_number_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_coefficient TYPE f.
    DATA lv_power TYPE f.
    DATA lv_term TYPE f.
    DATA lv_coeff TYPE f.
    DATA lv_loop_index TYPE i.

    lv_string = iv_coefficients.
    lv_length = strlen( lv_string ).
    lv_number_str = ''.

    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_current_char = lv_string+lv_index(1).

      IF lv_current_char = ',' OR lv_current_char = ' ' OR lv_current_char = '[' OR lv_current_char = ']'.
        IF lv_number_str IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_coefficient = lv_number_str.
          APPEND lv_coefficient TO lt_coefficients.
          lv_number_str = ''.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        CONCATENATE lv_number_str lv_current_char INTO lv_number_str.
      ENDIF.

      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDDO.

    IF lv_number_str IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_coefficient = lv_number_str.
      APPEND lv_coefficient TO lt_coefficients.
    ENDIF.

    lv_x = 1.0.
    lv_tolerance = 0.00001.
    lv_max_iterations = 100.
    lv_iteration = 0.

    DO lv_max_iterations TIMES.
      lv_fx = 0.0.
      LOOP AT lt_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_loop_index = sy-tabix - 1.
        lv_power = lv_x ** lv_loop_index.
        lv_term = lv_coeff * lv_power.
        lv_fx = lv_fx + lv_term.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_fpx = 0.0.
      LOOP AT lt_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_loop_index = sy-tabix - 1.
        IF lv_loop_index > 0.
          lv_power = lv_x ** ( lv_loop_index - 1 ).
          lv_term = lv_coeff * lv_loop_index * lv_power.
          lv_fpx = lv_fpx + lv_term.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_fpx = 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_new = lv_x - ( lv_fx / lv_fpx ).

      IF abs( lv_x_new - lv_x ) < lv_tolerance.
        lv_x = lv_x_new.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x = lv_x_new.
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.
    ENDDO.

    rv_zero = lv_x.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA: lt_coefficients TYPE TABLE OF f.
    DATA: lv_coeff_str TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_coeff TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_x TYPE f VALUE 1.0.
    DATA: lv_fx TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_fpx TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_x_new TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_iteration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 100.
    DATA: lv_tolerance TYPE f VALUE 0.000001.
    DATA: lv_diff TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_power TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE f.
    DATA: lt_parts TYPE TABLE OF string.

    SPLIT iv_coefficients BY ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    LOOP AT lt_parts INTO lv_coeff_str.
      lv_coeff_str = condense( lv_coeff_str ).
      lv_coeff = lv_coeff_str.
      APPEND lv_coeff TO lt_coefficients.
    ENDLOOP.

    WHILE lv_iteration < lv_max_iterations.
      lv_result = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_index = sy-tabix - 1.
        lv_power = lv_x ** lv_index.
        lv_result = lv_result + ( lv_coeff * lv_power ).
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_fx = lv_result.

      lv_result = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_index = sy-tabix - 1.
        IF lv_index > 0.
          lv_power = lv_x ** ( lv_index - 1 ).
          lv_result = lv_result + ( lv_index * lv_coeff * lv_power ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_fpx = lv_result.

      IF abs( lv_fpx ) < lv_tolerance.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_new = lv_x - ( lv_fx / lv_fpx ).
      lv_diff = abs( lv_x_new - lv_x ).

      IF lv_diff < lv_tolerance.
        lv_x = lv_x_new.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x = lv_x_new.
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_zero = lv_x.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS find_zero
      IMPORTING coefficients TYPE TABLE OF f
      RETURNING VALUE(zero_point) TYPE f.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA:
      x_current    TYPE f,
      x_next       TYPE f,
      f_value      TYPE f,
      f_derivative TYPE f,
      delta        TYPE f,
      h            TYPE f,
      f_plus       TYPE f,
      f_minus      TYPE f,
      coeffs_table TYPE TABLE OF f,
      power        TYPE f,
      coeff        TYPE f,
      index        TYPE i,
      term         TYPE f,
      result       TYPE f,
      max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 1000,
      tolerance      TYPE f VALUE '1.0E-10'.

    coeffs_table = coefficients.

    x_current = 1.0.
    h = '1.0E-8'.

    DO max_iterations TIMES.

      result = 0.
      LOOP AT coeffs_table INTO coeff.
        index = sy-tabix - 1.
        IF index = 0.
          power = 1.
        ELSE.
          power = x_current ** index.
        ENDIF.
        term = coeff * power.
        result = result + term.
      ENDLOOP.
      f_value = result.

      result = 0.
      LOOP AT coeffs_table INTO coeff.
        index = sy-tabix - 1.
        IF index = 0.
          power = 1.
        ELSE.
          power = ( x_current + h ) ** index.
        ENDIF.
        term = coeff * power.
        result = result + term.
      ENDLOOP.
      f_plus = result.

      result = 0.
      LOOP AT coeffs_table INTO coeff.
        index = sy-tabix - 1.
        IF index = 0.
          power = 1.
        ELSE.
          power = ( x_current - h ) ** index.
        ENDIF.
        term = coeff * power.
        result = result + term.
      ENDLOOP.
      f_minus = result.

      f_derivative = ( f_plus - f_minus ) / ( 2 * h ).

      IF ABS( f_derivative ) < tolerance.
        zero_point = x_current.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      x_next = x_current - ( f_value / f_derivative ).

      delta = ABS( x_next - x_current ).

      IF delta < tolerance.
        zero_point = x_next.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      x_current = x_next.

    ENDDO.

    zero_point = x_current.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS find_zero
      IMPORTING coefficients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f
      RETURNING VALUE(zero_point) TYPE f.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS evaluate_polynomial
      IMPORTING coefficients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f x_value TYPE f
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE f.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA lv_x_current TYPE f VALUE 0.0.
    DATA lv_x_next TYPE f.
    DATA lv_f_current TYPE f.
    DATA lv_f_derivative TYPE f.
    DATA lv_delta TYPE f.
    DATA lv_h TYPE f VALUE '1e-7'.
    DATA lv_f_plus TYPE f.
    DATA lv_f_minus TYPE f.
    DATA lv_x_test TYPE f.
    DATA lv_coeffs_copy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f.
    DATA lv_iteration TYPE i.

    IF lines( coefficients ) = 0.
      zero_point = 0.0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_coeffs_copy = coefficients.
    lv_x_current = 1.0.

    DO 1000 TIMES.
      lv_iteration = sy-index.

      lv_f_current = evaluate_polynomial(
        coefficients = lv_coeffs_copy
        x_value = lv_x_current ).

      lv_x_test = lv_x_current + lv_h.
      lv_f_plus = evaluate_polynomial(
        coefficients = lv_coeffs_copy
        x_value = lv_x_test ).

      lv_x_test = lv_x_current - lv_h.
      lv_f_minus = evaluate_polynomial(
        coefficients = lv_coeffs_copy
        x_value = lv_x_test ).

      lv_f_derivative = ( lv_f_plus - lv_f_minus ) / ( 2.0 * lv_h ).

      IF abs( lv_f_derivative ) < '1e-8'.
        lv_x_current = lv_x_current - 0.1.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_next = lv_x_current - ( lv_f_current / lv_f_derivative ).
      lv_delta = abs( lv_x_next - lv_x_current ).

      IF lv_delta < '1e-10'.
        zero_point = lv_x_next.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_current = lv_x_next.
    ENDDO.

    zero_point = lv_x_current.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD evaluate_polynomial.
    DATA lv_power TYPE f.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.

    result = 0.0.

    LOOP AT coefficients INTO DATA(lv_coeff).
      lv_index = sy-tabix - 1.
      IF lv_index = 0.
        lv_power = 1.0.
      ELSE.
        lv_power = x_value ** lv_index.
      ENDIF.
      result = result + ( lv_coeff * lv_power ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD evaluate_and_find_zero.
    DATA lv_x_current TYPE f VALUE 1.0.
    DATA lv_x_next TYPE f.
    DATA lv_f_value TYPE f.
    DATA lv_f_derivative TYPE f.
    DATA lv_iteration TYPE i.
    DATA lv_max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 100.
    DATA lv_tolerance TYPE f VALUE 0.000001.
    DATA lv_difference TYPE f.
    DATA lv_power TYPE f.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_coeff TYPE f.

    lv_iteration = 0.

    WHILE lv_iteration < lv_max_iterations.
      lv_f_value = 0.
      lv_index = 0.
      LOOP AT coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_power = lv_x_current ** lv_index.
        lv_f_value = lv_f_value + ( lv_coeff * lv_power ).
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_f_derivative = 0.
      lv_index = 0.
      LOOP AT coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        IF lv_index > 0.
          lv_power = lv_x_current ** ( lv_index - 1 ).
          lv_f_derivative = lv_f_derivative + ( lv_index * lv_coeff * lv_power ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_f_derivative = 0.
        result = lv_x_current.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_next = lv_x_current - ( lv_f_value / lv_f_derivative ).
      lv_difference = lv_x_next - lv_x_current.

      IF lv_difference < 0.
        lv_difference = lv_difference * -1.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_difference < lv_tolerance.
        result = lv_x_next.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_current = lv_x_next.
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = lv_x_current.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polynomial_solver IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA lv_x_current TYPE f VALUE 1.0.
    DATA lv_x_next TYPE f.
    DATA lv_f_current TYPE f.
    DATA lv_tolerance TYPE f VALUE 0.00001.
    DATA lv_max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 1000.
    DATA lv_iteration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_derivative TYPE f.
    DATA lv_h TYPE f VALUE 0.0001.
    DATA lv_f_plus TYPE f.
    DATA lv_f_minus TYPE f.
    DATA lv_power TYPE f.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_coeff TYPE f.

    DO lv_max_iterations TIMES.
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.

      lv_f_current = 0.0.
      lv_index = 0.
      LOOP AT it_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_power = 1.0.
        IF lv_index > 0.
          lv_power = lv_x_current ** lv_index.
        ENDIF.
        lv_f_current = lv_f_current + ( lv_coeff * lv_power ).
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF abs( lv_f_current ) < lv_tolerance.
        rv_zero = lv_x_current.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_f_plus = 0.0.
      lv_index = 0.
      LOOP AT it_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_power = 1.0.
        IF lv_index > 0.
          lv_power = ( lv_x_current + lv_h ) ** lv_index.
        ENDIF.
        lv_f_plus = lv_f_plus + ( lv_coeff * lv_power ).
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_f_minus = 0.0.
      lv_index = 0.
      LOOP AT it_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        lv_power = 1.0.
        IF lv_index > 0.
          lv_power = ( lv_x_current - lv_h ) ** lv_index.
        ENDIF.
        lv_f_minus = lv_f_minus + ( lv_coeff * lv_power ).
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_derivative = ( lv_f_plus - lv_f_minus ) / ( 2 * lv_h ).

      IF abs( lv_derivative ) < lv_tolerance.
        rv_zero = lv_x_current.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_next = lv_x_current - ( lv_f_current / lv_derivative ).

      IF abs( lv_x_next - lv_x_current ) < lv_tolerance.
        rv_zero = lv_x_next.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_current = lv_x_next.
    ENDDO.

    rv_zero = lv_x_current.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD find_zero.
    DATA: lt_coefficients TYPE TABLE OF f.

    DATA: lv_x TYPE f VALUE 1.0.
    DATA: lv_fx TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_fpx TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_x_new TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_tolerance TYPE f VALUE 0.000001.
    DATA: lv_max_iterations TYPE i VALUE 1000.
    DATA: lv_iteration TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_x_power TYPE f.
    DATA: lv_deriv_power TYPE f.

    SPLIT iv_coefficients BY ',' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_parts).

    LOOP AT lt_parts INTO lv_coeff_str.
      lv_coeff_str = cl_abap_string_utilities=>to_upper( lv_coeff_str ).
      lv_coeff = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>read_string( lv_coeff_str )->get( ).
      INSERT lv_coeff INTO TABLE lt_coefficients.
    ENDLOOP.

    DO lv_max_iterations TIMES.
      lv_fx = 0.
      lv_fpx = 0.
      lv_index = 0.

      LOOP AT lt_coefficients INTO lv_coeff.
        IF lv_index = 0.
          lv_fx = lv_fx + lv_coeff.
        ELSE.
          lv_x_power = 1.
          DO lv_index TIMES.
            lv_x_power = lv_x_power * lv_x.
          ENDDO.
          lv_fx = lv_fx + ( lv_coeff * lv_x_power ).

          lv_deriv_power = 1.
          DO lv_index - 1 TIMES.
            lv_deriv_power = lv_deriv_power * lv_x.
          ENDDO.
          lv_fpx = lv_fpx + ( lv_index * lv_coeff * lv_deriv_power ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF ABS( lv_fpx ) < lv_tolerance.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x_new = lv_x - ( lv_fx / lv_fpx ).

      IF ABS( lv_x_new - lv_x ) < lv_tolerance.
        lv_x = lv_x_new.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_x = lv_x_new.
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.
    ENDDO.

    rv_zero = lv_x.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

          lv_f_derivative = lv_f_derivative + ( lv_i * lv_coeff * lv_power ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_f_derivative = 0.
        lv_x_next = lv_x_current - 0.1.
      ELSE.
        lv_x_next = lv_x_current - ( lv_f_value / lv_f_derivative ).

      lv_difference = lv_x_next - lv_x_current.

CLASS z_interval_intersection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_intersection_prime
      IMPORTING iv_start1 TYPE i
                iv_end1 TYPE i
                iv_start2 TYPE i
                iv_end2 TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_interval_intersection IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD check_intersection_prime.
    DATA lv_intersection_start TYPE i.
    DATA lv_intersection_end TYPE i.
    DATA lv_intersection_length TYPE i.
    DATA lv_is_prime TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_i TYPE i.

    lv_intersection_start = COND i( WHEN iv_start1 > iv_start2 THEN iv_start1 ELSE iv_start2 ).
    lv_intersection_end = COND i( WHEN iv_end1 < iv_end2 THEN iv_end1 ELSE iv_end2 ).

    IF lv_intersection_start > lv_intersection_end.
      rv_result = 'NO'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_intersection_length = lv_intersection_end - lv_intersection_start.

    IF lv_intersection_length < 2.
      rv_result = 'NO'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_is_prime = abap_true.

    IF lv_intersection_length = 2.
      lv_is_prime = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      IF MOD( lv_intersection_length, 2 ) = 0.
        lv_is_prime = abap_false.
      ELSE.
        lv_i = 3.
        WHILE lv_i * lv_i <= lv_intersection_length.
          IF MOD( lv_intersection_length, lv_i ) = 0.
            lv_is_prime = abap_false.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          lv_i = lv_i + 2.
        ENDWHILE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_is_prime = abap_true.
      rv_result = 'YES'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'NO'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_interval_intersection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS check_intersection
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval1_start TYPE i
        iv_interval1_end TYPE i
        iv_interval2_start TYPE i
        iv_interval2_end TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

      IMPORTING

CLASS z_interval_intersection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_intersection.
    DATA lv_intersection_start TYPE i.
    DATA lv_intersection_end TYPE i.
    DATA lv_intersection_length TYPE i.

    IF iv_interval1_start > iv_interval2_end OR iv_interval2_start > iv_interval1_end.
      rv_result = 'NO'.
      RETURN.

      RETURN.

    CLEAR index_list.

    WHILE i < list_size.
      IF i MOD 3 = 0.
        APPEND input_list[ i + 1 ] TO divisible_by_three.

    ENDWHILE.

          temp_value = sorted_values[ i + 1 ].
          sorted_values[ i + 1 ] = sorted_values[ j + 1 ].
          sorted_values[ j + 1 ] = temp_value.

CLASS zcl_prime_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD is_prime.
    rv_result = abap_false.

    IF iv_number < 2.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number = 2.
      rv_result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number MOD 2 = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_i TYPE i.
    DATA lv_sqrt TYPE i.

    lv_sqrt = SQRT( iv_number ).

    lv_i = 3.
    WHILE lv_i <= lv_sqrt.
      IF iv_number MOD lv_i = 0.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lv_i = lv_i + 2.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS z_is_prime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_prime.
    result = abap_false.

    IF n < 2.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF n = 2.
      result = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF n MOD 2 = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(i) = 3.
    DATA(limit) = SQRT( n ).

    WHILE i <= limit.
      IF n MOD i = 0.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      i = i + 2.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA: lt_words TYPE TABLE OF string,
          lt_values TYPE TABLE OF i,

          lv_temp_value TYPE i,
          lv_result TYPE string,
          lv_first TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true,
          lv_i TYPE i,
          lv_j TYPE i,
          lv_size TYPE i.

    SPLIT numbers AT space INTO TABLE lt_words.

    LOOP AT lt_words INTO lv_word.
      CASE lv_word.
        WHEN 'zero'.
          lv_value = 0.
        WHEN 'one'.
          lv_value = 1.
        WHEN 'two'.
          lv_value = 2.
        WHEN 'three'.
          lv_value = 3.

          lv_value = 4.

          lv_value = 5.
        WHEN 'six'.
          lv_value = 6.
        WHEN 'seven'.
          lv_value = 7.
        WHEN 'eight'.
          lv_value = 8.
        WHEN 'nine'.
          lv_value = 9.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND lv_value TO lt_values.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_size = LINES( lt_values ).

    DO lv_size TIMES.
      lv_i = sy-index.
      DO lv_size - lv_i TIMES.
        lv_j = sy-index.
        IF lt_values[ lv_j ] > lt_values[ lv_j + 1 ].
          lv_temp_value = lt_values[ lv_j ].
          lt_values[ lv_j ] = lt_values[ lv_j + 1 ].
          lt_values[ lv_j + 1 ] = lv_temp_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.

    LOOP AT lt_values INTO lv_value.
      CASE lv_value.
        WHEN 0.
          lv_word = 'zero'.
        WHEN 1.
          lv_word = 'one'.
        WHEN 2.
          lv_word = 'two'.
        WHEN 3.
          lv_word = 'three'.
        WHEN 4.
          lv_word = 'four'.
        WHEN 5.
          lv_word = 'five'.
        WHEN 6.
          lv_word = 'six'.
        WHEN 7.
          lv_word = 'seven'.
        WHEN 8.
          lv_word = 'eight'.
        WHEN 9.
          lv_word = 'nine'.
      ENDCASE.

      IF lv_first = abap_true.
        lv_result = lv_word.
        lv_first = abap_false.
      ELSE.
        lv_result = lv_result && space && lv_word.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    result = lv_result.

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA: lv_min_index TYPE i.

        WHEN 'nine'.
          lv_num_value = 9.

          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.

      CONCATENATE lv_num_value lv_word INTO lv_pair.
      APPEND lv_pair TO lt_number_pairs.
    ENDLOOP.

    lt_temp_table = lt_number_pairs.

    LOOP AT lt_temp_table INTO lv_pair.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS calculate
      IMPORTING
        n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF decfloat34.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA: lv_n_float TYPE decfloat34.

    CLEAR result.

    IF n < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO result.
    result[ 1 ] = 1.

    IF n = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO result.
    result[ 2 ] = 3.

    IF n = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO n - 1 TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index + 2.

      IF lv_index MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_n_float = lv_index.
        lv_value = 1 + ( lv_n_float / 2 ).
      ELSE.
        lv_value = result[ lv_index - 1 ] +
                   result[ lv_index - 2 ].

        IF lv_index + 1 <= n + 1.
          IF ( lv_index + 1 ) MOD 2 = 0.
            lv_n_float = lv_index + 1.
            lv_value = lv_value + ( 1 + ( lv_n_float / 2 ) ).
          ELSE.
            lv_value = lv_value + result[ lv_index ].
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          lv_value = lv_value + result[ lv_index ].
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_value TO result.
    ENDDO.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS calculate IMPORTING n TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    DATA: memo TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: tri_value TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: val1 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: val2 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: val3 TYPE decfloat16.

    CLEAR result.

    IF n < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO n + 2 TIMES.
      APPEND 0 TO memo.
    ENDDO.

    DO n + 1 TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.

      IF i = 0.
        tri_value = 1.
      ELSEIF i = 1.
        tri_value = 3.
      ELSEIF i MOD 2 = 0.
        tri_value = 1 + i / 2.0.
      ELSE.
        READ TABLE memo INDEX i INTO val1.
        IF val1 = 0.
          IF i - 1 = 0.
            val1 = 1.
          ELSEIF i - 1 = 1.
            val1 = 3.
          ELSEIF ( i - 1 ) MOD 2 = 0.
            val1 = 1 + ( i - 1 ) / 2.0.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        READ TABLE memo INDEX i - 1 INTO val2.
        IF val2 = 0.
          IF i - 2 = 0.
            val2 = 1.
          ELSEIF i - 2 = 1.
            val2 = 3.
          ELSEIF ( i - 2 ) MOD 2 = 0.
            val2 = 1 + ( i - 2 ) / 2.0.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        IF ( i + 1 ) MOD 2 = 0.
          val3 = 1 + ( i + 1 ) / 2.0.
        ELSE.
          val3 = 0.
        ENDIF.

        tri_value = val1 + val2 + val3.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND tri_value TO result.
      INSERT tri_value INTO memo INDEX i + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS calculate IMPORTING n TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_value TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA lt_memo TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
    DATA lv_size TYPE i.
    DATA lv_counter TYPE i.
    DATA lv_mod TYPE i.
    DATA lv_prev1 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA lv_prev2 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA lv_next TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA lv_index_minus_1 TYPE i.
    DATA lv_index_minus_2 TYPE i.
    DATA lv_index_plus_1 TYPE i.

    lv_size = n + 1.
    DO lv_size TIMES.
      APPEND 0.0 TO lt_memo.
    ENDDO.

    lv_counter = 0.
    DO lv_size TIMES.
      IF lv_counter = 0.
        lv_value = 1.0.
      ELSEIF lv_counter = 1.
        lv_value = 3.0.
      ELSE.
        lv_mod = lv_counter MOD 2.
        IF lv_mod = 0.
          lv_value = 1.0 + ( lv_counter / 2.0 ).
        ELSE.
          lv_index_minus_1 = lv_counter - 1.
          lv_index_minus_2 = lv_counter - 2.
          lv_index_plus_1 = lv_counter + 1.

          READ TABLE lt_memo INDEX lv_index_minus_1 INTO lv_prev1.
          READ TABLE lt_memo INDEX lv_index_minus_2 INTO lv_prev2.

          IF lv_index_plus_1 = 0.
            lv_next = 1.0.
          ELSEIF lv_index_plus_1 = 1.
            lv_next = 3.0.
          ELSE.
            lv_mod = lv_index_plus_1 MOD 2.
            IF lv_mod = 0.
              lv_next = 1.0 + ( lv_index_plus_1 / 2.0 ).
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.

          lv_value = lv_prev1 + lv_prev2 + lv_next.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_value TO result.
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_tri.
    lt_tri[ 2 ] = 3.

    IF lv_n = 1.

    DO lv_n - 1 TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index + 2.

      IF lv_index MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_value = 1 + ( lv_index / 2 ).
      ELSE.
        IF lv_index = 3.
          lv_value = lt_tri[ lv_index - 1 ] + lt_tri[ lv_index - 2 ] + ( 1 + ( ( lv_index + 1 ) / 2 ) ).
        ELSE.
          lv_value = lt_tri[ lv_index - 1 ] + lt_tri[ lv_index - 2 ] + ( 1 + ( ( lv_index + 1 ) / 2 ) ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_value TO lt_tri.
    ENDDO.

    result = lt_tri.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    DATA: memo TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: tri_value TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: zero_val TYPE decfloat16 VALUE 0.

    CLEAR result.

    IF n < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO n + 1 TIMES.
      APPEND zero_val TO memo.
    ENDDO.

    DO n + 1 TIMES.
      i = sy-index - 1.
      tri_value = get_tri_value( index = i memo = memo ).
      APPEND tri_value TO result.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_tri_value.
    DATA: memo_size TYPE i.
    DATA: val1 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: val2 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: val3 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: memo_copy TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.

    memo_size = LINES( memo ).

    IF index = 0.
      value = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF index = 1.
      value = 3.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE memo INDEX index + 1 INTO value.
    IF value <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF index MOD 2 = 0.
      value = 1 + index / 2.0.
    ELSE.
      memo_copy = memo.
      val1 = get_tri_value( index = index - 1 memo = memo_copy ).
      val2 = get_tri_value( index = index - 2 memo = memo_copy ).
      val3 = get_tri_value( index = index + 1 memo = memo_copy ).

      value = val1 + val2 + val3.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD tri.

    DATA lv_n_float TYPE decfloat16.

    IF n < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO result.
    result[ 1 ] = 1.

    IF n = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO result.
    result[ 2 ] = 3.

    IF n = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO n - 1 TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index + 2.

      IF lv_index MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_n_float = lv_index.
        lv_value = 1 + ( lv_n_float / 2 ).
        APPEND lv_value TO result.
      ELSE.
        lv_value = result[ lv_index - 1 ] + result[ lv_index - 2 ].

        IF lv_index + 1 <= n + 1.
          IF ( lv_index + 1 ) MOD 2 = 0.
            lv_n_float = lv_index + 1.
            lv_value = lv_value + ( 1 + ( lv_n_float / 2 ) ).
          ELSE.
            lv_value = lv_value + result[ lv_index ].
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          lv_value = lv_value + result[ lv_index ].
        ENDIF.

        APPEND lv_value TO result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS tri IMPORTING n TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF decfloat34 .

CLASS zcl_tribonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD tri.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_value TYPE decfloat34.
    DATA lt_tri TYPE TABLE OF decfloat34.
    DATA lv_size TYPE i.

    IF n < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_size = n + 1.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_tri.
    lt_tri[ 1 ] = 1.

    IF lv_size > 1.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_tri.
      lt_tri[ 2 ] = 3.
    ENDIF.

    lv_index = 2.
    WHILE lv_index < lv_size.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.

      IF lv_index MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_value = 1 + ( lv_index / 2 ).
      ELSE.
        lv_value = lt_tri[ lv_index - 1 ] + lt_tri[ lv_index - 2 ] + ( 1 + ( ( lv_index + 1 ) / 2 ) ).
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_value TO lt_tri.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS calculate IMPORTING n TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    DATA: memo TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
    DATA: i TYPE i.
    DATA: val TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: extended_memo TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
    DATA: index_val TYPE i.
    DATA: even_check TYPE i.
    DATA: val1 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: val2 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: val3 TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA: memo_size TYPE i.
    
    IF n < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    
    extended_memo = memo.
    
    DO n + 1 TIMES.
      index_val = sy-index - 1.
      
      IF index_val = 1.
        val = 3.
      ELSE.
        even_check = index_val MOD 2.
        IF even_check = 0.
          val = 1 + ( index_val / 2 ).
        ELSE.
          memo_size = LINES( extended_memo ).
          IF index_val - 1 <= memo_size AND index_val - 1 > 0.
            val1 = extended_memo[ index_val - 1 ].
          ELSE.
            val1 = 0.
          ENDIF.
          
          IF index_val - 2 <= memo_size AND index_val - 2 > 0.
            val2 = extended_memo[ index_val - 2 ].
          ELSE.
            val2 = 0.
          ENDIF.
          
          IF index_val + 1 = 2.
            val3 = 2.
          ELSEIF index_val + 1 = 4.
            val3 = 3.
          ELSE.
            val3 = 0.
          ENDIF.
          
          val = val1 + val2 + val3.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      
      APPEND val TO result.
      APPEND val TO extended_memo.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS tri
      IMPORTING n TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tribonacci IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD tri.
    DATA lt_tri TYPE TABLE OF decfloat16.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_value TYPE decfloat16.

    IF n < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND 1 TO lt_tri.

    IF n = 0.
      result = lt_tri.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND 3 TO lt_tri.

    lv_index = 2.
    WHILE lv_index <= n.
      IF lv_index MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_value = 1 + ( lv_index / 2 ).
      ELSE.
        lv_value = lt_tri[ lv_index ] + lt_tri[ lv_index - 1 ].
        IF lv_index + 1 <= n.
          IF ( lv_index + 1 ) MOD 2 = 0.
            lv_value = lv_value + ( 1 + ( ( lv_index + 1 ) / 2 ) ).
          ELSE.
            lv_value = lv_value + lt_tri[ lv_index - 1 ] + lt_tri[ lv_index - 2 ].
            IF lv_index + 2 <= n.
              IF ( lv_index + 2 ) MOD 2 = 0.
                lv_value = lv_value + ( 1 + ( ( lv_index + 2 ) / 2 ) ).
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND lv_value TO lt_tri.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    result = lt_tri.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS METHODS validate_date
      IMPORTING date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(result) TYPE abap_bool
    .
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_date.
    DATA: month TYPE i.
    DATA: day TYPE i.
    DATA: year TYPE i.
    DATA: parts TYPE TABLE OF string.
    DATA: part_count TYPE i.

    result = abap_false.

    IF date_string IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT date_string AT '-' INTO TABLE parts.
    part_count = lines( parts ).

    IF part_count <> 3.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        month = CONV i( parts[ 1 ] ).
        day = CONV i( parts[ 2 ] ).
        year = CONV i( parts[ 3 ] ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    IF month < 1 OR month > 12.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF day < 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CASE month.
      WHEN 1 OR 3 OR 5 OR 7 OR 8 OR 10 OR 12.
        IF day > 31.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 4 OR 6 OR 9 OR 11.
        IF day > 30.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 2.
        IF day > 29.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

    IF strlen( parts[ 1 ] ) <> 2 OR
       strlen( parts[ 2 ] ) <> 2 OR
       strlen( parts[ 3 ] ) <> 4.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    result = abap_true.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD validate_date.
    DATA lv_month TYPE i.

    DATA lv_year TYPE i.

    DATA lv_dash_count TYPE i.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_char TYPE c.
    DATA lv_month_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_day_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_year_str TYPE string.
    DATA lv_part_index TYPE i.
    DATA lv_current_part TYPE string.

    rv_is_valid = abap_false.

    IF iv_date_string IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_length = strlen( iv_date_string ).

    IF lv_length <> 10.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_dash_count = 0.
    lv_part_index = 0.
    lv_current_part = ''.

    DO lv_length TIMES.
      lv_index = sy-index - 1.
      lv_char = iv_date_string+lv_index(1).

      IF lv_char = '-'.
        lv_dash_count = lv_dash_count + 1.
        IF lv_part_index = 0.
          lv_month_str = lv_current_part.
        ELSEIF lv_part_index = 1.
          lv_day_str = lv_current_part.
        ENDIF.
        lv_current_part = ''.
        lv_part_index = lv_part_index + 1.
      ELSE.
        IF lv_char < '0' OR lv_char > '9'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        lv_current_part = lv_current_part && lv_char.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    lv_year_str = lv_current_part.

    IF lv_dash_count <> 2.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_month_str IS INITIAL OR lv_day_str IS INITIAL OR lv_year_str IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF strlen( lv_month_str ) <> 2 OR strlen( lv_day_str ) <> 2 OR strlen( lv_year_str ) <> 4.

    ENDIF.

    TRY.
      lv_month = lv_month_str.
      lv_day = lv_day_str.
      lv_year = lv_year_str.
    CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
      RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lv_month < 1 OR lv_month > 12.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_day < 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CASE lv_month.
      WHEN 1 OR 3 OR 5 OR 7 OR 8 OR 10 OR 12.
        IF lv_day > 31.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 4 OR 6 OR 9 OR 11.
        IF lv_day > 30.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 2.
        IF lv_day > 29.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.

    rv_is_valid = abap_true.

    DATA: len TYPE I.

    DATA: valid1 TYPE ABAP_BOOL VALUE abap_true.

    IF lines( lst ) < 2.

    DO len TIMES.

      char = combined1+i(1).

        counter1 = counter1 + 1.

        counter1 = counter1 - 1.
